ekegusii: Abange ba abasenator nigo baiyeria engana eyio igoro yo okoroisigwe gwe ekomiti eyio no omonogeri bwe ebunge eyio ken Lusaka eyio yarenge gochia korau no omosenator Cleophas malala amo no omokonyi oye susan kihika kwarigania oroboti rwabo igoro ye obotuki obwo ase amatuko 10 na rika riaye goetia ebunge engima etuke oroboti rwe ebunge ya kiambu igoro ye engana eyio magega ya abasenator 28 kogania ebunge engima na 16 kogania ekomiti koroisigwa.

english: This great school of Gusii was established by the people of Gusii, and it has grown into a large school. It started as a primary school and then a secondary school, but we haven't reached university level yet. The Member of Parliament for Nyaribari Masaba, Sam Ongeri, helped greatly that year to build this big school for the children of Simbauti and the residents of Borabu.
ekegusii: Ekero esukuru enene ya Gusii eraagachwe seito Gusii, nigo erarete obuya obonene seito. Nigo tobwate chisukuru chia puremari amo ne chisekenderi chinyinge lakini titobwati eyunivasiti nonya neyemo. Obunge o Nyaribari Masaba,Sam Ongeri natebete omwaka oyo oera inga tiga toagache esukuru enene aaria ase omogongo o Simbauti ase ensemo ya Borabu.

english: Dr. John Akama, Vice Chancellor, Kisii University College
ekegusii: Dr. John Akama, Vice Chachellor, Kisii University College

english: The Gusii University (Kisii University College) was established with the following objectives:
ekegusii: Eyunivasiti ya Gusii (Kisii University College) nigo erarete amagenderero amange buna:

english: - These courses were created so that many children can get a good education. This helps those children who didn't manage to study because they lacked resources to benefit from the available courses.
ekegusii: - Amabaga ande amange nigo aratoke ya abana baito gosoma chisemi chinene. Bono iga abana abange tibari gosoma buna batagete nonya baetire amatemwa ase engencho ya amabaga gotatoka.

english: - This university was established to provide higher education to the people of Gusii. That school attracts teachers and workers who contribute significantly. Many graduates are employed in various sectors.
ekegusii: - Ekero eyunivasiti eraagachwe, nigo erarente chigasi chinyinge ase Gusii yaito. Nigo esukuru eyio erarike abarimu amo na abakori emeremo be chinamuna chinyinge. Abaremi baito nabarabwo nigo baratware ase bakoonia chindagera.

english: - The big school was built with a lot of effort and resources. This development plan aims to help develop this university.
ekegusii: - Esukuru enene koagachwa negere chibara chinyinge chirosigwe amo no omorero kong’uswa. Ekero omochango oraanse, tiga tobwaterane toagache eyunivasiti yaito.

english: We understand there is a lot of discussion about President William Ruto, we want to tell those who associate with President Uhuru Kenyatta and ODM leader Raila Odinga.

english: We understand there is a lot of discussion about President William Ruto, we want to tell those who associate with President Uhuru Kenyatta and ODM leader Raila Odinga, which was broadcast for two years.
ekegusii: Ensemo yabarai baria bakomobwatesia omokonyi bwomorai bwense William Ruto, otuguteire are okobwatana gati yomorai bwense Uhuru Kneyatta nomorai bwekiama gia ODM Raila Odinga, okwo gwaikeranetwe emiaka 2 yaetire

english: Those people have reached a point of no return, they said going back is impossible, Kenyans will not accept them returning to cooperate like that.
ekegusii: Abarai abwo barenge gokwana emambia ya rero, nigo batebire buna goika bono, abakenya tibararora buya barengire goikeranigwa nokobwaterana okwo

ekegusii: [CLIP] MPS DISMISS.

ekegusii: Nonya nabo, omoriki bwekiama gia ODM Edwin Sifuna, nigo aegereire okobwaterana okwo,n goteba kwaretire amange amaya ase ense ya Kenya

english: [CLIP]SIFUNA PACT…
ekegusii: [CLIP]SIFUNA PACT…

english: Uhuru and Raila agreed to cooperate and resolve the election dispute following the 2017 general election, on March 9, 2018, leading to significant changes.
ekegusii: Uhuru na Raila nigo baigwananete kobwatana na gokora emeremo ase obwamo, chitariki 9 March omwaka o 2018, magega yobochori obonene bwa 2017 obwo bwaenegeti okwamererania

english: Members of the Tangatanga faction have been accused of inciting chaos during the Building Bridges Initiative (BBI) Mombasa meeting.
ekegusii: Ababunge ba tanga tanga bakureirwe kobeka omorembe ase omosangererekano o BBI mombasa

english: The MPs are said to have disrupted proceedings when President Uhuru Kenyatta and former Prime Minister Raila Odinga were addressing their supporters, leading to clashes with those from the Tangatanga side who also tried to disrupt the proceedings led by Deputy President William Ruto, causing a scene and almost disrupting the BBI popularization process, which was intended to educate citizens about the benefits of the BBI bill, culminating in chaotic scenes at the Mombasa event over the weekend.
ekegusii: Ababunge baete okoboko ogocha amo kwo omorai bwe ense Uhuru kenyatta amo no omorai bwe ekiama kia ODM Raila Odinga babakureire abamwabo be ekeombe gia tanga tanga abwo bamoete okoboko omokonyi bwo omorai bwe ense William Ruto tibaenana amagani ande onsi chingaki bagochi gosanga nabwo goikerana omosangererekano bwo okobamanyia abananchi igoro yo oroboti rwa BBI orobereirie gochi gokorekana ime ya mombasa eikendi eye.

english: These MPs are allied with outspoken legislators from both houses, including National Assembly Minority Leader Junet Mohammed and Senate Deputy Majority Leader Cleophas Malala, who have accused them of deliberately trying to sabotage the BBI popularization efforts, alleging they will not succeed in their plans.
ekegusii: Ababunge abwo bakorau no omoteneneri bwa ababunge bo omobaro omoke ase ebunge enene Junet mohammed amo no omokonyi bwo omorai bwo omobaro omoke ase ebunge ye esenate Cleophas malala batebire buna nonya kera omokenya kabwate obosibore bwo ogoikerana omosangererekano oyio abarai abwo tibabwenereti gocha na amachiko abo.

english: Nairobi Senator Johnson Sakaja and Kieni MP Kanini Kega have stated that the BBI process should be postponed until after the 2022 elections and allow leaders to focus on other priorities under President Uhuru Kenyatta's leadership.
ekegusii: Boigo omosenator o Nairobi Johnson sakaja amo no omobunge o kieni kanini kega batuguteire are amangana buna emesangererekano eyio ya bbi erengete siasa chio omwaka bwe 2022 na kobagania abarai gotiga komochecheria omorai bwe ense uhuru kenyatta.

english: Aria O' Bande, Mother Naomi Agatwara Obororo Obonge Ase Omoyo Oye [Ruth 1:1-5]: The child of a man, Reverend Douglas Otiso oyio
ekegusii: Aaria O' Bande, Omong'ina Naomi Agatwara Obororo Obonge Ase Omoyo Oye [ Ruth 1:1-5 ]: Omwana Omino, Reverend Douglas Otiso oyio

english: Write down this story so that people remember, let them learn and be strengthened. Aria also tells the story of Bande, Naomi writes about her life. Remember, a husband dies and leaves behind his wife and children. Because of suffering and hardship, the troubles that affect Naomi's life, and she raises her daughter.
ekegusii: Konyora emechando komenyete obande, amariga nigo agoichora, kwaborwa oyokogotinyia. Aaria ase ense y' bande, Naomi akanyora obokongu obonge mono. Ritang'ani, omogaka oye agasira na komotiga bweka n' abana. Buna okomiamia n' okoramokia, amakweri agaonchora obogima bw' Naomi, na komoura omwanchi oye.

english: This happened a long time ago, the troubles continued to come after five years, then her sons got wives, and they lived together, but they died, leaving only her. Therefore, Mother Naomi took the sorrowful journey with her life.
ekegusii: Bono gatigara kare omoboraka, amakweri naende agatarera omochi oye nyuma y' emiaka ikomi, abwo ase abana baye abamura babere, nabarabwo basirete, na komotiga ore bweka. Aaiga, omong'ina Naomi agatwara obororo obonge ase omoyo oye.

english: Our Father provides everything.
ekegusii: Bono Tata otoriereire eiira.

english: Traditions are not bad. Customs are not bad, but we should look up to our Great Father Nyasae. The child of a man, Reverend Douglas Otiso oyio.
ekegusii: Amariga takoba aroro. Ebirero tibikoba aroro, ekero twaaikire nka ase Omonene Tata Nyasae. Omwana omino, Reverend Douglas Otiso oyio.

english: My mother tells me about Reverend Douglas Otiso about putting videos on Youtube.
ekegusii: Mbuya mono gochia ase Reverend Douglas Otiso ase okobeka ogotera oko kw' ogosesenigwa ase Youtube.

english: The shield of God is strong – it protects people from all shields of the wicked. The shield of God is perfected today, with strength and wisdom, and this which has been completed leads them to be baptized in Jesus and John and leads them to know His name during their worship. Let us strive to be cleansed today through the shield of God so that we may be acceptable.
ekegusii: Oboronge bwa Nyasae nigo bore maiso -marore naende tibari buna oboronge bwa mwanyabanto. oboronge bwa Nyasae nigo boorokirie ime ase enchiri yamache na omoika , obwo bwaikeranetigwe goetera ase okobatiswa kwa Yeso amo na Yohana na goetera ase amanyinga aye igoro ase omosaraba. Goika toirane ase okwegena kore ime ase oboronge bwa Nyasae chingaki chitaraera.

english: Do you remember when Jesus was baptized by John the baptizer? Why did John baptize Jesus, yet he himself was less important than Him? John the baptizer was a great prophet, a very great prophet who testified about everyone, and the baptism he gave to Jesus also showed the plan of God so that He might forgive sins and cleanse them through Jesus.
ekegusii: Nomanyete ekiagera Yeso akabatiswa na Yohana omobatisi? Onye Yohana atabatisete Yeso, ebibe biaito nanga tibing'anyetigwe gochia asare. Yohana omobatisi nigo arenge omonto omonene omobatisi nigo arenge omonto omonene goetania bonsi, naende ebatiso eria abatisete Yeso nakwo kwarengeokogania ogoikeranu Nyasae atagete ase okong'anyia ebibe biaito korwa ase tore gochia ase Yeso.

english: Jesus was baptized to bear all sins of the world throughout his life, and He will lead them to know His name during their worship forever. All things have come to pass according to the knowledge of our Lord during their worship. Truly God has revealed His shield so that we may understand and be cleansed through His shield. I greatly desire your coming.
ekegusii: Yeso nigo abatisetwe ase okobogoria ebibe bionsi bi'ense igoro ase rireko riaye, naende agaitera amanyinga igoro ase omosaraba erinde aakane eng'eria yabo yonsi. Ebinto ebio bionsi biaonchoirie okomanya kwane ogotang'ani igoro ase omosaraba oka. bono Nyasae okworokereria oboronge bwaye buna bore erinde tomanye gochia ime na kwegena ime ase oboronge bwaye. Namoiraneirie omonene buya ase ogosesenia oko gwensi.

english: Minto FM: Addressing Concerns Regarding the Name of Kisii County – Ongwae
ekegusii: Minto FM: Obokoreri Bw’ Obochenu Ime Ya Kisii County – Ongwae

english: The Governor of Kisii County has issued a directive regarding the concerns raised by traders and business people. He stated that he has heard the complaints of those traders from Obochenu and understands their difficulties in accessing funds and services within the county, and they have expressed numerous issues concerning the trading environment. Speaking on Minto FM with Host Junior Lollypohp John, the Governor said he will investigate the allegations of embezzlement of funds which have been circulating among the public.
ekegusii: Omogavana o’ Kisii County otebire buna eng’encho nereo abakoreri bo obochenu gotiga omogira na koirana emeremo. Nigo amentire goteba abakoreri abwo bo Obochenu nigo bare egati ya baria bagoakanwa eng’eria enene kobua abaobisa bande be ekaunti na nigo baire amaganio onsi y’ obokoreri bw obogwenia. Gokwana ime ya Minto FM n’ Omogaka Junior Lollypohp John, Omogavana oyio nigo atebire onye tibari gochia koirana emeremo riroria tamochigwa ekere barabutwe.

english: The headteacher says that parents should take their children to school so they can learn and grow up knowing their culture well. The results have been released today, and now the parents are happy and celebrating.
ekegusii: Mwanyagetinge ominto, gento nkeiyo toratigere abana baito otatiga kobaira esukuru erinde basome nari bagocha bekonya amatuko are motwe. Amatemu nasoka bwango iga, na nigo abana bande bakora bobe pi, na abande bagaeta buya.

english: Please share this information with people from Keroka sub-county: There is a school called Keroka D.O.K Primary School which has good performance and its director is Mr. Laban Opande who works hard in his work. Mwanyagetinge.com/2016.
ekegusii: Tokare goika aaria ase omochi o Keroka omokubio oyo oerete: Aiga nesukuru ya Keroka D.O.K Primary School ase omoegereri bw' ebina Laban Opande ore aaria maiko aeterete ase amasomo aye. Mwanyagetinge.com/2016.

english: This school has greatly improved because of the leadership of Mr. Laban who has helped teachers, students perform well and also ensured there is discipline, good infrastructure, and a motivated teacher who works diligently. According to the 2015 KCPE results, this school was the most improved having raised the mean score from 220 to 259.7.
ekegusii: Esukuru eye nigo yaba kegokora bobe naki omosike Laban aba gagosegeta abarimu, abaibori n' abana bakore omokia na nabae ekeegwa gochia ase enyaroka entag'ani, omomura omotang'ani, naboigo omwarimu omoremo oye ore gocha gotangana. Bono ekero amatemu asoka for 2015 KCPE, esukuru eye nigo yaba most improved korwa a mean score of 220 to 259.7.

english: Laban has been praised for discipline and infrastructure and the teacher who motivates them has worked hard. This is a big achievement for the people of Mwanyagetinge. We continue to encourage children who study hard to succeed.
ekegusii: Laban narwa ebiegwa gochia ase omonyaroka n'omomura omotang'ani nere omwarimu ori omoremo oye otang'anete nanyora ekeegwa kiaye. Oyo n'omokia omonene n'esegeto engiya ase Mwanyagetinge. Ntwe nigo togosabera abana aba amaya ase kera egento bagokora,

english: The news reports that there is heavy traffic, and people say that vehicles are stuck and unable to move due to the congestion on the roads from Kisumu to Nairobi today. Being delayed like this with a "matatu" is very frustrating because of the long queues and the time wasted at the stage, the congestion causing delays on the road and the numerous roundabouts making the journey longer.
ekegusii: Rituko ria rero ekenyanchuge, maambia chuni nigo abaonchoreria barobekana kobwatekana n’ogokanigwa kogendia emetoka yabo ya mogongoteni ase omochie o nairobi gati. Ogokurerwa buna nonya nechi’ “matatu” nigo chigochi gwancherwa gotenena chitageka isano chioka ase egetaseni gi’ chigari, mogongoteni gotagenda omochie gati na oboetanano(round abouts) korusigwa aroro nigo biaretire riberera.

english: Because of those roundabouts, the road has been filled with many vehicles, and drivers are trying to overtake each other and continue their journeys quickly. However, with the current situation, our colleague Juma says that the congestion on the road is caused by many vehicles colliding and causing an accident near the intersection, which has resulted in a lot of damage.
ekegusii: Nonya nabo oboetanano nigo bwateirwe ne chingaki ekiagera nigo abarundia bagotenena koganya chigari chinde rika chigokung’ia ake na kogenda buna chinse chiria chiagendereire. gokwana na omotuki oito bwa amang’ana omosike Juma, nigo agoteba buna nonya emegongoteni nigo yaeteirwe nechingaki buna ekororekana nonya kere enchera ye’rigori ria inse ase ogosomba endagera gochia ase obomenyo kobwa mono eria egosareka bwango.

english: The road has become impassable, and there are many vehicles unable to pass through the roadblocks leading to Nairobi. Anyone heading towards "Wakulima Market" should be aware of the current situation. And friends, listen to GUSII FM always on frequency 104.0 FM.
ekegusii: Emegongoteni nigo yabeire gekoreta ogotenena gwe chigari nonya nabo tibari kobwatia amachiko eyio ekoirera omochie kogenda ng’ora kobua enyongore. Onye gwaetire aaria “wakulima market” nabo okoba kirori bwa amang’ana aya. ase amange, tegerera GUSII FM bwango iga aaria ase chikaonti chiaito 104.0 FM.

english: Good afternoon everyone: With Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Thursday (September) 14, 2011
ekegusii: Buna twakabeire:Na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Tureti Y' Kebaki (September) 14, 2011

english: When someone steals a little bit of maize from leaders and their hearts become very angry, they protect themselves from being gossiped about. Truly, hearts get annoyed when they are given an insult. It is better for people to be quiet than to give a foolish child a name.
ekegusii: Nigo chiaigete chinsa chia maiso abakungu na magokoro akaara riiyo nse erinde tonya kogosoria. Keri keri, magokoro agateba buna nabwate embachero. Nigo omongina baba ominto atebete buna nabwate omwana oyomo.

english: Look closely and plant good bananas. Because if it ripens well, respect the child who has them and his relatives so that they can also have some. It is good to have good bananas, because if a child doesn't have enough, he will be weak. Why do hearts worry so much?
ekegusii: Ochire echiro na kogora amatoke abere. Bono korende gaikire nyomba, onyorire omwana oye ore n'abagisangio baye babere. Nigo abwate amatoke abere oka, ko natagete koa omwana oye ritoke erimo rigima. Naki magokoro agokora gose?

english: Yes indeed. Hearts always want good bananas. But why don't they ripen?
ekegusii: Yaani manya. Magokoro nigo atorentera amatoke abere oka. Bono nako togokora?

english: MESSAGE: Bananas and good things, few children. So let his relatives of the child who has enough share. Know that they will teach the child how to eat a whole banana. A half is not a full banana. That is why the child who has a full banana is happy!
ekegusii: RICHIBU: Amatoke n'abere, abana mbatato. Nigo nkoa abagisangio b' omwana one ritoke erimo erimo. Manye kobatebia babutorere omwana one enusu kera oyomo. Enusu omente enusu nigo ekoba ritoke rigima. Igo nari omwana one arari ritoke rigima!

english: The government has been very concerned about the current situation and how it affects people's lives. This is because there are many challenges facing our communities and families due to the severe effects.
ekegusii: Eserikali nero bono egochia gokonachera buna indi ogokora enyangi yao. Aya inkobwatekana namachiko amayia ayio abwatokirwe na abisi yomonene bwerichik

english: The government has been very concerned about the current situation and how it affects people's lives. This is because there are many challenges facing our communities and families due to the severe effects which concern those leaders who have come together to help families with the severe effects of AG.
ekegusii: Eserikali nero bono egochia gokonachera buna indi ogokora enyangi yao. Aya inkobwatekana namachiko amayia ayio abwatokirwe na abisi yomonene bwerichiko gochia ase baria baganeti gochia konywomana goetera ase abisi yomonene bwerichiko gose AG

english: The leader of those families, Winnie Guchu, said that people should unite, and they will be helped to overcome the difficulties, and they will be given support to help those families overcome the internet.
ekegusii: Omoriki omokonyi ase abisi eyio Winnie Guchu, nigo atebire buna baria baraganie konywomana, nigo baraganerigwe gotoka amauko gochia ase eyio goetera omotandao

english: They say those families are trying to find solutions to the problems, and two visitors were arrested for spreading rumors.
ekegusii: Nigo abisi eyio erachi kobeka ensemo amatuko yogokora chinyangi, ase abageni 2 boka nabanyanyangi barancherwe goikerana

english: They say those families are solving problem 2 and its causes, and Guchu said she will provide medicine to prevent the spread of coronavirus.
ekegusii: Nigo abisi eyio erakore chinyangi 2 chioka ase rituko, ase Guchu atebire nenchera eyemo yogotanga ebinyinyi bia corona

english: And people have come together to solve their problems and aid others, and 15 people were arrested for spreading rumors, and this news spread quickly within 45 days.
ekegusii: Na baria baganeti gochia gokora enyanyi yabo ase aigoir, nigo abanto 15 boka barancherwe goikerana, nomoyega oyio koira chidageka 45 chioka

ekegusii: Longer sentences, up to 1500 words

english: The ritual of traditional dances is performed with small bells attached, which make a sound when they move together. These bells are made by blacksmiths and dancers themselves.
ekegusii: Omogano igora ya ogokonya ebirerwa bieching'iti chikoretwa ase enasari ye chitangana. Ebirerwa ebio nigo bikorerwa nomonto obene na abakonyi bande.

english: Buses and similar vehicles are regularly inspected for safety. They are inspected for safety, and also their condition is checked thoroughly.
ekegusii: Ekebusi amo ne'sese nigo bikorigereria korwa etirisa. Bikorigerei korwa etirisa, nario erio biaroche ekegwankwa.

english: Aaria Nyamache, Bobasi within Kisii County, a very sad incident. The old man and his wife, they say he took his child and went, truly speaking, he went with his children to bury them because the pain of those people was too much, they said he went to join them in death. Abraham Moseti and Alice Okemwa were married in Nairobi, they planned and decided to have a child.
ekegusii: Aaria Nyamache, Bobasi ime ya Kisii County, obokongu mbwabete. Omosacha oyomo nigo aitete omwana na mokaye, nere gweeita ase eng'encho abaibori b' omokungu bakanete buna enywomo gati ya aba baere tekoba ase eng'encho bare ab' enyomba eyemo. Abrahama Moseti amo n' Alice Okemwa nigo baumeranete aaria Nairobi, bakamenya aamo n' konyora omwana oyomo.

english: Truly this matter, the people went to seek help from their relatives, the relatives tried to stop him, but it was difficult to prevent those people from dying together. It is reported that Abraham Moseti fell ill and destroyed his house.
ekegusii: Bono ekero aba bagenda sobo omokungu erinde komanya abaibori ba mokaye, abaibori bakabatebia buna nigo ere chimuma ase aba babere konywomana ekiagera nigo bare ab' enyomba eyemo. Gotebigwa iga, Abraham Moseti akaigwa obororo kegima na gosamba enyomba yaye.

english: The child is the one who survived all of this. After this, the wife, Alice Okemwa went to Kenyatta National Hospital, where she received treatment and recovered. The old man also got sick, and he was treated and recovered. According to Ekegusii tradition, grandfathers and grandmothers do not agree, which leads to the deaths of their grandchildren.
ekegusii: Omwana ere nigo asirerete abwo abo. Korwa abwo, mokaye, omosubati Alice Okemwa nere agasirera aaria Kenyatta National Hospital, abwo ase aminyogetigwe gochia kobwenigwa. Omosacha oyo ere nigo akwerete nchera, gakominyokigwa gochia ase enyagitari kobwenigwa. Kobwatekana n' Ekegusii, Omometobo amo n' Omokiama tibari konywomerana, ekigera aba n' abana bare ab' enyomba eyemo.

english: Indeed, this story about baptism is important because it reminds us of the importance of repentance for all people. These scriptures also remind us of the significance of John the Baptist's ministry and the baptism of Jesus which was performed by John the baptizer. Christmas arrives quickly, and it is a time when the church gathers together, and Christians from the church gather and remember the baptism of Jesus performed by John the baptizer near the Jordan River and on January 6th each year, so why do they celebrate remembering this event and its meaning for their salvation? These scriptures are done in remembrance of this event, and this remembrance is important for our Christianity.
ekegusii: Ninde n'ekeene ng'a obomaene nigo bore bw'engencho kobua ebirengererio bi'abanto. Ebitabu biaito nigo bire bi'eritang'ani n'ebiekeene ase chingaki echi na bigokwana igoro yobobisi bore ime y'ebatiso y'Yeso eyio yakoretwe na Yohana omobatisi. Ekerisimasi tikiarenge aroro ase chikarne ibere chi'kanisa entang'ani korende Abakeristo b'ekanisa entang'ani amo n'aborokigwa ba Yeso, nigo bare koinyora rituko ri'abatiso y' Yeso yakoretwe na Yohana omobatisi aaria ase oroche rwa Jorodani ase omotienyi o Januari chitariki 6 ase kera omwaka, ninki kiagerete bakarikora rituko eri koba eriengencho mono ase okwegena kwabo? Ebitabu biaito nigo bikorwa obomaene ase riborio eri, n'obomaene nigo bore bw'engencho ase obokeristo bwaito mono.

english: Patrick Mayoyo says in Nation that he has investigated how people from Omogusii live, saying this issue has been bothering him because of the suffering people undergo when they experience problems. They say the things they see, people and their families have been wronged and harmed greatly. It is said there is a lot of injustice happening. People are being called to areas of Bosongo, Gucha and Nyamira. This matter of people investigating and the courts making decisions about people's lives has caused people to feel like they are being oppressed. Welcome people and children who are being called to the land of Gusii. The people of Bosongo are not able to travel to seek help so they believe this is witchcraft. The Kenya National Commission on Human Rights says people are being mistreated and subjected to torture. During this year, five people were killed and buried in a place called Kanunda in Bomwanda within the district of Bosongo. Those involved are said to be Boyani Gichana, Yobensia Ongubo, Christoper Ongubo, Sandimu Mageto and Chietunde Agirio, their leader Nyaboe and others also participated.
ekegusii: Patrick Mayoyo bwe e Nation nigo agoteba inga onye kore Omogusii, egento ekebe kerakobere ne ekero omonto onde aratebe inga aye no omorogi gose omokori ebinto ebibe buna oboibi. Ase ebitageka ebike, abanto bare na obororo nigo bagokogwera amo ne ebioma bia kera aina. Tibari kogotiga impaka gwakure. Abanto nigo bakare goitwa ase obonge aaria Bosongo, Gucha amo na Nyamira. Bono abanene be chikanisa amo na ebiombe biria bikorenda obogima bwa abanto nigo batagete bari bagoita abande batigigwe. Karibu abanto batano na omo nigo bagoitwa kera omotienyi ime ya Gusii. Abagusii bari bare echera aaria Bosongo tibatageti kogenda chinka ekiagera nigo baoboete inga imbache baitwe bakogenda chinka.Ekeombe keria getenenerete obogima bwa abanto Kenya (KNCHR) nigo kegoteba inga abanto nigo bagoitwa batarairwa ekoti erinde banyorwe na amagoso. Omotienyi okabere omwaka oyo, abanto batano imbaitwa na gosambwa aaria omochie o Kanunda ime ya Bomwanda ase e distrikti ya Bosongo. Bari baitetwe nigo bare korokwa Boyani Gichana, Yobensia Ongubo, Christoper Ongubo, Sandimu Mageto amo na Chietunde Agirio, omoiri obo, omosubati Nyaboe nabo ateba.

english: South Mugirango MP, Hon Manson Nyamweya has invited people from Kisii County to his home, intending to raise about 300,000 shillings to spend on the Referendum. Hon Nyamweya is said to be planning to contribute money himself, but supporters from the Coalition for Reforms and Democracy (Cord) say they will also participate in the fundraising for the Referendum.

english: The leader of CORD, Kitutu Chache South MP, Hon Richard Onyonka has expressed concern and stated that the fundraising for the Referendum needs transparency, for the sake of Kenyan citizens. Hon Onyonka, along with Bomachoge Chache MP, Hon Simon Ogari have participated in discussions regarding Okoa Kenya, which supports the initiative of Hon Nyamweya.

Mhe Onyonka, amo na Bomachoge Chache MP, Mhe Simon Ogari mbachieti ase omosangererekano bw' Okoa Kenya, oyio orenge inse y' oborai bw' Mhe Nyamweya.

english: Kenyan citizens should understand the importance of the Referendum. They shouldn't be forced to contribute," added Hon Nyamweya. english: The people are saying that the government is delaying the investigation of these matters and they are being frustrated and angered. It is said that they have written about these matters as they should be done. The lawyer for the family of Nyaruri, Mr. Andrew Mandi, has been served with documents related to this case and he has been asked to respond. The investigator investigating these matters, Robert Natwoli, has been summoned to explain why he was not present. There is strong evidence suggesting that Francis Nyaruri's time has come as it should be. Many people are now worried about the consequences of all this. Furthermore, there are those who are very eager to cooperate with the family of Francis Nyaruri.

Omosigari omotuki bwa amangana aya, Robert Natwoli nere otebigwe atige obotuki obo ataraitwa. Onde bwensi otagete koboria igoro ya Francis Nyaruri nigo akoonywa inga ingoitwa are. Obosoku sana ase ogotachera amachiko ye ense yaito inse. Naende, nigo ere bobe sana ase ogotarorera eamate na omochie o Francis Nyaruri amabera.

english: In 2008, the award from The Committee to Protect Journalists was given to the late journalist, Hon. Mwai Kibaki. It was reported that Hon. Kibaki supported the investigation of the murder of journalists. And the truth will eventually emerge regarding the circumstances surrounding the death of Nyaruri. Let us wait and see. Also, the award from The Committee to Protect Journalists was given to Hon. PM Raila Odinga. It was stated that PM Raila supported and repeated that those who committed crimes against journalist Francis Nyaruri would be held accountable under Kenyan law. We urge the family of Francis Nyaruri to be comforted.

Kibaki arigererie amangana ya ogoitwa kwa abariki ba amangaseti. Naende imbaboretie arore inga obotuki bwo ogoitwa kwa Nyaruri kwabeire. Kende tikiana koba. Ase bono iga, ekeombe eke kia The Committee to Protect Journalists kiarikire rirube gochia ase Mhe. PM Raila Odinga. Nigo gekoboria PM Raila arigererie na korora inga bari bakorete amabe ase omosike Francis Nyaruri bagambigwe kobwatekana na amachiko aito Kenya. Nigo twensi togosaba omochie o Francis Nyaruri ororerwe amabera.

english: The committee worked well, yes! This field and the bananas have been harvested. Oh, oh! It seems those who harvest also harvest the husks. He started digging, working with large hoes until he found the child. Then Matacho became tired and began singing a song.
ekegusii: Simbiri agaaka ng'a, po! Akabuga ng'a ne ritoke anacha. Obe, obe! Kumbe n' omoisia oye anacha ebigoti. Akang'ea goichana, gakorera n'ebirero ebinge kagoteba buna aitire omwana oye. Abwo Matacho akaboka na kobugia esirimbi.

english: The ceremony at the home of Iruma ended going to Matacho and digging with the tools. In that time, the families rejoiced greatly, at the home of Iruma.

english: Furthermore, Ombachi mentioned that MCAs deserve at least 30 percent of the resources allocated to county services to enable them to implement development agendas for the people.

english: Five people have been confirmed to have contracted the coronavirus disease in Nyamira county, bringing the total number of infected people to 379 who have so far been tested positive and discharged after being confirmed to have contracted the disease, while a total of 7,050 people have been screened and the total number of people infected with the disease across Kenya now stands at 10,105.

english: The number of people who have been confirmed to have contracted the disease in Nairobi county is leading with 209 cases followed by Kiambu with 49 cases, Busia with 38 cases, Migori with 19 cases, Mombasa with 16 cases, Kajiado with 12 cases, Uasin Gishu with 8 cases, Lamu with 6 cases, Machakos and Nakuru counties each recorded 5 cases respectively, Wajir, Narok and Kisumu each had 2 cases respectively, while Nyamira, Isiolo, Kericho, Nyeri, and Trans Nzoia counties each recorded one case respectively.

english: However, another 49 people have recovered after undergoing treatment, bringing the total number of those who have recovered to 185 people who have been discharged from hospitals across Kenya.

Kenyatta National Hospital (KNH) is reporting that over 1,000 patients are diagnosed annually, with approximately 1,000 more awaiting access to treatment.
ekegusii: Oborwaire bwa kansa nekansa borobwo obonyene ase Kenya yaito ekiagera onde taiyio nonya neserekari ogwechandera oboringoria obwo gose gokonya baria batari kwenyara. ekegusii: Omorai omonene bwense ya France omosike Francois Hollande nigo atebire buna tegeneti gose onde naatorigwe korwa ase endege eyio.

english: There were 148 passengers on the plane," Hollande said. "This is a tragedy, a terrible shock, and we must find out what happened.
ekegusii: “Abayerinete nigo barenge 148 endege ime,” Hollande okomenta. “okororokana kwa omobosokano oyio, nigo ogotokora korengia ng’a onde tatigareti orabe moyo.”

english: French authorities say 142 of those on board were passengers, including five children, and six crew members.
ekegusii: Ebitaseni bia oboraria bia France nigo biateba buna 142 nigo barenge abasombwa ko batano nomo nigo bare abakori emeremo and six crew on board.

english: Hollande also said the victims included Germans and Spaniards who were flying from Barcelona to Düsseldorf.
ekegusii: Hollande boigo nigo atebire buna ekororokana abanto korwa Germans nabwo barinete abange korwa Barcelona kogenda Duesseldorf.

english: He added that the cause of the crash was still unknown.
ekegusii: Nigo amentire goteba buna ase endege eyio yagwera tari goikereka bwango’

english: A spokesman for the French civil aviation authority DGAC said the plane took off from Barcelona at around 10:55 am and crashed near the town of Barcelonnette, about 65 miles (100 km) inland from the French Riviera coast near Nice.
ekegusii: Omonogeri bw’ ekeombe gia France DGAC aviation authority nigo aenekia buna endege eyio nigo yaatekera omochie omonene o Barcelonnette ang’e chimaeli emerongo etano nomo na etano (65 Miles) 100 km irianyi ya omochie o French Riviera okorokwa o Nice.

english: Local residents reported hearing explosions and the wreckage of the plane was found near Meolans-Revel, a small village in the French Alps.
ekegusii: Abatuki korwa ense ya france bakoringoria emebasokano nigo bachiire Meolans-Revel, ekenyoro getamenyiri na banto bange ase ebitunwa bia French Alps.

english: The plane's black boxes have been recovered.
ekegusii: Abanyene endege nabarabwo baenekirie omwateko oyio.

english: The aircraft, an A320, was 24 years old and had been operated by the Lufthansa group since 1991, according to information available on the website airfleets.net.
ekegusii: Endege eye yaateka ya A320 nigo yarenge emiaka emerongo ebere na ene na nigo yabeire ase abaonchoreria ba Lufthansa group korwa 1991, koreng’ana na amang’ana agachire ase chibuku chia eneti; airfleets.net

english: Relatives we are saddened by the death of our sister Esther Gesare Nduko Nyagwachi. After a period of illness she passed away on July 14th, 2014, while at Kenyatta National Hospital, Nairobi. She originally came from Bomanono Village, Bonyunyu, Nyamira County.
ekegusii: Abaminto twatebiigwe amang'ana amakongu igoro yo ogosira kwo omongina Esther Gesare Nduko Nyagwachi. Magega yo okorwara ase amatuko amange, omongina Gesare nigo asira chitariki 14 Enkoromoni [ July ] 2014, aaria Kenyatta National Hospital, Nairobi. Enka nigo ere aaria Bomanono Village, Bonyunyu, Nyamira County.

english: Child: Mother Esther Gesare had a son named Joseph Mbera and a daughter named Banchiri Mbera.
ekegusii: Omwana: Mama Esther Gesare nigo are omwana bw' omogaka Joseph Mbera amo n' omongina Banchiri Mbera.

english: Daughter: Esther was the wife of teacher Josiah Nyagwanchi Onchoke.
ekegusii: Omwanchwa: Esther was a wife of Mwalimu Josiah Nyagwanchi Onchoke.

english: Mother: She was a mother to Delilah Moraaa, Alice Kemunto, Milka Kwamboka, Geofrey Nduko, Martha Kerubo, Joyce Banchiri, Josepth Sitara, and Dennis Onchoke.
ekegusii: Mama: She was mother to Delilah Moraaa, Alice Kemunto, Milka Kwamboka, Geofrey Nduko, Martha Kerubo, Joyce Banchiri, Josepth Sitara, amo na Dennis Onchoke.

english: Grandchild: Mother Gesare has grandchildren including David Mbera, Grace Moraa, Henry Nyabuto, James Magare, and Pamela Mbera.
ekegusii: Omwana Ominto: Omongina Geasre nigo are moiseke omwabo gochia ase David Mbera, Grace Moraa, Henry Nyabuto, James Magare, amo na Pamela Mbera.

english: Burial arrangements: The main fundraiser will be held on 21/07/2014 at Garden Square, Nairobi, in order to cover medical and transport costs. Burial will take place on 25/07/2014 at Bomanono Village, Bonyunyu, West Mugirango, Nyamira County.
ekegusii: Burial arrangements: The main fundraising will be held on 21/07/2014 at Garden Square, Nairobi, in order to offset medical and transportation charges. Burial will take place on 25/07/2014 at Bomanono Village, Bonyunyu, West Mugirango, Nyamira County.

english: Our deepest condolences to relatives of Esther Gesare Nduko for the loss of your beloved one.
ekegusii: Pole sana gochia ase abamwabo Esther Gesare Nduko for the loss of your loved one.

english: uprooting of boundaries disputes
ekegusii: torwanie amaru atancheiri

english: Written by Hyline Major on February 25, 2022
ekegusii: Written by Hyline Major on February 25, 2022

english: People who trespass on boundaries should be careful so that boundary disputes do not arise.
ekegusii: Abaengi amarwa bagendereire komochigwa ase okogenderera koenga amarwa atancheirie bobisi.

english: The incident happened in Keera location which is in Nyamaiya Nyamira South subcounty of Nyamira county, Senior Chief Oire has ordered investigations into the matter of Nyaisa land which involves people trespassing on boundaries.
ekegusii: Omogambi bwelocation ya Keera eyio egotoka Nyamaiya Nyamira South ekaonty ya Nyamira, Senior Chief Oire nigo anene aragire ekiara ekenyoro kia Nyaisa ekio abeire ogosagana abaengi amarwa.

english: He also said that Oire instructed that the committee investigating boundary disputes should quickly finish its work so that people can farm peacefully and without conflicts.
ekegusii: Nonya nabo nigo Oire atebire buna esegi yokorwania amarwa ero goika egenderere goika asirire erio abanto goonchoreria na koirana mogondo gokora oboremi

english: Oire further stated that they will help those whose boundaries have been interfered with to ensure they get their land back.
ekegusii: Oire nigo aereire emechando bagoetera ase esegi yokorwania amarwa ase asororire abanto kogenda mogondo erio koenyoera ribaga riamarwa.

english: Are you looking for stories?
ekegusii: Ning’o orobare goika ikomi?

english: Are you wondering how stories can help children learn and grow?
ekegusii: Ning’o orabe omoruoti bweching’iti chiorosana maega yeechui korwa oboruoti?

english: Grandma's Bananas
ekegusii: Amatoke A’Baba

english: The little girl is curious as she watches her grandmother preparing to ripen bananas. Where grandmother stores the bananas to ripen remains a top secret to the disappointment of her grandchild. But how long will it take before the grandchild discovers grandmother’s secret?
ekegusii: The little girl is curious as she watches her grandma preparing to ripen bananas. Where grandma stores the bananas to ripen remains top secret to the disappointment of her grandchild. But how long does it take before the grandchild discovers grandma’s secret?

english: Ekebusi and Esese and the Mirror
ekegusii: Ekebusi, Esese amo ne’ekegwankwa

english: Ekebusi and Esese went to look at themselves in the mirror. They looked at themselves in the mirror, and suddenly a beautiful image appeared.
ekegusii: Ekebusi amo ne’sese nigo bikorigereria korwa etirisa. Bikorigerei korwa etirisa, nario erio biaroche ekegwankwa.

english: The Clever Rabbit
ekegusii: Omonto omotambe mono

english: This rabbit was very clever. This rabbit always thought about how to trick others and how to get what he wanted. This rabbit often used his cunning to deceive people and make them do things they didn’t want to do.
ekegusii: Omonto oyo ore ase omogano oyo nigoare omontambe mono na ase igo keregento nigokere ekieng’e na egeke asare. Omonto oyo nigo agotatora obokong’u goetera ase okoreng’ania ebinto bionsi bimoreng’ane.

english: Selemeng’s Pots
ekegusii: Ebibusi bia Selemeng’

english: Selemeng’ had many pots. How many pots did Selemeng’ have?
ekegusii: Selemeng’ nigo abwate ebibusi ebinge. Ebibusi birenga Selemeng’ abwate?

english: The Story of the Little Bird
ekegusii: Kobara chinyang’au chiorosana

english: The bird flew around looking for a place to build its nest near the water.
ekegusii: Chinyang’au nigo chire nerang’o aseigo chibare buna chigochia konywa amache.

english: Ekebusi and Esese and Erangi
ekegusii: Ekebusi amo ne’Esese amo nogoaka Erangi

english: Ekebusi and Esese were friends. They found something and started doing everything together.
ekegusii: Ekebusi ne’Esese nigo bire abasani. Nigo bibwate echeche nainde bikogoka gokora ebinto bionsi amo.

english: The US military operation targeting a senior Al-Shabaab commander, Adan Garar, has been confirmed, according to sources. The Pentagon's operation reportedly involved an airstrike that successfully eliminated Garar in a remote area of southern Somalia.
ekegusii: Ensemo y’oborendi ya ense ya Amerika yaenekirie ogoitwa kwa omorai bw’ ekeombe kia alshaabab omosike, Adan Garar. Korwa ensemo ya Pentagon nigo amang’ana atoikera buna endege y’ esegi etarigotwara omogendia nigo yamobutoria chokombora aaria Irianyi ya Somalia echuma yaeta eria tano.

english: |Those who were radicalized and recruited alongside Garar within Al-Shabaab|
ekegusii: |ababegu aba baminyokirigwe na goserigwa ase chinkonko chinyinge ase ense ya Somalia|

english: Garar was allegedly identified as being involved in the 2013 attack on the Westgate shopping mall, which resulted in the deaths of at least sixty people.
ekegusii: Garar nigo arenge omokagerwa ase omwaka chilibu ibere na ngwansa ikomi na isato (2013) ase echiro ya oboonchoreria ya Westgate obwo bwairereta abanto emerongo etano nomo na batano na babere gosiria amagima abo.

english: The United States accuses Garar of planning attacks and recruiting individuals for terrorist activities. He is also accused of being a key facilitator for the group, responsible for coordinating operations and providing support, according to information from the Pentagon.
ekegusii: Amerika nigo yegenete Garaar buna nigo arenge korigereria buna barakore obosagani na goita abanto be chinse chia bosongo. Nigo arenge omobwatani bw’ ekeombe ekio ase abwate ekerogo gio’koringoria buna inaki obogima bwabo bogosereirie kobwa mono n’ chinguru cha isiko koreng’ana na Pentagon.

english: This incident occurred approximately 240 kilometers south of Mogadishu near the town of Dinsoor.
ekegusii: Aya onsi nigo akorekana ang’e chimaeli rigana n’emerongo etano gose (240 KM) bosongo ya Mogadishu ang’e n’omochie omonene Dinsoor.

english: Washington has provided assistance to the African Union forces (AU force) working to combat Al-Shabaab militants in Somalia.
ekegusii: Washington yabeire gekobwatesia obomo bw’ cinse chia Afrika (AU force), obwo bwarusirie ebiombe ao ao bi’ obobegu korwa ase ense ya Somalia.

english: The US military operation aims to disrupt Garar's network and further weaken Al-Shabaab's presence in Somalia.
ekegusii: Ensemo y’ oborendi ya Amerika nigo yateba buna ogokwa kwa Garar’ nokwengencho enene kobua buna kwaretige eriansa rinene ase ekeombe ekio kia ababegu ba alshaabab aaria Somalia.

english: Pentagon officials have indicated that ongoing operations against Al-Shabaab are intended to prevent future attacks against civilians in areas such as Sugusu-mocha in Kenya.
ekegusii: Ekero egeke magega ya Pentagon koyaenekia ayio, ogosagaana gwakorwa n’ekeombe ekio kia al-Shabab nigo kwairera ogokwa kwa abanto banne aaria sugusu-mocha ya Kenya.

english: Militants linked to the attack in Kenya reportedly originated from training camps supported by the African Union mission and the Somali government.
ekegusii: Ababegu aba batianire gochanda Kenya gotatimoka ase engencho y’okoba na obomo bwe chinse chia afrika ase oborendi bogendererete ase orogongo rwa Somalia.

english: Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. February 22, 2011.
ekegusii: Na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Monunguno O Barema (February) 22, 2011.

english: The hyena's riddle
ekegusii: Kobanga chinkomoro

english: Is there anyone who knows the proverbs of Ekegusii well? Yes indeed. It is a difficult riddle. Therefore, let us examine this riddle carefully so that those who know it can explain it clearly:
ekegusii: Nomanyete similes buna chikorokwa ase Ekegusii? Eee bono. Nigo chikorokwa chinkomoro. Rero tiga torakwana ingo igoro ye chinkomoro ibere na amo ne emebayeno ebere:

english: HYENA:
ekegusii: CHINKOMORO:

english: 1.It chases gazelles even when they have already fallen. What does this mean? It means that a greedy person always seeks more possessions even when he has enough. This is why people say that a person who is constantly looking for things will never be satisfied.
ekegusii: 1.Kora emerondo buna eye ekeguye. Yaani nigo andama bono? Engecho ende omonto obwate amagoro amanyerere mono. Aya nigo agotumeka ekero okorama oyonde gose abande bateba ekenyamerondo.

english: 2.A coward runs away. People say that if a coward is wounded while running, he will stumble, fall, and become helpless. These sayings are used to describe a person who is afraid and unable to defend himself.
ekegusii: 2.Omwororo buna riruma. Abaminto nonya korwa emuma ime riruma nigo rigotebekana rire riororo, riitongo, ndibwati mangana. Bono amangana aya nigo agotumeka ekero ogokwana igoro yo omonto omoitongo gose omwororo.

english: LESSONS:
ekegusii: EMEBAYENO:

english: 1.Don't speak ill of someone while they are still alive. Our ancestors said this. Don't try to destroy someone's reputation while they are still around. Because a person may recover from illness and then punish those who spoke badly about them while they were sick and vulnerable.
ekegusii: 1.Moeta mono onyora mara are iiga. Bakoro mbaroche aya onsi. Kona goeta kera ase nabo gokorenta chindwari chinyinge. Kera omonto nigo agokurerwa aya tiga obonyaka gose tagotwara abasani abange mogosanga kemobere ekiagera korakore obonyaka mara are iiga nakonyora endwari.

english: 2.We don't quarrel over cattle, we don't quarrel over people. Our ancestors also said that people should not fight over material possessions because they are temporary, and instead focus on building good relationships and maintaining peace among themselves.
ekegusii: 2.Tuga ntakana a ngombe, totuga ntakana a monto. Nabo orakonye omonto korwa emechando ime magega yaye nonya mbuya mono tagotebia, naende agokorere ogochaya na takoa esiko eria kwamokonyete ekero achandegete.

english: radio news reporter about the Keroka incident
ekegusii: radio vuna gotarera abaonchoreria bechiro ya keroka

english: Written by Hyline Major on February 24, 2022
ekegusii: Written by Hyline Major on February 24, 2022

english: Concerning Radio Vuna news, it has been reported that an incident at Keroka occurred yesterday causing great concern among people.
ekegusii: Egetaseni kia Radio Vuna nigo kebegete ekambi ase echiro ya Keroka erio gosanga nabaonchoreria eyemo ase eyemo.

english: The Keroka incident reports have spread widely causing anxiety and fear among residents because of the ongoing issues.
ekegusii: Abaonchoreria bechiro eyio nigo banyora ribaga riokoerera ebirengererio biabo gochia ase abateneneri erio koenekia amagenderero.

english: Speaking to our correspondent from Nyamira county, people said they have received information regarding what happened and are seeking clarification about the matter.
ekegusii: Kobwaterana neserekali yekaonty ya Nyamira, abanto mbanyora amaegerio igoro yobuya bwokorwa ebango na boigo koenekia obochenu ase echiiro

english: Radio Vuna listeners have expressed their sadness and disappointment over this issue.
ekegusii: Amashabiki a radio vuna nabarabwo nigo benyorera ribaga riabene ase omosangererekano oyio

english: These are their words:
ekegusii: aya amwabo aya:

english: The Gusii people talk a lot and boast, and they say things like “A home without children is incomplete.” What does this mean? It means people say this: When someone visits God and finds favor, that person Kebiro also receives blessings and says, “Wow! But how can I express my gratitude… I am grateful!”
ekegusii: Abagusii mbatebete buna ogochaya n' okobe, na gototebia buna "Ey' etari na kemincha, tiga etirerie ekeene" Bono igo naki? Nigo sokoro ominto agoteba iga: Riria omogaka Onduso aimokire gokwana iga, omogaka Kebiro nigo akoimoka korwa ensemo na goteba buna, "Kai! Naye ninki obwate ogototebia...... Motebie aikaranse

english: Times and seasons pass. These days there are no children, so it seems incomplete. The visitors find themselves going around looking for news. Picture and special correspondent, Gusii.com files.
ekegusii: Amasikani n' egento ekiya. Eeeri eyio netaba n' ekemincha, nigo egotireria ekeene. Abagaka baimokire kogenda aase etureti kogayana. Picture na special correspondent, Gusii.com files.

english: This person Onduso did not receive favor, he was rejected. He was despised and hated, unfortunately. And now he understands that he should have listened to his relatives who were seeking news. It is regrettable that this matter has become widespread, so everyone knows about it, even those who are seated.
ekegusii: Bono omogaka Onduso ere tatakeiri gokwana, gose koigweka. Oikaransigwa na gokanigwa, taakwana. Ere nigo amanyire buna tabwati kende aratebie abamwabo aase etureti yaikaransire. Nigo okonyora buna ekero gie etureti, abanto bonsi nigo bagoikerana, mbaka bari bachaire.

english: When someone receives favor, people wonder what makes them special. Because of jealousy, people complain, they lament that the portion of food they eat is small, and they say it is not enough for life [it seems incomplete].
ekegusii: Ori ochaire ekero akoimoka gokwana, abanto bachaka kweonya buna nere ninki arakwane. Korende magega yaye, abanto bagochia goitona, baanyora buna eng'ana y' oria bachaete, nigo yare ey' eng'encho kegima [ etirerie ekeene ].

english: Now let us look at old stories that are worth remembering. Let our elders tell us about the reporters [who lack understanding], now let them speak the truth, so that those who listen understand. Boastful behavior has made the older Gusii people say “A home without children is incomplete.” That is the news for this week. Blessings to the visitor and thank you for listening.
ekegusii: Nere buya ebirengererio bia kera oyomo biategererwa. Neba mbari bakageire koba abariri [ batabwati ekemincha ], nere buya baegwa chingaki, bakwana aya babwate. Ogochaya buna oko nakwo kwagerete Abagusii abakoro bagateba buna "Ey' etari na kemincha, tiga etirerie ekeene". Oyo noro omobayeno oito for this week. Korwa ase omogaka sokoro ominto, mbuya mono and thank you for listening.

english: The chairperson of the health committee in Nyamira County has called for a meeting of healthcare workers from across the county.
ekegusii: abaonchoreria bechiro ya magombo ime yekaunti ya nyamira kwemurunganeria obokoreri obobe korwa ase eserekali yekaunti eyio

english: The chairperson of the health committee in Nyamira County has invited healthcare workers from across the county to discuss issues affecting their work and the county government's role.
ekegusii: Abaonchoreria ase echiro ya magombo ekaunti ya Nyamira nigo bemurunganeirie obokoreri obobe korwa ase eserekali yekaunti eyio nonya bakorwa ebango

english: They have requested that those with grievances bring them forward, along with solutions, so that the county government can address the concerns of those working in healthcare and improve their services.
ekegusii: Nigo batebire buna mbabwati nonya nechinyomba chiakebara ,amache nonya bakorwa ebango, eserekali yekaunti eyio terabeka emeroberio yokoenekia buna ase bagokorera oboonchoreria bwabo nagiya are

english: Therefore, they have informed the governor of that county, Amos Nyaribo, about this issue and asked him to provide resources to help them resolve the problems facing them and enable them to continue serving the people effectively.
ekegusii: Bono nigo bamoboririe omogavana bwekaunti eyio Amos Nyaribo koenekia echiro eyio nebwate ebinto biengencho ase boigo baboririe babekerwe chitaya na amache erio banyare kogendereria emeremo yabo buya na korwa ebango buna ebwenerete

english: Behold, how beautiful and wonderful is the creation of God!
ekegusii: Enchiri yamache na omoika nero oboronge bwa Nyasae!

english: The people who live in darkness, let them receive light, and may their hearts be enlightened. Christians from all tribes, let them strive to understand, so they may know the true path, and all their deeds may be righteous. Understand the creation of God, which has shone forth in darkness.
ekegusii: Amang'ana are ime ase egetabu eke, naisanekie erng'ao ere ime ase enkoro yao. Abakristo abange b'amatuko aya, nigo bagendererete komenya, batamanyeti richibu ri'ekeene, ase ebibe biria bagokora kera rituko. Nomanyete oboronge bwa Nyasae, obwo boorokirie ime ase egetabu eke.

english: The creation of God, it is perfect like beauty and wonder. And you, together with others, according to the covenant of righteousness, it is made manifest through the eyes of the followers of faith, and a lasting foundation. Through this teaching, people may repent and believe in their own creation, leading to understanding the creation of God. And now, the perfection of Christianity does not diminish this teaching, but rather leads to understanding the glory of God.
ekegusii: Oboronge bwa Nyasae, bwabeire bokoba ne enchili yamache na omoika.s nonya nabo, koreng'ana n'enibo y'erigori, yabeire ekobiswa korwa ase amaiso y'ababwatani b'edini, ase chingaki chintambe. Ase engencho eyio, abanto abange bakaba bagosemeria na gwetogia ase oboronge bwabo abanyene, ribaga ri'okwegena oboronge bwa Nyasae. Ase igo, amorokererio y'obokristo atabwati engencho akaba okwegena koirete ribaga, ime ase chinkoro chi'abegeni orakage ng'a amorokererio aya, nabwate oboronge bwa Nyasae.

english: The perfection of offering things is manifested when God creates everything, becoming strong and enduring forever, and even the great perfection of Christianity is not limited, and is established within the covenant of believers. Therefore, Christians should seek to know God again, appreciate the glory of His creation, and strive to understand so they may be saved.
ekegusii: Amorokererio y'ogoteba ng'a ebinto nigo bikororekana koreng'ana buna Nyasae achorete omonyene, ogocheneka omonto akona konyora ng'ora ng'ora, ayio naro amorokererio amanene y'obokristo naro arentete obotantanu, na ogoiserwa ime ase chinkoro chi'abegeni. Korende bono, Abakristo abange mbagwenerete komanya Nyasae buya, beorokererie igoro y'oboronge bwaye, na kogenderera ase okwegena koria bare nobomaene.

english: “How excellent is the perfection of God’s creation!” Indeed, life itself, to understand deeply, and to share goodness with each other. The potter makes vessels, and he does not fail to make something useful to understand, the creation of God, even with him!
ekegusii: Omonene oito oy'okoba oboronge bwa Nyasae" Inakee, omoyo oo, okomanya okonene, na koyotang'ana gochia ase omorembe. Omoriki bw'egetabu eke, nigo atagete otware ogosesenia gw'okomanya, oboronge bwa Nyasae, kobe naye!

english: Was 1995 good while 2011 is? Welcome to Google Plus
ekegusii: Eye 1995 bono gose 2011? Karibuni to Google Plus

english: Those days people used to write letters a lot, you remember Usenet. For the young generation, those were times when using the internet was difficult. Good people would go to a phone booth to make calls. Forget about cellphones which are now common.
ekegusii: Ase baria mobwate chimbuche buna nche, you remember Usenet. For the young generation, eyio nigo yarenge buna esimi yo omorande ase eintaneti. Gose kogenda ase e call box goaka esimi. Aye forget about cellphones echi chia rero.

english: Usenet was like a newsgroup, which in today's language, is like a social media website. After that, there was Geocities. You weren't cool if you didn't have a Geocities account. It didn't take long. People got tired of Geocities and moved on to Myspace.
ekegusii: Usenet nigo yarenge e newsgroup, eyio in today's lingo, emineti social website. Korwa abwo, bagatoa Geocities. You were not hip onye tikwabwate e Geocities account. It did not take long. Abanto bakarosa na Geocities and moved on to Myspace.

english: The reign of Myspace didn't last long. It didn't take long for people to abandon Myspace and move to Facebook and Twitter which became popular on the internet. Hello? It is 2011. Friends welcome to the future. Welcome to Google Plus.
ekegusii: Erombe ya Myspace did not last long. Nigo kera omonto aagete Myspace etege gochia aaria ekero Facebook na Twitter chiaika ase erwenyi y' eintaneti. Hello? It is 2011. Bono abaminto karibuni to the future. Welcome to Google Plus.

english: People at Google say Google +, they claim this is the future. But even so, Google Plus is still being developed, and we don't know what will happen. They also claim that Google Plus is still in Beta testing. That means it's not yet finished. Honestly I don't know. However I have invitations to Google Plus. If you want one, please send an email to me whose address is below. And the subject line, please write: Google Plus. Have fun. Enjoy.

english: Long ago, Ogasusu and Mansamu knew each other well and had a good relationship with the people of Kiobegi. These people were known for their kindness and hospitality, always welcoming visitors. They also often found themselves in difficult situations, especially with their children, and they persevered through them all.
ekegusii: Abwo kare kare, Ogasusu na Mansamu mbamenyete mbarabare ne rinani ria Kiobegi. Bono aba babere nigo banchaine kerage na ituko rimo ndiare goeta batararorana. Aba nigo bare gosanga kera ekemo, nonya n' abana babo, nigo barenge gotiena aamo.

english: Ogasusu and Omasamu often shared food together.
ekegusii: Ogasusu n' Omasamu nigo barenge koenana ebisi

english: Continuing this story, there was a certain time when they both knew about a matter that concerned them. These people often shared food with the intention of resolving issues. However, despite this, Omansamu continued to bother Ogasusu’s children.
ekegusii: Korende engaki eyemo, enchara egaateka aiga ase bamenyete. Bono aba nigo bare koenana ebisi yo kogenda korigia endagera. Nonya nabo igo, Omansamu korende narenge n' obote bwo okoria abana bo Ogasusu.

english: The household of Ogasusu often went to resolve issues, and Omansamu would secretly cause trouble for them, harming Ogasusu’s children. In that situation, Omansamu called out to a young child and sent him on a journey along a dangerous path.
ekegusii: Ekero rituko ri' Ogasusu arenge kogenda korigia endagera riaigete, Omansamu akagoka konyora ribaga ria bene, aite abana b' Ogasusu inde abarie. Rituko erio, Omansamu agaita omwana oyomo na agatama akagenda ense eng'ao.

english: Ogasusu became angry because of this act.
ekegusii: Ogasusu oiranire na kende kia mboto

english: Ogasusu spent a long time thinking and worrying deeply. Despite this, they remained united, continuing to work towards peace. These two then decided to confront Omansamu about what he had done to his friend’s children.
ekegusii: Ogasusu akairana magoroba kare n' omoroso omonene. Nonya nabo igo, tairanete bosa, narenge nakende baregocha kobeka mboto. Bono Ogasusu agaichana ekero abana baye bamotebeti eki Omansamu akorerete oyomwabo.

english: In the end, Ogasusu was defeated and succumbed to the influence of Omansamu, becoming like an ordinary person. Ogasusu realized that he could no longer trust Omansamu anymore.
ekegusii: Koigwa iga, Ogasusu akagechigwa na goitona ase egekorwa kia Omansamu orenge omosani oye bwe enkoro. Ogasusu agatiana ng'a takwabera Omansamu neba ki.

english: Verah Mosubati is a researcher and consultant in education. She obtained and completed a bachelor's degree (research) in technology (Education/Information Technology of the Faculty of Education) from the University of Nairobi. Currently she works as a senior educational technologist. She has published several articles on technology and information science. From time to time she publishes books which are few but relevant and useful. They have also been nicknamed "a treasure trove".
ekegusii: Verah Mosubati bw’Omwocha n’omoriki egesora. Nigo asomete na goikerania edigirii engesi (riecheche) y’o bworokia (Egesongo/Obomanyi obosera bw’omonwa bw’egesongo) korwa Eyunibasiti ya Nairobi. Bono iga nao agokorere ase enyomba eyemo y’oboriki esagini eye. Nigo abwate obosemia oboagare ase chitana chio obworokia na obosamisi bw’ebitabu. Giokara bono iga osamisire ebitabu bitari bike abinde bire bi’emegano na ebinde ebi’ekeene. Nabo igo nanchete abana “kianda gia ikomi”.

english: The elders also respect work. They also fight for their rights. Regarding this matter, “Abe nguru ane” means that it encourages children to respect their parents, to care for their siblings, and to honor their mother and father.

english: What about this story, these words educate children. By educating children, these words protect the family and the community, and provide guidance. It is said that these words help someone find peace of mind and achieve their goals, encouraging them to live responsibly. Work with the community leaders, who share this message with everyone this week.

english: The people of Esuguku have decided on this date. Because it has been a year, they will celebrate Christmas on December 25th. Everything is being prepared well. Those who wish to go to church, take their offerings from home, so that everyone can go and worship. But this time, what does it mean to prepare for a good celebration?

english: Together with the teachings of the people of Esuguku, we share our greetings with our brothers and sisters during this season of celebrating the birth of Jesus. If someone forgets and thinks this celebration is just fun, let them not be afraid to learn more about it. And may you continue to work hard and strive for progress. Don't hesitate to help others, because those who give generously will also receive abundantly. Let us not forget humility, respect, and love for each other always.
ekegusii: Naintwe ase ekebute eke kia Mwanyagetinge, nigo tokobaganeria abasani baito mwensi pi amaiga amaya y' ogochengera okoiborwa kwa Yeso. Ka moranche iyora buna ekero ogochengera rituko eriiga, mbare batari kwenyara kobwatekana n' oboreu ao ao. Nabo oranyore n' obotaka gose omobere otaigweti buya. english: The incident of stones being thrown is said to have occurred at Cardinal Otunga High School Mosocho. This morning, the school was closed indefinitely following a student strike on Tuesday afternoon. The Headteacher of that school, Principal Zachary Nyariki, stated that the school was closed due to the chaos caused by the strike.
ekegusii: Chinyomba isato ch' oboraro nigo chiayiete na koba obonyinyo aaria Cardinal Otunga High School Mosocho. Omorero oyio orenge ekebemberia nigo obete ase rituko ria Tichi kabere botuko amo na igoro Tichi Gatato. Omwoorokia Omonene bw' esukuru eyio, Principal Zachary Nyariki nigo atebete buna esukuru eyio yasiekirwe, kobwatekana n' omobasokano oyio bw' omorero.

english: Students who spoke did not know the cause of the strike but said they found themselves running away from the school, fearing harm. “It is regrettable that this incident happened, because now students will not be able to continue with their studies, and it will delay their education” Also Principal Nyariki stated.
ekegusii: Abaorokigwa baria konyora bataramanya igoro y' omorero oyo naende barenge koirana gocha ase esukuru eyio, nigo bairanete gochia ase chinka chiabo. "Nigo togokagera buna chinyomba echi nigo chiasambetwe, korende ntwe nigo totagete abanyanyimbo bakore obotuko bwabo, erinde gototebia ekeene" Nabo Principal Nyariki atebete.

english: The school which was founded by Catholics, can accommodate 1100 students. Out of those students, 250 are boarders.
ekegusii: Esukuru eyio yachagetwe amo na Abakatholiki, nigo ebwate abaorokigwa goetania 1100. Gati ya abaorokigwa abwo, 250 bono mbabwati oboraro.

english: This first incident happened during the Tichi Kabere holiday when the students were gathering in the field, and were addressed by the Principal. Yesterday afternoon, it was reported that the students who had attended that meeting, woke up angry and started causing trouble.
ekegusii: Chinyomba ibere nigo chiasambwa ase rituko ria Tichi Kabere morogoba ekero abana b' esukuru eyio basangererekanete ase ebaredi, gotebigwa amatangaso amo n' Principal. Enyomba y' gatato nigo yayiete igoro mogaso, ekero abanyanyimbo baria barendete enkore eyio, barwete aroro na kogenda korigia ganto babeke mboto.

english: Today’s meeting of Cardinal Otunga has been postponed until further notice, so that investigations can be carried out. Kisii Central Division Criminal Investigation Officer, Paul Wambugu and Marani OCPD Benjamin Kimwale visited the school and promised to investigate the matter thoroughly, and arrest those involved.
ekegusii: Enyomba yende y' Cardinal Otunga nigo yayiete omwaka oyo oera, korende obotuki tibwanya gochia aande. Kisii Central Division Criminal Investigation Officer, Paul Wambugu amo na Marani OCPD Benjamin Kimwale mbatarerete esukuru eyio na koria chiira buna obotuki boikeranete, mboche bokorwe.

english: Here are the words:

english: Those who dwell near are those of Tabaka.
ekegusii: Amandegere ande nao are aaria Tabaka.

english: They respect Abageka. Indeed, do people of Gusii know the history of the prophets in the clan of prophets? Very true. It is said that many prophets from the Gusii region were descended from the lineage of Abageka.
ekegusii: Timochiesera Abageka. Inee, nomanyete buna Abagusii intwabwate enyomba ya ababani gose e clan of prophets? Eee bono. Nigo egotebekana inga ababani bonsi pi ase Gusii engima nigo bare korwa ase enyomba ya a Abageka.

english: In addition, it is reported that Prophet Sakawa and Prophet Ombati Omonyamorero originated from the lineage of Abageka which is located in Kitutu Chache.
ekegusii: Ase boigo, nigo sokoro antebetie inga Omobani (Prophet) Sakawa amo no omobani Ombati Omonyamorero nigo barwete ase enyomba ya Abageka eyio egotoka aaria Kitutu Chache.

english: Very true.
ekegusii: Manya bono.

english: Prophet Sakawa once dreamed a dream about his followers and they went to consult with the Basongo and also to visit the town of Getembe (Kisii Town). Because of this, people say that Sakawa foresaw everything he did.
ekegusii: Omobani Sakawa ere nachiete nguma ase obobani bwaye ekero abanete igoro yo ogocha kwa Abasongo amo no okoagachwa kwo omochie o Getembe (Kisii Town). Korende onde taiyo oragotebie buna Sakawa asirete gose ase achiete.

english: It is said that the events that happened after Sakawa involved witchcraft and sorcery, which came to pass. Therefore, his enemies plotted against him, and some used poison, others used spears, those who dwelt nearby conspired against him, and his head was displayed where he had acted.
ekegusii: Nigo egotebekana buna emambia eyemo nyuma ya Sakawa gotwara omoyega bwo okoragera na konywa, agatoka taiyo. Korende abarugi baye nigo batebete inga kaa kagocha, nache na bwari buya, amare amatambe , amandegere name no obwate momura nayae korende otabwati momura narere, agasira tarorekana ase achiete.

english: That day passed. It is said that Sakawa dreamt that those who dwell near would be defeated at the location of the National Bank Of Kenya, Kisii, and so it happened.
ekegusii: Tari igo rioka. Nigo egotebekana buna Sakawa nigo abanete inga amandegere nigo are gocha kwama aaria ase amaagacho ye enyomba ya National Bank Of Kenya, Kisii, eagachire rero.

english: Concerning the dreams of Sakawa, Getembe truly understood that they were important. The interpretation is that those who dwell near will fall into trouble.
ekegusii: Kobwatekana no obobani bwa Sakawa, Getembe yaito yaikeranirie buna atebete. Obwonchoreria nigo bobwatete nse, naende nigo ekororekana buna amandegere nigo akuagwa ase obonge.
