english: The elders of the law were there at the place of purification where people gathered in Omoika, who knew this covenant like the law itself, and they increased and the law itself was fully explained about the place of purification where people gather in Omoika, and because of this reason they remembered the purification where people gather in Omoika and they agreed on a book.
ekegusii: Amang’ana amanene are ime y’egetabu eke igoro yokoiborwa ase amache amo n’ Omoika, oyo noro omochakano bwe egetabu eke, ase enchera ende, egetabu eke nigo kegotworokereria mono igoro yokoiborwa ase amache amo n’ omoika, na inaki omonto aranyare koiborwa ase amache amo n’omoika mono korengana ne ebuku.

english: People also had a discussion about the baptism of Jesus Christ which happened in the river Jordan, and the book showed that all his deeds were done during the time of Jesus so that he could be baptized in it with John the baptizer. John did not have the authority of an angel like Aaron the high priest.
ekegusii: Amache nigo are omobwekano bwe ebatiso ya Yeso aria ase orooche rwa yorodani, ebuku nigo egototebia buna ebibe biaito bionsi nigo biabegetwe igoro ya Yeso ekero abatisetwe amo na yohana omobatisi. Yohana nigo arenge entenenera ya mwanyabanto bw’ ororeria rwa Aroni omokuani omonene.

english: Aaron had stretched out his hands at the place of the forehead during the glory of the tabernacle, and he sanctified all the possessions of the Israelites for a whole year, and the foundation was established. And he did not lack the power of the elders who had authority. The baptism of Jesus was like a full explanation of the glory of the tabernacle.
ekegusii: Aroni nigo are kobeka amoboko aye igoro y’omotwe bw’ Embori y’ekengwanso, na koyetambokeria ebibe bionsi bia aba Israeli bio ‘mwaka omogima, ase rituko riokobwatanigwa. Eke nigo kiarenge ekeriri kia amangana amaya arenge bosio. Ebatiso ya Yeso nigo yarenge buna ekiorokererio giekengwanso kiebibe igoro ya embori eria.

english: Jesus was baptized in the river Jordan, forgiving all the sins of the people and his forehead and stretching out his hand with John, and he was bound by the spirit and he completed all things.
ekegusii: Yeso nigo abatisetwe ase oroche rwa Yorodani, akobogoria ebibe bionsi biamwanyabanto ase omotwe oye ase okobekererwa amoboko amo na Yohana, akabambwa ase omosaraba erio aakanere ebibe bionsi.

english: Therefore, Christians today do not know what happened when Jesus was baptized with John the baptizer in the river Jordan, the baptism of Jesus is a great covenant like the law itself, and this teaching will continue to spread so that it remains forever. It is remembered greatly about being cleansed in Omoika and among the people and the spirit of forgiveness.
ekegusii: Korende abakeresito abange tibamanyeti ninki kiagerete Yeso akabatiswa amo na Yohana omobatisi ase oroche rwa Yorodani, ebatiso ya Yeso n’ekerenga ekenene ase egetabu eke, nensemo yenchiri etanyare goonchoka korende itagarete koba yekeene emiaka yonsi. Nigo tokoiborwa eriakabere ase okwegena enchiri y’omoika amo n’amache na ogokwa kwaye ase omosaraba.

english: Abanto county recorded 960 infections with coronavirus.
ekegusii: Abanto bande 960 batokire na corona

english: The total number of Abanto cases now stands at 17,603, with 25 deaths from the disease, while 960 people have recovered. A total of 8,261 people have been tested. The total number of Abanto cases in Kenya is 17,603.
ekegusii: Omobaro bwa abanto banyorekanire ne ebinyinyi bia corona ase ecounty ya kisii omentekanire goika abanto 25 magega yo omonto onde oyomo konyorekana ne ebinyinyi ebio gati ya abanto 960 bararigwa rero ne ewizara yo obochenu korwa ase abanto 8,261 barengetwe na igo goikia omobaro bwa abanto banyorekanire ne ebinyinyi ebio aiga kenya koba 17,603.

english: According to reports from the Ministry of Health through Minister Mutahi Kagwe, out of the 960 new cases, 510 were reported in Nairobi County, followed by Kajiado with 102, Kiambu with 100, Machakos with 58, Mombasa with 48, Busia with 21, Garissa with 17, Uasin Gishu with 15, Kisumu with 14, Nakuru with 12, Narok with 10, Turkana with 9, Kericho with 7, and Muranga, Makueni, and Laikipia counties each with 5 cases. Additionally, Embu had 3 cases, while Bungoma, Kakamega, Nyeri, and Taita Taveta each had 2 cases, and the counties of Kisii, Tana River, and Trans Nzoia each had only one case.
ekegusii: korengana na amangana atomwa no omowaziri bwo obochenu mutahi kagwe egati ya abanto abwo abayia 960 banyorekanire ne ebinyinyi ebio ecounty ya Nairobi nigo etangaine na abanto 510, kobwatigwa na kajiado na abanto 102, kiambu na abanto 100, machakos nigo ebwate abanto 58 mombasa abanto 48, Busia abanto 21, Garissa abanto 17, Uasin Gishu abanto 15, kisumu abanto 14, Nakuru abanto 12, Narok na abanto 10, Turkana na abanto 9, keriho na abanto 7, ase chicounty chia muranga , makueni ,na Laikipia chibwate abanto 5 kera eyemo, Embu na abanto 3, chicounty chia Bungoma , kakameg, Nyeri na Taita Taveta gotwara abanto 2 kera eyemo ase boigo chicounty chia kisii, Tana river, na Trans Nzoia chibwate omonto oyomo.

english: Today, two people died from the disease, bringing the total number of deaths in Kenya to 280, while 169 people recovered, bringing the total number of recoveries in Kenya to 7,743.
ekegusii: Nonya nabo abanto bande 2 bakure na igo goikia omobaro bwa abanto bakure gwetera ebinyinyi ebio aiga kenya koba 280, ase korende abanto bande 169 babwenire na goikia omobaro bwa abanto babwenire ebinyinyi ebio aiga kenya koba 7,743.

english: Kenya is facing challenges due to ongoing attacks and instability along its border with Somalia affecting Kenyan citizens.
ekegusii: Kenya nigo egochia koagacha orobago orotambe gotanga ababegu korwa ase ense ya somalia gosoa kenya.

english: The Interior Cabinet Secretary Fred Matiang'i stated that they are deploying more security forces to the Mandera county border area to address the increasing threat from Al-Shabaab militants and also stated that this deployment will cover the Mandera region extending to Wajir.
ekegusii: Omoriki bw’serekali oborendi bwa ime omosike Joseph Nkaissery nigo agoteba buna oyo ngati y’ emeroberio y’eserekari kobeka oborendi obonene ase ensemo ya ekaonti ya Mandera korwa ase obosagani bwa kera chingaki bwa Al-Shabaab naboigo na goteba buna nigo oboagachi obwo bogochia gochakwa korwa Mandera etaoni goika Wajir.

english: Mandera and Bulahawa are areas where criminals easily cross over making it difficult to distinguish between Kenyans and Somalis and we are installing CCTV cameras and enhancing border patrols. We need cooperation from the public to identify and report suspicious individuals." Matiang'i added while addressing a gathering in Kenya.
ekegusii: “Mandera na Bulahawa nigo chire ang’e kegima goikera ekerengo otanyare goatanana korwa omochie onde bono tokonyara komanya kenya ng’ai na somalia ng’ai, nabo tokorigereria CCTV na chinchera chinyinge chia oborendi. Goika tonyore chingaki komanya ning’o ogocha na gosoka boigo ning’o orendete chinsa echio.” Nkaissery ogokwana na egetaseni ekemo aaria Kenya.

english: Matiang'i further explained that the ongoing operations are aimed at protecting Kenya's territorial integrity and ensuring safety and security for its citizens and preventing attackers from entering the country through porous borders.
ekegusii: Nkaissery nigo atebete buna orobago oro nigo bogochia korwa oborendi obonene ase engaki entambe bwachandire kenya ekiagera koreng’ana nere, ogosoa na gosoka korwa kenya nigo korabe goetera ase egesieri ekemo koirera komanya na gotanga ababegu ase ebirengo bia igoro.

english: The recent attacks carried out by al-Shabaab militants have caused significant damage to infrastructure in Kenya including the Westgate shopping mall attack in Nairobi which was linked to the African extremist group al-Shabaab who had previously sent fighters to Somalia in 2011 following an offensive against the coastal city of Kismayo and associated with the organization al-Qaeda.
ekegusii: Ekeombe eke gia abaislamu abasaria nigo giakorire obosagani obonene ase chinsemo chia irianyi ya kenya amo n’ emechie emenene gati yabo omochie omonene o Nairobi, gesa orogongo rwa africa ya mocha gotoma abarendi gochia Somalia omwaka 2011 korwania ekeombe eke gesegetire na ekia Alkaida

english: However Kenya has experienced increased attacks targeting foreigners especially in the coastal regions of Mombasa and Lamu.
ekegusii: Boigo nigo Kenya egokagera ekeombe ekio goocherera abageni buna ensemo ya irianyi nonya archipelago emechia ya Mombasa na Lamu.

english: 64 people were killed last year in attacks in Mandera county perpetrated by al-Shabaab militants and five others were abducted during another attack that year escaping death in the same incident.
ekegusii: Abanto 64 nigo baitwa omwaka oria ase ekaonti ya Mandera ase obosagani bobere bwakorwa na ekeombe kia Al-Shabaab, na batano bande gokwa nyuma yo’ bosagani bonde omwaka oyo buna ochaka ase ense eyio eyio.

english: The current situation requires Kenya to strengthen its defense capabilities and collaborate with Ethiopia to stabilize the border region of Somalia and combat terrorism and enhance their own security measures.
ekegusii: Okoagachwa kw’ enyasi oko nigo kogocha magega ya Kenya goteba buna nigo yare gati y’ chinkwana na Ethipoia kobeka ribaga ime ya Somalia riokomanya ase ekeombe ekio boigo kegosokera na koroberia obosagani bwabo.

english: PETRONILLAH OGOTI, Gusii.com: December [ Greetings, Greetings to Masaba ] 16, 2015.
ekegusii: PETRONILLAH OGOTI, Gusii.com: December [ Egesunte, Egesunte Kia Masaba ] 16, 2015.

english: Long ago, Kebaki and Okagonkoru showed me a beautiful place near Magenche. These people always respect elders and they maintain good traditions. Kebaki and Okagonkoru always helped those who were suffering and comforted them. Because of this, others also respected them and praised their kindness.
ekegusii: Abwo kare kare, Kebaki amo n ' Okagonkoru mbamenyete aaria ase rinani erimo ria Magenche. Bono aba nigo barenge abasani abanene kegima na nigo banchaine ekianda gia ikomi. Kebaki amo n' Okagonkoru nigo barenge koagacha egesera ase oboamo na komenya aamo. Ase boigo, naende aba babere nigo barenge koumerana amo na gotiachora endagera ase oboamo ase chingaki chinyinge.

english: Those days passed, Okagonkoru once said “Let us protect our land together. Let us unite so that we can build a strong nation and develop our land well.” Others agreed with him and promised to work hard towards achieving this goal.
ekegusii: Bono engaki eyemo, Okagonkoru okare kobora buna "Tiga totare rinani eri rionsi. Nabo toranyore ase agiya kobua aiga ase tomenyete ekiagera naigure gochia moino ye rinani eri endagera n' enyinge na nigo are agiya mono" Aba babere bagaancherana eng'ana eye na komanora gochia korigia enka enyia.

english: This bird flies and hovers around, disturbing people greatly. It refuses to fly unless it sees a very tall tree, its wings and feathers shining. Ignoring that tree, they wonder how to understand it. Therefore, this bird keeps circling like the story of Kebaki and Okagonkoru, a story that continues to be told generation after generation.
ekegusii: Chinyoni echi chikairuruka na gotambururuka amo erinde barigie enka enyia. Kibakonya koiruruka bakaumera omote omotambe, omuuya ore ne ekiriri ekiiya. Kibanyora omote oyo, bagakung'ia erinde bamenye. Korende chinyoni echi chikaba tichiri koigwana buna gati y' Kebaki amo n' Okagonkoru, buna ning'o orenge gocha korosia egesera aaiga.

english: We continue today, with the strength of unity and cooperation.
ekegusii: Tibakoreti kende nonya, ase engencho y' esegi amo n' ekeminano

english: They remember the importance of working together, unity and cooperation. The strength of that cooperation, someone will start to appreciate it. Those who work on important matters, seek guidance from this bird to help them succeed, they try hard!! Work diligently, others know that their hearts are full of wisdom and understanding.
ekegusii: Ekero baamererania ase egeka egetambe, eminano n' esegi egaateka. Ekero esegi eye yaateka, omonto akabora okoyetoria. Aba bakaba bakorwana ase engaki entambe, goikera ekairera chinyoni echi koirana gochia ase barwete, batarakora kende !! Korwa erio, aba babere bakamanya ase emioyo yabo ime buna okoigwana n' egento ekiya.

english: Many thanks. Are these things still being remembered? There is no way to hide the truth. Why did Okagonkoru and Okebaki come together to show everyone the right path, they tried hard.
ekegusii: Amachara bosa. Bono niingo ogocha koroisia egesera? Esegi teri gokonya onde bwensi. Bono Okagonkoru n' Okebaki bairanire gochia aaria sobo akoro, batarakora kende.

english: The incident occurred at The Nation Media.
ekegusii: Koru ase The Nation Media.

english: Items worth millions of shillings were destroyed by fire at Eronge SDA Boarding Primary School in Borabu Constituency, Nyamira County. The head teacher of that school, Mr. Evans Osinde, said that the cause of the fire is still unknown, and investigations are ongoing.
ekegusii: Ebinto ebinge biisaine chishilingi chimilioni chinyinge nigo biayiete na koba obonyinyo aaria ase Eronge SDA Boarding Primary school ime ya Borabu Constituency, Nyamira County. Omwoorokia omonene bw' esukuru eyio omosike Evans Osinde nigo ateba buna ase ebisio ebiya, onde bwensi tabwate chingoma chinde, kobwatekana n' omorero oyio.

english: “We thank God Almighty for saving the students from this unfortunate incident, the parents and teachers should pray for the church and its surroundings. Investigations are underway to determine the cause of the fire,” said Head Teacher Osinde.
ekegusii: Ntwe nigo togoakera Omonene Tata Nyasae buna mbuya mono ase eng'encho ekero omorero oyio obete, abaorokia amo na abaorokigwa konyora bachire ase ekanisa ime ase amasabo. Onde bwensi tarenge ase enyomba y' oboraro, eyio yayiete ase ekebemberi ekio" Nabo omosike Osinde atebete.

english: “We have received very sad news. We urge everyone to cooperate, restore the building and the large amount of property lost in the fire,” added Head Teacher Osinde while speaking further. The Principal Osinde also stated that they tried to put out the fire using fire extinguishers, but the fire spread quickly and caused significant damage to the building.
ekegusii: Ntwe nigo twaigwete enkoba y' eriogi rinene. Togochi korigereria, tokarora omorero amo n' erioki rinene koru ase enyomba eyio eyemo y' oboraro" Nabo omosike Osinde atebete okomenta naende. Nigo Principal Osinde atebete buna nabo batemete korimia omorero oyio bagotumia fire extinguishers chiabo, eyio ekagera omorero oyo tominchoria na kominyoka gochia ase chinyomba chinde.

english: Reporting by our correspondent
ekegusii: Ogokonywa ngotakeire

english: Members of Parliament from Manga and Esise Ward Rep Teresa Nyaanga visited the children and teachers to comfort them over the incident. The extent of the damage to the building and the children's belongings is yet to be determined. Principal Osinde stated that the loss is estimated at Ksh15 million.
ekegusii: Abanyanyimbo koru Manga amo na Esise Ward Rep Teresa Nyaanga nigo babwatesetie abana amo n' abarimu ase okorimia ekebemberi ekio. Gati y' ebinto biasambetwe n' omorero oyio n' ebitanda amo n' ebinto binde bia abana. Nigo Principal Osinde atebete buna omorero oyio nabo osambete ebinto biraire Ksh15 million.

english: Head Teacher Osinde and Esise Ward Rep Ms. Nyaanga appealed to the government and well-wishers to help the 160 students who are now displaced and their education disrupted.
ekegusii: Omosike Osinde amo na Esise Ward Rep omosubati Nyaanga nigo baboretie eserikali amo n' abanto baito bonsi barwe ogokonya gochia ase abana abwo 160, erinde nario baragenderere amo n' amasomo abo.

english: The dining hall was completely destroyed, leaving the students without a place to eat meals provided by God Almighty, which had been happening regularly. Below: Principal Evans Osinde showing Henry Nyarora of Daily Nation the extent of the fire.
ekegusii: Enyomba y' oboraro nigo yayiete pi, korende enyomba y' amasabo abwo ase abana barenge ime gosaba Omonene Tata Nyasae egatigara kere buya. Below: Principal Evans Osinde okwoorokia Henry Nyarora o Daily Nation the extent of the fire.

english: The Member of Parliament for Suna East, Junet Mohammed, has accused the electoral commission (IEBC) of colluding with Kenya Kwanza coalition supporters in Kajiado Central to rig the election. Speaking to journalists, Junet alleged that the Jubilee Alliance Party was funding the rigging scheme to ensure victory for their candidate.
ekegusii: Omorai bw’ obochori korwa ODM omosike Junet Mohammed orangeirie ekeombe kia obochori n’ chimbebe (IEBC) koringoria obogori bw’ chikura bwaigwekanire aria Kajiado Central ase obochori oboke bogochia koera.Kobwaterana na abasike bande ba ekeombe ekio abajumbe, Junet nigo agoteba buna Jubilee Alliance Party nigo egokorera obong’ainereria bw’okoboko gose chibesa koiba chikura echio.

english: MP Junet claimed the scheme involves using Japanese technology.
ekegusii: omosike Junet obogoretie chibesa chikageire korwa ase omomenyi o Japan

english: However, this happened during the nominations in Kajiado Town. JAP, along with its allies, denied the allegations and maintained that the process was fair and transparent. The constituency returning officer was appointed by Memusi Kanchori from ODM, Patrick Tutui from JAP, and another official named Kuntai Nkashuma. These claims remain unsubstantiated, with ODM officials led by Homa Bay Women Representative Gladys Wanga dismissing them as baseless accusations aimed at discrediting the results. They also stated that voters should be allowed to choose their leaders freely. The officials further added that those making the allegations were likely unhappy with the outcome. The officials have vowed to challenge anyone who attempts to interfere with the election process. Their concerns stem from reports of irregularities at Maasai Technical Training Institute
ekegusii: Gati ye ebitaseni bigotebekana buna Kajiado Town. JAP, nonya nabo yakanire amang’ana ayio na goteba buna echio ne chintacho chi’omoerio chia ebarasi. english: Because of this, the story is about how important it is to be successful. Yes. His children and relatives, they too wanted to achieve success. But what does this story mean when someone wants to acquire the wealth of another person, and that person refuses, causing conflict and problems, and ultimately leading to destruction?

english: Consider this carefully and remember well: The advisor told the king, saying that it is important to listen to advice, and to respect others, and to help those in need, so that things will turn out well. And the Gusii people, they have a lot of wealth.

english: Therefore, know this truth, it is good to work hard, to strive for success and to protect your property from thieves. ekegusii: Ntwe ntomanyeti buna Facebook na amatuko arenga eragenderere koba. Titomanyeti eki kegocha koba gochia motwe. Nabo barayesieke tomanye gotigara bosa. Eroro igoro.

english: “Really, Facebook is free. Isn’t it? Why then do people spend a lot of money buying bundles for these websites only to find out they are being cheated?
ekegusii: Inee, gete Facebook nigo ere free. Tari bo? Ninki gekogera motagete gotuguta chibesa ase chiwebu saiti chinde bosa, mokona korera buna ebesa yakongire?

english: The old man laughed again. There is no need to suffer because of Facebook.
ekegusii: Abwo omogaka ekio ne ekeene. Onde tari goakanera besa ase Facebook.

english: But they are causing problems!
ekegusii: Nabo bakobichoka omotwe!

english: So don’t waste your time aimlessly on Facebook, just know this. It is ruining Facebook. And they are taking our time and resources which could be used elsewhere. Comment on this, friends, stop causing problems, and they should delete their accounts completely! Be careful and wise.
ekegusii: Korende kende gionsi okorika ase Facebook, tikeri kiao. Nigo gekoba eki' Facebook. Nabo baratake gokora kende gionsi na amariko ao kwarikire aroro. Komenta nayio, baise kobichoka omotwe, nabo bagosieka eakounti yao bira riborio! Omanye gotigara otari na kiamboria.

english: “Why is it that you people are spending so much time on Facebook?” Ah! the old man said and pondered. Readers of Gusii.com are also on it. They are on Facebook, Twitter, Yahoogroups…. They are on it. I myself didn’t want to be on Facebook, but I had to join because of others. I joined. And now I find myself spending a lot of time there. The old man Okioma, said this while speaking about how young people use websites.
ekegusii: Bono igo nainwe nigo motagete koba buna Facebook?" Aa! omogaka rero nabo okamineti. Abasomi ba Gusii.com nigo bare kera ase. Nigo bare ase Facebook, Twitter, Yahoogroups.... Kera ase. Naintwe nigo togosiomeria aroro ase Facebook, erinde kobatebia buna nao tore. Batoinyore. Erinde batorotote ekero banyorire ribaga.

english: Matiang’i criticizes the plans of Kenya Kwanza; accuses Kenyans of being naive
ekegusii: Matiang’i komochia obomo bwa Kenya Kwanza; obaenekeirie abakenya omorembe

english: The Minister for Internal Security Dr.Fred Matiang’I has criticized the plans of Kenya Kwanza, saying that some things are just empty promises made to deceive people, and he said those who support them are like fools following Uhuru Kenyatta.
ekegusii: Omowaziri bwoborendi bwa ime Dr.Fred Matiang’I nigo amochirie obomo bwa Kenya Kwanza, maega yogoteba amasakara atoka gasiareranire ime yomochie ‘Mombasa ayio are kogosereria obogima bwabarai gete , nigo arwa ase abisi yomorai bwense omosike Uhuru Kenyatta.

english: However, despite the large amount of money needed for this big project, Matiang’I told them and warned them not to mislead citizens, also saying that five and six (8) of them were arrested because they were found doing something wrong and were therefore released.
ekegusii: Gokwana chingaki chiegeikaro giokeneki omorembe bosio bwobochori obenene,Matiang’I nigo agikeria abarai abwo na kobaboria gotiga kong’aina abanainchi,ase ateba abakagerwa batano na batato (8) abwo bakageire koenekia egekore ekio nigo babekirwe biara.

english: He further accused the naive Kenyans, during this big project, also saying that the government is watching, seeing what this project will be like and whether it will succeed on September 9th next year.
ekegusii: Nigo omowaziri oyuo abaenekeria omorembe oisaine abakenya, bosio bwobochori obonene, ase keria ateba eserekali nigo ere maiso, erio koenekia obochori bwekeene nobwasioku chitariki 9 chiomotienyi o gatano na gatato.

english: Are the children enough?" And her father scolded her mother, reminding her like a foolish person. We children, we would argue constantly, we would fight. As we fought, we went outside together. Our father didn't know how to scold. Petronillah Ogoti was greeted by eight people, saying, “Father, you are a good man. The good man is Akareta Baba.”
ekegusii: Abana mbaragera?" Nabo tata akaboririe mama, gaiikire nka morogoba. Ntwe ebimwana nigo twakarageire ritang'ani, twabutiara. Go twabutiarire, twagenda isiko gotiena. Tata omanya koragera. Petronillah Ogoti nigo atebetigwe na ng'ina koro buna, "Tata N' omochobeeri. Agachobeera Akareta Baba".

english: What does this mean in Ekegusii? It means she has experienced life, those eight people including Petronillah have agreed. To be associated with those eight people, and the wealth they possess is great. That wealth existed, and it helped the child who had problems and lacked respect, and it benefited them.
ekegusii: Bono igo ninki aase Ekegusii? Ase ogototebia igoro y' omoino oyo, ngina koro Petronillah natoete omogano. Kobwatekana na ng'ina koro, eye n' enywomo yatogetigwe ase omobayeno oyo oito. Enywomo eyio yabete, nigo yaagerete omwana oyomo akaba n' omogoko, na gotogia ise.

english: And now this story continues to spread around about the past and the present. This story also involves a large amount of money, and it reminds people of the things they did in the past. Those things were shared among everyone, and those eight people helped.
ekegusii: Nigo ise omomura oyo arenge omogaka bwanchire ase enka amo n' ekenyoro kiaye. Bono omomura oyo gakiina na koba omonto omonene, akainyora obwanchani boria bwarenge ase enka yaye. Obwanchani boria bwachakerete gati y' ise na ng'ina, eyio yaagerete akaiborwa.

english: This time with problems and respect, this story reminds them to avoid being disrespectful to others, helping. It reminds them again, causing life to flourish through the help of others. Time passes quickly. Repeating the good deeds that our ancestors did, this story will continue until it reaches the ears of those who understand the importance of respecting elders.
ekegusii: Bono kaare n' omogoko, omomura oyo akainyora buna goetera ase ise konywoma ngina, akaiborwa. Kainyora iga, agatera omoino oyo ase enchera y' omobayeno. Tari igo rioka. Korora ebiinto ebiya ise amokorerete, omomura oyo akarora buna tiga amotogie, ase eng'encho nere ogerete abeire omomura egesora ase ekenyoro.

english: Because of this story, the Gusii people remember the relationship between fathers and children which says, “Father, you are a good man. The good man is Akareta Baba.” This is a good thing for life this week, and I wish Happy Father's Day to all fathers who exist. Have a nice day and thank you for listening.
ekegusii: Goetera ase omomura oyo, Abagusii bakabwatera abwo n' omobayeno oyo ogoteba buna"Tata N' omochobeeri. Agachobeera Akareta Baba". Oyo noro omoino oito for this week, naende Happy Father's Day ase abatata bonsi babeta. Monywe mache maya and thank you for listening.

english: Happy Fathers Day 2012. This child, Fanuel Sedekia.
ekegusii: Happy Fathers Day 2012. Omwana omino, Fanuel Sedekia oyio.

english: This is Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. May 3, 2011.
ekegusii: Na Petronillah Ogoti. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Amaumuntia (May) 3, 2011.

english: My father Mosera Ibu and Nyamisanchu during happier times.
ekegusii: Abangina Mosera Ibu amo na Nyamisanchu during happier times.

english: My mother Nyamisanchu was very generous. Long ago, people did not have much. Why does this wealth seem to favor the children of Mwanyagetinge? Long ago and long ago, years and years, the elder always helped his relatives.
ekegusii: Omongina Nyamisanchu nere otorentererete. Abwo kare kare, banto tibare gokwa. Bono rende inaki amakweri akorete agachera Mwanyagetinge? Abwo kare na kare, emiaka ne emiaka, omogaka oyomo nabwate abarugi babere.

english: Mosera Ibu and Nyamisanchu. Because Nyamisanchu loved her family very much. She would save little by little until she managed to buy good clothes. It was said, people did not have much.
ekegusii: Mosera Ibu amo na na Nyamisanchu. Korende Nyamisanchu tanchete moibori omwabo. Nigo are komororera endamwamu enyinge sana mbaka akagania amakweri amoire. Goikera ekero eke, banto mbare gokwa.

english: In those days, Nyamisanchu would love her family so much that she would spoil them. The elder who had this habit also had friends who would help him with his farming. That elder was known for being kind and compassionate, and his neighbors would come together to help him when he needed it.
ekegusii: Rituko erimo, Nyamisanchu agaita moibori omwabo mbaka agatweka mo. Omogaka bwo omochi oyo akaba na amayianda ase ogosira kwo omorugi oye. Omogaka oyo akaba gakorenda oboina bwa nyagosira gekogera nigo abakoro bare kwegena buna monto tagokwa agende pi.

english: They came together like ants after five days. Nyamisanchu continued to love her family and care for them. She saved money, and whenever these savings were enough, she would send the elder to buy things and bring them home.
ekegusii: Nigo begenete inga inkoboka are nyuma ya amatuko atano. Nyamisanchu tachia kogokigwa na okorendwa kwo oboina. Akaenga amarwa, na ekero amarwa aya ayiete, agatebia omogaka oye agende gotimoka gakonya kwegokia na amarwa ere arende oboina.

english: The elder went and bought Nyamisanchu what she wanted. As they returned, there was a lot of noise. Nyamisanchu sang songs and danced while carrying a pot, saying, “my wealth is increasing, my possessions are growing, my granary is full.”
ekegusii: Omogaka akagenda na gotiga Nyamisanchu arende oboina. Karendete, ribusi rikabusi amaroba. Nyamisanchu korora aya, akarigia enyimbo na gochwata embera igoro kagoteba, "monto okwa osira, motienyi okwa oboka, chitunda isato".

english: The pots made a lot of noise as they walked. This happened because the pots were full of things that Nyamisanchu had bought, and the children of Mwanyagetinge were happy about it.
ekegusii: Amaroba agakira tagenderera kobusia. korwa erio amakweri agacha buna amaroba aya are kobusia nyagosira otagete koboka Nyamisanchu akamochwata tachia koboka, amakweri agachera Mwanyagetinge korwa erio.

english: IEBC prepares major election forum for the 2022 general election at KICC
ekegusii: IEBC gokora omosangererekano omonene igoro yobochori bwomwaka o 2022 KICC

english: Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 11, 2022
ekegusii: Written by Zachary Mayieka on July 11, 2022

english: The commission announced that IEBC will hold a major election forum for monitoring the general election at the KICC grounds in Nairobi.
ekegusii: Ekeombe kiobochoori nechimbebe IEBC nigo kerakore omosangererekano omonene igoro yokoerigania kwobochori obonene ase amaagacho a KICC ime yomochie o Nairobi.

english: This forum's theme is, ‘Promoting peaceful elections in Kenya through inclusive dialogue’. The purpose of the forum is to monitor the election and educate voters.
ekegusii: Omosangererekano oyio nigo ore nekerenga, ‘Ogosukia ense ya Kenya gochia ase ekerengo egeting’u kiobosibore’. Chinkwana nchibe igoro yokoerigania kwobochori na koenekia obochori obuya.

english: President Uhuru Kenyatta also attended the election forum yesterday, along with his running mate and other leaders.
ekegusii: Omorai bwense omosike Uhuru Kenyatta nigo akageire koigora omosangererekano oyuo bwamatuko ane, amo na abarwanereria bane bekerogo kioborai bwense.

english: Among them were ODM leader Raila Odinga, UDA leader William Ruto, Roots Party candidate George Wajackoya, and Agano Party candidate David Wahiga.
ekegusii: Abwo ng’amo na oria o ODM Raila Odinga, oria o UDA William Ruto, Roots Party George Wajackoya, amo na Agano Party David Wahiga.

english: Several observers attended including representatives from the African Union, Commission of Chairperson Moussa Faki Mahamat and other election observation teams.
ekegusii: Boigo ebiombe biariganirie ng’amo na African Union, Commision of Chairperson Moussa Faki Mahamat amo nabanyakerogo korwa ebiombe binde biobochori.

english: Chief Justice Martha Koome, Attorney General Kihara Kariuki and IEBC chairman Wafula Chebukati were also present.
ekegusii: Omonachi ebina omonene Martha Koome, Attoney General Kihara Kariuki amo nomoteneneri o IEBC Wafula Chebukati nabaikerane.

english: Long ago, there was a doctor in Makairo, whose name was Nyandika, who treated people with herbs. This doctor Nyandika also had a habit of secretly treating patients and they would pay him with gifts.
ekegusii: Abwo kare kare ase ekenyoro kia Makairo, omogaka gete narengeo orenge korokwa Nyandika. Bono omogaka Nyandika nigo arenge n' obwanchani naende nigo anchete korwa obokonyi gochi ase bari baremeire na kende.

english: The beauty of eyes: A beautiful girl who is admired. She doesn't like seeing a healthy person with large breasts. Gusii.com at home and the doctor Nyandika's house in Makairo, West Nugirango, Nyamira County. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014
ekegusii: Amaridadi y' amaiso: Omobisa tanya koayererwa. Tokare nyomba gotiachora obokima bw' obori amo n' amabere amaroranu. Gusii.com at home ase enka y' omogaka Nyandika aaria Makairo, West Nugirango, Nyamira County. Mwanyagetinge.com/2014

english: Every time she dreams, she refuses to return until people bring her charms, beads, clay pots, and money before she returns. It is said that the doctor Nyandika wrote down the medicine he was given completely. And this medicine was mixed with witchcraft.
ekegusii: Nonya nase ching'iti, tarenge korora buya ekero abanto bagochanda ebimoni, chisese, chimbori, ching'ondi tare korora buya. Rituko erimo, omogaka Nyandika akanyora emanwa y' eng'era yatigetwe yoka. Bono emanwa eye nigo yarenge n' enchara.

english: This doctor Nyandika used to refuse to accept payment.
ekegusii: Bono omogaka Nyandika okare koniantoka gochia bwoye

english: To admire her, Doctor Nyandika was approached with gifts and he carried messages while secretly treating patients. Quickly, Nyandika refused to go away and argued with the young man and his breasts were full of milk.
ekegusii: Koyerora iga, omogaka Nyandika agaichorwa n' amabera na agatwara omong'uso bw' okorwa obokonyi. Keri keri, Nyandika akaniantoka kogenda bwoye na koirana ne ekerandi kere na amabere ache koa emanwa enywe.

english: Until he met her, he stayed awake all night. This doctor then went crazy because of the medicine he drank from the breasts. Every day now, the old man no longer sleeps. The head sometimes argues with itself. And the head refusing this, it falls and gets hurt.
ekegusii: Ekero aairana, akayebekera monwa egere egonke. Bono omogaka oyo akagoka buna emanwa y' eng'era yare konywa amabere buya. Nonya nabo igo, omogoko oye torenge bwe egeka. Eng'ina kumbe nkoirana ekare. Bono engina korora aya, ekaigwa bobe na kogechigwa.

english: The story about Doctor Nyandika
ekegusii: Ekare korundokera omogaka Nyandika

english: It is reported, the story about Nyandika. This doctor Nyandika admiring, he woke up feeling weak and very tired. That medicine which confused him, made him stay awake all night, and caused him trouble saying “No”. Every day now, he doesn’t know what to do.
ekegusii: Kiyagechigwa, ekare korundokera Nyandika. Bono omogaka Nyandika koyerora, akaimoka gotama korende tanyara gotama bwango. Eng'era eye ekamobogani, ekamoimoki igoro, na komotinera inse buna "Mo" Nonya nabo igo, tachieti gokwa.

english: In those days, Doctor Nyandika carried knowledge that a girl, when admired, does not feel shy.
ekegusii: Korwa erio, omogaka Nyandika agatwara obomanyi buna omobisa, tari koayererwa.

english: These are my words:
ekegusii: Aya amwabo aya:

english: Minto Mwamogusii, a child of mine who praised God, praised Him in the year 2012. It was a good day when I remembered and thought about the importance of raising a child well, like raising a young plant. I created Gusii.com so people could find information there. I continue to work on it diligently.
ekegusii: Minto Mwamogusii, mbuya mono ase Omonene Tata Nyasae, ase ogotoikia omwaka o 2012. Nigo nyegenete ng'a nakera oyomo nare n' obote bw' okwarigania omwaka omoyia buna omosubati okoarigania omwana okoiborwa. Naintwe aiga Gusii.com ntori gotigwa magega yaye. Naintwe nkoyochengera tore.

english: “Don’t despise small beginnings, don’t despise humble origins.” This is what the children of Mwanyagetinge said in 2012, and it has remained true. Happy New Year 2012, to all the children of our clan.
ekegusii: Ntakana ekebwata bobe egasira, ntakana ekebwata buya ekaba aroro". Tiga ntwe abana ba Mwanyagetinge twebwate buya in 2012, erinde tochabumbe. Happy new year 2012, ase abana baminto mwensi

english: This is how we begin this year with peace and the love of Jesus Christ, whom we all know, Gusii people, and with all wisdom. And with great joy we will celebrate together and the year will end well. I also wish you blessings throughout the year 2012.
ekegusii: Bono nigo tokoganeria mwensi amaya na omorembe O' Yeso obe nainwe ne chiamate chiano chionsi, Gusii yaito, n' ense engima. N' omogoko omonene buna twabwaterana twensi ase okogokera buna egekoro giato kiare ase omwaka oyo oera. naende ntogenderere gosemanian ase omwaka oyo o 2012.

english: We pray for blessings so we can continue to live and prosper. A strong child can become very successful. I hope this happens too. We ask that this blessing happen quickly.
ekegusii: Nigo tokobasaba togenderere kobwaterana nario omonwa oito oragenderere. Omwana gakonya gokina nigo akonya kong'ainia ake ake. Naintwe nkonya gokina tore. Nigo tososaba buna tiga togenderere gokina aamo.

english: The Gusii people should always live together peacefully and help each other so we can progress. There is no time to waste. Let the Gusii language flourish and be known everywhere, and let it bring us honor. These words are true, they are important for every child.
ekegusii: Abagusii baminto tiga tobwaterane twensi toegokere na koinyorerani buna twakabeire. Teri igo rioka. Tiga Ekegusii giato gechabumbe gaki nonya emenwa ende yachiire nguma. Aya takoba ,otaiyo buna omwana ominto.

english: 2012 is a year of change for Kenya. We ask for peace to prevail during the elections so that people don’t fight, saying “Don’t despise small beginnings, don’t despise humble origins”. Let us embrace humility, and may we not be arrogant. These are the hopes for the year 2012. Happy New Year children of Mwanyagetinge clan. May God bless you.
ekegusii: 2012 n'omwaka bw'obochori seito Kenya. Tiga tosabe omorembe oichore egati yaito twensi ekiagera abakoro mbatebete buna, "Ntakana ekebwata bobe egasira, ntakana ekebwata buya ekaba aroro". Tiga toebwate buya, tonya koba ororo. Aya na amaiga y' omwaka omuya 2012. Happy new year abana baminto Mwanyagetinge mwensi. Nyasae abe nainwe.

ekegusii: Omoteneneri omonene bwa amang’ana ya abasae ase abisi yo omokonyi bwo omorai bwense omosike Anthony Kibagendi otebire buna abasae nigo bagwenerete kobeka ebirengererio biabo mono ase ensemo yo oboremi amo […]

english: The chairperson of the women, Susan Mochache, has informed the women leaders that they should work together to improve their businesses and strengthen their savings groups [...].
ekegusii: Omoriki o’ botambe ase ewizara yo obochenu omosubati Susan Mochache, nigo aboririe abanyagitari koerusanaania korwa aase omogiro bwo okobwatoka obokoreri bwabo na gokwana egetambokero ekio koba ekebe anene chingaki echi […]

english: The leader of the Sub-County women's group (Kenya Women Candidates Association) said that she came to encourage them and give them hope, and that she will continue to support them always. She added that she would try her best to ensure they succeed [...].
ekegusii: Omokonyi bwomonyakerogo bwekiombe gia kia Abasubati bakorigia amabaga yoborai (Kenya Women Candidates Association) Otebiri Ng’a kera omonto nabwate ribaga ase obora bwechinsemo ao ao ime yense. Nigo arenge koyakwana ime […]

english: The Governor of Kisii County, James Ongwae, said that Kisii County is prepared to celebrate the heroes of 2020. He added that he would support the initiative of Minto Bwakire [...].
ekegusii: Omogavana bwe ekaunti ya Kisii Omosike James Ongwae otebire buna ekaonti ya Kisii neareganetie kegima ase ogochengera rituko ria Mashujaa yomwaka 2020. Nigo arenge koyakwana ase omoroberio o’ Minto Bwakire […]

english: West Mugirango MP Vincent Kemosi announced that a large amount of money from the NG-CDF fund for the constituency will be used to build classrooms and buy a school bus, which was handed over to help students [...].
ekegusii: Omojumbe o’ West Mugirango Vincent Kemosi oenekirie buna chibesa chinyinge chia NG-CDF ase e-constituency eywo nigo chiabeire chikoimokeriria amaagacho ase chisukuru naboigo kogora chi-school bus ekio atebire kegendererete gokinia ebirengo […]

english: Parents should take their children to school so that they don't miss out on education, because education is important for the future. This was said by the chairperson of Maendeleo Ya Wanawake and the representative of Minto Bwakire, who urged them to cooperate with Evans Makori [...].
ekegusii: Abaibori mbagwenerete gosomia abana babo amng’ana yechinsoni batarikobaombia erio chibwa chiabana chibe chingiya. Aya nigo akwanwa nomoriki bwekeombe kia Maendeleo Ya Wanawake ase omoroberio o’Minto Bwakire ekero barenge gsanga na Evans Makori […]

english: Good evening: With PETRONILLAH OGOTI. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Published [ January ] 15, 2014
ekegusii: Buna twakabeire: Na PETRONILLAH OGOTI. Gusii.com Proverbs, Culture And Customs Editor. Engatiato [ January ] 15, 2014

english: When someone builds a house and drinks beer, the owner does not quickly forget the builders and the plasterers. It is the owner who remembers that Esese Eaberi Neero Yarusetie Entwoni Bogere! What is the reason for remembering those builders? I also remember them quickly.
ekegusii: Togaikaransete emogoroba eyemo konywa rikairo, omogaka sokoro ominto nantegerete omorabaro gete omorito. Nigo omogaka sokoro antebetie buna Esese Eaberi Neero Yarusetie Entwoni Bogere! Bono ninki engencho y' omorabaro oyo? Nche naboretie sokoro.

english: And I see my father working hard until he gets tired. They get tired because the spirit of going to work is good. The spirit of the owner Bogonko works around Marani, Bogetutu. Very well, greet Bomariba, Bonchari!
ekegusii: Nere n' omokia tata gokora keri kebeterereti. Nabo ebeterereti buna esese eye goika egende ase atambe. Esese y' omogaka Bogonko korwa aaria Marani, Bogetutu. Kare kare, yaikire Bomariba, Bonchari!

english: It is the owner who remembers that when they were young, their traditions were respected. These days the traditions are gone, and respect has disappeared from the road. But let us remember the spirit of the owner Bogonko, who works around Marani, very well greet Bomariba!
ekegusii: Nigo omogaka antebetie buna abwo ase amatuko a kare, chisese chintwoni nchiagatarire. Naende amatuko amange, chisese echi nigo chiarenge gotara orogendo orotambe. Nabo kwarenge konyora buna esese y' omogaka Bogonko, korwa aaria Marani, kare kare yaikire Bomariba!

english: Let the tradition disappear slowly, protecting the old tradition. If you see the old spirit, let us remember the new tradition so that the old spirit remains there.
ekegusii: Nigo chisese chintwoni chiarenge kogenda aare, erinde korigia chisese chiaberi. Ande onsi ase esese eaberi ere, nigo kwarenge konyora chisese chintwani chigocha koyetarera, esese eye eaberi neba aare.

english: What did it cause?!
ekegusii: Bono chiakorire esababu!!

english: What caused this tradition, and yet it spreads around where people live!! That is true. Listen, the big body of those builders is here now, my father and mother. Anyone who forgets them, their memory will not be lost, it will remain.
ekegusii: Bono chisese echi gichiakorire esababu yabo, naende nigo chikoirana gochi aaria ase chiarwa!! Yaani manya. Aaiga, eganga enene y' omorabaro oyo neri ng'a, omokia n' omuya. Onye omokia toiyo, rirorio tokonyora keri otagete, gose kebeterereti.

english: My father always tells me to look carefully at his wealth.
ekegusii: Omokia noro oragere aye onyore keri kegochandete ase enkoro yao.

english: Let people work hard like my father, and let the Abagusii elders know that Esese Eaberi Neero Yarusetie Entwoni Bogere! Works with the owner, this is what I have for this week.
ekegusii: Gosegeta abanto gokora omokia, nakio kiagerete Abagusii abakoro bagateba buna Esese Eaberi Neero Yarusetie Entwoni Bogere! Korwa ase omogaka sokoro ominto, oyo noro omobayeno oito for this week.

english: Goodbye everyone and thank you for listening.
ekegusii: Mbuya mono and thank you for listening.

english: Raila campaigned with Arati and Ongwae extensively
ekegusii: Raila koirera Arati na Ongwae gosabusana

english: Supporters gathered in large numbers to support the Azimio La Umoja coalition led by Raila Odinga, and they held rallies throughout the Gusii region for several days.
ekegusii: Oyokorigia ekerogo kioborai bwense goetera obomo bwa Azimio La Umoja omosike Raila Odinga,nigo airete chikampeini chiobomo obwo ase orogongo rwa Gusii rituko ria tichi kabere.

english: Notably, Raila greatly appreciates the people of Gusii, and he has assured them that he will address their concerns and work towards development, adding that unity is key for the progress of Kenya.
ekegusii: Gokwana ase egetii ekenene kia Gusii Raila ,nigo ababoria abagusii goesokia ase obonge chitariki kianda na komoakera chikura,erio koenekia buna nkoba are omorai ogatano bwense ya Kenya.

english: Recently, Raila held a meeting where he encouraged supporters from various parts of Kisii County, urging them to continue supporting the governors of those counties, namely Simba Arati and James Ongwae, assuring them that his victory would bring significant benefits to those working for the Azimio coalition, leading to widespread celebration and joy among the people.
ekegusii: Chingaki echio echio omosike Raila nigo aira ribaga erio kobwatani abakorigia ebirogo aoao ime yecounty ya Kisii,egati yabo oyokorigia ekerogo kiobogavana ime yecounty eyio omosike Simba Arati amo nomogavana bwecounty ya Kisii omosike James Ongwa ase Raila ateba buna nobosooku obonene ase abarai bakorwa obomo bwa Azimio ,gotwara okong’usanana egento kerairere kobugwa ase obochori obwo

english: These people have vowed to remain united and work tirelessly to ensure the success of the Azimio coalition in the upcoming elections in Kisii County.
ekegusii: Babere abwo nigo babeire babwate oboererania obobe egento konya kiaireire obomo bwa Azimio korigia gotagoka ime yekaonty ya Kisii.

english: The Khasi pine (Pinus kesiya) is native to Asia and grows well in mountainous areas, and it is also grown as a commercial tree. It can reach heights of 30–35 meters with a trunk diameter of about one meter. The bark is reddish-brown, thick, and scaly, while the needles are 15 to 20 centimeters long. The cones of this pine are 5 to 9 centimeters long and 1.5 to 2.5 centimeters wide.
ekegusii: Ekemeri giepaini ya Khasi (Pinus kesiya) korwa Asia nigo gekwama bwago mono, naende nkeri gotoka raisi isiko ya sobo. Emete nigo egoika chimita 30–35 ase obotambe n’amatina agoika emita eyemo ase obonetu. Kera egesabo ekebwate amagwa amato akobeta atato, kera erimo rire chisentimita 15 goika 20 ase abotambe. Amatunda korwa aekemeri eke nigo are chisentimita 5 goika 9 ne chintetereechire chisentimita 1,5 goika 2,5 ase abotambe.

english: The Khasi pine is found in the Himalayas: from the foothills of Bhoondi (these forests are often mixed with Khasi and Naga pines in the states of Meghalaya and Manipur, China (especially Yunnan province), Burma (now Myanmar), Thailand, Laos, Vietnam (particularly Lai Chau, Lang Son, Cao Bang, and Quang Ninh provinces), and the Philippines (Luzon island). In the Philippines, it is sometimes confused with Pinus insularis. In China, it is also sometimes confused with Pinus yunnanensis.
ekegusii: Ekemeri giepaini ya Khasi nigo okwama ase Himalayaa: Ase rogoro-mocha ya Boindi (amatuko aya asengencho y’okogesaemete ase egetunwa kia Khasi ns egetunwa kia Naga ase ensemo ya Meghaliay na Manipur, China (ase omochie Yunnan), Burma (ase omochie o Myanmar), Thailandi ya rorogo, Laos, Vietnam (ase emechie ya Lai Chau, Lang Son, Cao Bang, Quang Ninh), na Filipino (omochie o Luzon). Chipaini korwa ufilipino nigo kero kende chikorokwa n’erieta Pinus insularis. Ime ya China nabo okonyora egesaku kende gekorokwa Pinus yunnanensis.

english: This tree thrives on slopes and hillsides, growing well in well-drained soils at altitudes between 4.5 and 2000 meters, most commonly between 1200 and 1400 meters. It prefers cool climates and grows best in areas with abundant rainfall. The wood has a moisture content of around 70%.
ekegusii: Emete y’egesaku eke nigo egotoka ase ebitiro n’emete emaio emiao ekwama ase riroba ribe ri’erengi embariri nabisicha ere n’echumbi iga ya 4.5 na azse aimogete igoro goika chimita 800–2000 rakini mono korwa chimiti 1200 goika 1400. Ase agatigati abwate amache naende are aomo ase omwaka. Embura ere enyinge n’omoika oetaneti 70%.

english: This pine is also known for its resilience, being able to grow on poor soils. It is also relatively fast-growing, making it a valuable timber species.
ekegusii: Ekemeri eke nabo gekonyara koremereria obokendu, korende ekegosira bwanko ekero chigotwara amato. Korende ekero chihosimekwa, bokendu obo mbotakeiri nonye.

english: Other names for this pine include Pinus khasya and Pinus khasyanus.
ekegusii: Amarieta ande y’ekemeri eke nigo are Pinus khasya, Pinus khasyanus
