Bakaira. 9 Omonene bw'omoyega agachia koyaigwa amache akoregete koba edivai, tamanya ase yarua, (korende abasomba mbamanyete ababuchete amache), omonene bw'omoyega akamorangeria omonene bw'enyangi, 10 akamotebia, Kera omonto ritang'ani iga agochaka edivai ere engiya, goika abanto kobatiekire konywa mono, erio oreta eyetari engiya: aye kwagachire edivai engiya goika bono, 11 Oyio noro omochako bw'ebikone Yesu akorete Kana ya Galili, akaorokia obonene bwaye; aborokigwa baye bakamwancha. 12 Nyuma as'aya akagenda goika Kaperinaum, ere, na ng'ina, nabamwabo, naborokigwa baye: bakamenya aroro amatuko amake. 13 Naende epasaka y'Abayahudi iga yarenge ang'e, Yesu akarina goika Yerusalemu. 14 Akarora hekalu ime abanto barenge gotonda chiombe neching'ondi namaruma, nabanyene koonchora chifetha, baikaransete: 15 agakora orokini ase chingori, akabasokia bonsi korwa ase hekalu, neching'ondi nechiombe; agaitera chifetha chiabo abanyene goonchora chifetha,agachionchora chimesa chiabo; 16 akabatebia baria barenge gotonda amaruma, Yatigerie aya; timokora enyomba ya Tata one koba enyomba y'ebiasara. 17 Aborokigwa baye bakainyora ng'a nerikire, Risemi ri'enyomba yao riandire. 18 Nabo Abayahudi bakairaneria bakamotebia, Ngekone ki ogotworokia, ekiagera ogokora aya? 19 Yesu akairaneria, akabatebia, Yetagore hekalu eye, nainche as'amatuko atato ninyetenenie. 20 Abayahudi bakabora, Hekalu eye yaagachetwe as'engaki y'emiaka emerongo ene netano nomo, naye oyetenenie as'amatuko atato? 21 Korende ere igare kobora amang'ana ase hekalu y'omobere oye. 22 Nabo agachia kobokigwa as'amakweri aborokigwa baye bakainyora ng'a igatebete ring'ana eri, bakariancha riria ririko nariria ring'ana atebete Yesu. 23 Goika agachia kobao Yerusalemu ekero ki'epasaka ase rituko rinene, abanto abange bakariancha erieta riaye, kobarora ebikone arenge gokora. 24 Korende Yesu tegenete asebare, naki abamanyete bonsi, 25 naende ekiagera tarenge nokorigia as'abanto goteba amang'ana igoro ase mwanyabanto; naki ere omonyene amanyete ayare ime as'abanto.

english: 1 Now there was a Pharisee named Nicodemus, a member of the Jewish ruling council. 2 He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher sent from God. For no one could perform the signs you are doing if God were not with him.” 3 Jesus replied, “Very truly I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless they are born again.” 4 “How can someone be born when they are old?” Nicodemus asked. “Surely they cannot enter a second time into their mother’s womb to be reborn?” 5 Jesus answered, “Very truly I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless they are born of water and the Spirit. 6 Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit. 7 You should not be surprised that I said, ‘You must be born again.’ 8 The wind blows wherever it pleases. You hear its sound, but you cannot tell where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.” 9 “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked. 10 Jesus replied, “Are you Israel’s teacher, yet you do not understand these things? 11 Very truly I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, but you do not accept our testimony. 12 I have told you earthly things and you do not believe; how then will you believe if I tell you heavenly things? 13 No one has ever gone into heaven except the one who came down from heaven—the Son of Man. 14 Just as Moses lifted up the bronze snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up, 15 that everyone who believes may have eternal life in him.” 16 For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life. 17 For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn it, but to save it. 18 Whoever believes in him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe stands condemned already because they have not believed in the name of God’s one and only Son. 19 This is the verdict: Light has come into the world, but people loved darkness instead of light because their deeds were evil. 20 Everyone who does evil hates the light, and will not come into the light for fear that their deeds will be exposed. 21 But those who live by the truth come into the light, so that it may be seen plainly that what they have done has been done in the sight of God. 22 After this, Jesus and his disciples went out into the countryside of Judea. He spent some time there with them, and baptized. 23 John was also baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was plenty of water there; people were coming and being baptized. 24 This happened because John had not yet been thrown into prison. 25  Now a discussion arose between John’s disciples and a Jew about purification. 26 They came to John and asked, “Rabbi, why are you baptizing here if you aren’t the Messiah?” 27 John replied, “I baptize with water, but among you stands one you do not know. 28 He is the one who comes after me, and I am not worthy to untie the sandals on his feet.” 29 The next day, John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world! 30 This is the one I meant when I said, ‘After me will come one who ranks higher than I.’ 31 The one who goes ahead of me has already gone, and I am coming after him.” 32 And John testified: “I saw the Spirit come down from heaven like a dove and remain on him. 33 I have seen and I testify that this is the Son of God.” 34 The next day John again stood with his disciples and said, “See, the Lamb of God!” 35 The next day John was standing there again with two of his disciples. 36 When Jesus walked by, John looked at him and said, “See, the Lamb of God!” 37 The two disciples heard him say this, and they followed Jesus.
ekegusii: 1 Narenge omonto oyomo bw'Abafarisai, erieta riaye Nikodemo, omonene bw'Abayahudi: 2 oyo agacha ase Yesu botuko, akamotebia, Rabii, twamanyire ng'a nomworokia ore, kwarure ase Nyasaye: naki omonto onde tari oranyare kobikora ebikone ebi ogokora, tatiga Nyasaye abe amo nere. 3 Yesu akairaneria, akamotebia, Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie, Omonto ataiboiri eria kabere, takonyara koborora obonda bwa Nyasaye. 4 Nikodemo akamotebia, Naki aranyare omonto koiborwa kare omogaka? nanyare gosoa enda ya ng'ina eria kabere aiborwe? 5 Yesu akairaneria, Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie, Omonto ataiboiri as'amache n'Omoika, takonyara gosoa obonda bwa Nyasaye. 6 Ekeiboire as'omobere nomobere; nekeiboire as'Omoika nomoika. 7 Tokumia ekiagera nagotebia, Nogwenerete koiborwa naende. 8 Embeo iga ekogenda as'erigetie, negeturi kiaye iga ogokeigwa, korende tomanyeti as'ekorua gose as'ekogenda: naboigo na ker'omonto oiboirwe as'Omoika. 9 Nikodemo akamoiraneria, akamotebia, Naki aranyare koba aya? 10 Yesu akairaneria akamotebia, Inee! Aye nomworokia as'Isiraeli, naya toyainyoreti? 11 Ekeene, ekeene, nagotebirie, Eritomanyete nario togokwana, neri toroche twariteba; noborori bwaito timorigwancha. 12 Kerabe nkobatebia amang'ana ense, nainwe timogwancha, naki moranche, kondabatebie amang'ana a igoro? 13 Naende omonto onde tari orinire igoro, tatiga ere oyoikire korwa igoro Omwana-o-mwanyabanto ore igoro. 14 Naende buna Musa aimogetie eng'iti eroro ime, naboigo Omwana-o-mwanyabanto agwenerete aimokererigwe: 15 erinde tasira omonto onde bwonsi oyomwanchire, korende abe nobogima bwa kare nakare. 16 Naki Nyasaye ayianchete ense, goika akarua Omwana oye omomoima, erinde 'monto onde bwonsi oyomwanchire tasira, korende anyore obogima bwa kare nakare. 17 Naki Nyasaye tamotomete as'ense Omwana oye agambie ense; korende ense ekonywe nere. 18 Oyomwanchire takogambigwa; oyotancheti otiekire kogambigwa, ekiagera atariancheti erieta ria Omwana oyomo bweka o Nyasaye. 19 Neke nakio ekina, ekiagera omobaso ochire ense, abanto bagancha omosunte kobua omobaso; naki ogokora kwabo kwarenge okobe. 20 Naki kera oyogokora amabe igagechete omobaso, gose tagocha as'omobaso, ogokora kwaye tikobaisa gokanigwa. 21 Korende oyogokora ekeene igagocha as'omobaso, ogokora kwaye kororekane ng'a iga gwakorirwe ase Nyasaye. 22 Nyuma as'aya Yesu naborokigwa baye bakagenda goika ense ya Boyahudi, akabera aroro amo nabarabwo okobatisa, 23 Yohana nere igarenge kobatisa aria Ainon, ang'e na Salim, ekiagera narenge amache amange: abanto bakomochiera bakobatiswa. 24 Naki Yohana konya tarabekwa echela. 25 Nabo, gokaoroka okoamererania as'aborokigwa ba Yohana n'Abayahudi as'amang'ana ogwesibia. 26 Bakamochiera Yohana, bakamotebia, Rabii, ere oyorenge amo naye ng'umbu ya Yorodan, oyio kwaorogetie aye, oyio nere nkobatisare, nabanto bonsi nkomochierabare. 27 Yohana akairaneria, akabora, Takonyara omonto konyora ring'ana rinde rionsi tatiga aegwe korwa igoro. 28 Inwe abanyene mwabaire kirori ng'a natebete, Inche tari Kristo, korende natomirwe gotang'ana asare. 29 Oyore nere omoriakari bw'enyangi nere omonene, korende omosani oye bw'omonene bw'enyangi iga agotenena nakomoigwa, origokera eriogi riaye omonene bw'enyangi: nabo oyo omogoko one oikeranire. 30 Ere nagwenerete amenteke, korende inche nkee. 31 Oyochire korwa igoro oyio igare igoro as'onsi: oyore bw'ense, noyo bw'ense, iga agokwana amang'ana ense: ere oyochire korwa igoro oyio igare igoro as'onsi. 32 Ayaroche nakoyaigwa, naro abereire kirori: gose onde tari oyobwanchire oborori bwaye. 33 Oyobwanchire oborori bwaye obekire ekemanyererio kiaye ng'a Nyasaye nekeene, 34 Naki ere oyotometwe na Nyasaye igakoyakwana amang'ana a Nyasaye: naki Nyasaye tari komoa Omoika as'ekerengo. 35 Tata omwanchire Omwana, omoeire bionsi as'amaboko aye. 36 Oyoramwanche Omwana nare nobogima bwa kare nakare; noyotamoigwereti Omwana takorora obogima, korende nendamwainu ya Nyasaye eramoikaransere.

english: 1 Now when the Pharisees learned that Jesus had been baptizing people and gaining more disciples than John— 2 though Jesus himself did not baptize, but his disciples did— 3 he left Judea and went back to Galilee. 4 As he traveled, he went through Samaria. 5 So he came to a town in Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground Jacob had given to his son Joseph. 6 Jacob’s well was there, and Jesus, tired from his journey, sat down beside the well. It was about noon. 7 A Samaritan woman came to draw water, so Jesus said to her, “Will you give me a drink?” 8 His disciples had gone to the town to buy food. 9 The Samaritan woman said to him, “You are a Jew, and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink?” (Jews do not associate with Samaritans.) 10 Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is that asks you for a drink, you would have asked him for living water.” 11 “Sir,” the woman said, “you don’t have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where can you get this living water? 12 Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did also his sons and his livestock?” 13 Jesus answered, “Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again, 14 but whoever drinks the water I give them will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give them will become in them a spring of water welling up to eternal life.” 15 The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water so that I won’t have to come here and draw water anymore.” 16 He told her, “Go, call your husband and come back.” 17 “I have no husband,” she replied. Jesus said to her, “You are right to say you have no husband. 18 For you have had five husbands, and the man you have now is not your husband. At this you spoke the truth.” 19 The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet. 20 Our ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews claim that the place to worship is in Jerusalem.” 21 Jesus said, “Believe me, dear woman, a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem. 22 You Samaritans worship what you do not know; we worship what we know, for salvation is from the Jews. 23 Yet a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in the Spirit and in truth, for they are the kind of worshipers the Father seeks. 24 God is spirit, and his worshipers must worship in the Spirit and in truth.” 25  The woman said, “I know that Messiah” (called Christ) “is coming. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.” 26 Jesus declared, “I, the one speaking to you, am he.” 27 Just then his disciples returned and were surprised to find him talking with a woman. But no one asked him, “What do you want?” or “Why are you talking with her.” 28 Then the woman left her water jar and went back to the town. “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did,” she said to the women. “Could this be the Messiah?” 29 They came out of the town and made their way toward him. 30 Meanwhile, his disciples urged him, “Rabbi, eat something.” 31 But he said to them, “I have food you cannot comprehend.” 32 “Surely not the food someone brought him to eat?” the disciples asked each other. 33 Jesus told them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work. 34 Don’t you have a saying, ‘Four months until harvest’? I tell you, look around and see that the fields are already ripe for harvest. 35 The reaper’s wages are substantial, and he gathers in fruit for eternal life. So that both the sower and the reaper may rejoice together. 36 For in this case, the saying holds true: ‘One sows and another reaps.’ 37 And I tell you that the person who harvests will receive a reward too, and the harvest yields an abundant crop. 38 I sent you to reap what you haven’t worked for. Others have done the hard work, and you have come to enjoy their efforts.” 39 Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in him because of the testimony of the woman who said, “He told me everything I ever did.” 40 So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there for two days, 41 and many more became believers because of his message. 42 They said to the woman, “We no longer believe just because of what you told us; we have heard him ourselves, and we know that he really is the Savior of the world.” 43 After the two days he left for Galilee. 44 Now Jesus himself had pointed out that a prophet has no honor in his own hometown. 45 So when he arrived in Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him, having seen all that he did in Jerusalem at the Passover festival. 46 Once again he visited Cana in Galilee, where he had turned the water into wine. There was a royal official whose son lay sick in Capernaum. 47 When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went to him and begged him to come down and heal his son. 48 “Sir,” he said, “come down before my child dies.” 49 Jesus replied, “Go home. Your son will live.” The man took Jesus’ word and departed. 50 While he was walking home, his servants met him with the good news that his son was recovering. 51 He asked them how much time it had taken, and they replied, “Yesterday afternoon the fever left him.” 52 Then his father realized this must have been the time when Jesus said to him, “Your son will live!” And so the whole household believed. 53 This second sign Jesus performed was in Cana of Galilee. He then went to Capernaum. 54 This was the second miracle Jesus performed, coming from Judea to Galilee.
ekegusii: 1 Nabo Omonene agachia komanya ng'a Abafarisai baigure ng'a Yesu okorire aborokigwa abange kobua Yohana, nakobatisa, 2 (Yesu omonyene tare kobatisa, korende naborokigwa baye), 3 akarua Boyahudi akagenda Galili eria kabere. 4 Naende nagwenerete goeta gati ya Samaria. 5 Nabo agaika omochie o Samaria, okorokwa Sukar, ang'e nomogondo oria Yakobo amoete Yusufu omwana oye: 6 naende agwo yarenge ensoko ya Yakobo. Nabo Yesu, konya orosire as'orogendo rwaye, agaikaransa iga as'ensoko. Konya yabaire ang'e chinsa isano nemo. 7 Agacha omokungu o Samaria kobucha amache: Yesu akamotebia, Ing'a amache inywe. 8 Naki aborokigwa baye konya bachire omochie kogora endagera. 9 Nabo oria omokungu bw'Abasamaria akamotebia, Naki yaba aye Omoyahudi korigia amache asende, nainche nomokungu bw'Abasamaria? (naki Abayahudi tibari gosanga n'Abasamaria.) 10 Yesu akairaneria akamotebia, Onye nkwamanya ekeegwa kia Nyasaye, nere ng'o okogotebia, Ing'a amache inywe; anga nkwamosaba ere, nere anga nakoa amache are moyo. 11 Oria omokungu akamotebia, Omonene, tori negento gi'okobuchera nensoko yachire inse mono: ng'ai kwayanyorire amache aya are moyo? 12 Inee! aye nomonene kobua tata oito Yakobo, oyotoete ensoko eye, nere omonyene akanywa amache aya, nabana baye bonsi netugo yaye? 13 Yesu akairaneria, akamotebia, Ker'oyokonywa amache aya narore erang'o naende: 14 korende onde bwonsi oyoranywe amache aria ndamoe inche, takoigwa erang'o kare nakare; korende amache aria ndanyare komoa nabe ime yaye ensoko y'amache, agosoka goika obogima bwa kare nakare. 15 Omokungu oria akamotebia, Omonene, ing'a amache ayio tindora erang'o, gose timbaisa gocha aiga kobucha. 16 Yesu akamotebia, Genda, omorangerie omosacha oo oche nere aiga. 17 Omokungu oria akairaneria akamotebia, tindi nomosacha. Yesu akamotebia, gwakwanire buya, tindi nomosacha: 18 naki kwabaire nabasacha batano; nere oyore nere bono tari omosacha oo: as'ayio gwakwanire ekeene. 19 Omokungu oria akamotebia, Omonene, narorire ng'a nomobani ore. 20 Abatata baito iga barenge gosasima as'egetunwa eke; nainwe iga mogoteba ng'a Yerusalemu naase atogwenerete togosasimera. 21 Yesu akamotebia, Aye omokungu, inyancha, ensa neche, motpmosasime Tata as'egetunwa eke, nonya nase Yerusalemu. 22 Inwe iga mogosasima eki motamanyeti: intwe iga togosasima ekitemanyete: naki ogotoreka gokorua as'Abayahudi. 23 Korende ensa neche, nabono nere, abare nogosaba kw'ekeene nabamosasime Tata as'omoika nekeene: naki Tata iga akobarigia abanto buna abwo bamosasime. 24 Nyasaye n'Omoika, nabwo bakomosasima nebagwenerete komosasima as'omoika nekeene. 25 Omokungu oria akamotebia, Namanyire ng'a ngochare Masihi (okorokwa Kristo): karache ere, natoorokerie onsi. 26 Yesu akamotebia, Inche ngokwana naye, nere. 27 Erio bagacha aborokigwa baye bagakumia ekiagera arenge gokwana nomokungu; korende onde tarenge kobora, Inki okorigia? gose, Naki ogokwana nere? 28 Nabo oria omokungu akayetiga enyongo yaye, akagenda omochie ka, akabatebia abanto, 29 Inchuo, morore omonto ontebirie amang'ana onsi ayanakorire: Inee! oyio tari ere Kristo? 30 Bakaimoka korwa omochie bakamochiera. 31 Agwo nyuma aborokigwa bakamosorora bakabora, Rabii, ragera. 32 Akabatebia, Inche ninde nendagera motayemanyeti inwe. 33 Aborokigwa baye bakaborania, Inee? nomonto omoretera endagera? 34 Yesu akabatebia, Endagera yane ney'ogokora obwanchani bwaye oyontomete, nagokora emeremo yaye. 35 Timori goteba inwe, Yatigaire emetienyi ene, erio riche rigesa? Nainche nabatebirie, Ramokia amaiso aino moyerigererie emegondo, ng'a yatiekire koba emerabu ang'e ase rigesa. 36 Oyo okogesa nkonyorare eng'eria, nagosangereria amatunda as'obogima bwa kare nakare; erinde ere oyogosimeka nere oyokogesa bagoke amo. 37 Naki ring'ana riria, Oyomo osimeka, oyonde ogesa, iga rire ekeene. 38 Inche nabatomete moyagese ayamotechandereti; abande bakorire emeremo, nainwe mwasoire as'emeremo yabo. 39 Naende as'omochie oria Abasaniaria abange bagancha as'engecho y'amang'ana ay'oria omokungu, atebete ng'a, Nantebia amang'ana onsi ayanakorire. 40 Nabo ekero baria Abasamaria bachia komochiera, bakamosorora aikaranse amo nabarabwo: agaikaransa aroro amatuko abere. 41 Abanto abange kobua bagancha as'engecho ye ring'ana riaye; 42 bakamotebia omokungu oria, Bono twanchire, tari ekiagera as'amang'ana ao: naki twaigure abanyene, naende twamanyire ekeene ng'a oyo n'Omekonyi bw'ense. 43 Nyuma as'amatuko ayio abere akaimoka korwa agwo, akagenda Galili. 44 Naki Yesu omonyene atebete, ng'a omobani tari nogosikwa as'ense yaye omonyene. 45 Nabo ekero achia goika Galili bakamwancha, ekiagera baroche amang'ana onsi ayakorete Yerusalemu ekero kie rituko rinene: naki nabarabwo bagenderete rituko rinene. 46 Agaika naende Kana ya Galili, agwo akorete amache akaba edivai. Naende yarenge esagini eyemo, yarenge nomwana omorwaire Kaperinaum. 47 Oyio agachia koigwa ng'a Yesu ochire korwa Boyahudi goika Galili, akamochiera, akamosorora achiche amokonye omwana oye; ekiagera konya oisire gokwa. 48 Nabo Yesu akamotebia, Motarochi ebikone namakumigwa timogwancha nonya ng'ake. 49 Oria esagini akamotebia, Omonene, ika ritang'ani atarakwa omwana one. 50 Yesu akamotebia, Bwatia enchera yao: omwana oo moy'are. Omonto oria akariancha riria ring'ana atebetigwe na Yesu, akabwatia enchera. 51 Goika agachia koba ogoika, abasomba baye bagacha komorotota, bakamotebia, bakabora, Omwana oo moy'are. 52 Erio akababoria amang'ana ensa achagete koba buya. Bakamotebia, Igoro, chinsa isano naibere, esosera yamotigete. 53 Erio ise akainyora ng'a nensa eria eria atebetigwe na Yesu, Omwana oo moy'are: agancha ere, nenyomba yaye yonsi. 54 Neke negekone gia kabere akorete Yesu korwa ekero aruete Boyahudi kogenda Galili.

english: 1 Now there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem. 2 Near the Sheep Gate there is a pool called Bethesda, which has five porticoes. 3 Here lay a great number of people who were sick—blind, lame, paralyzed—waiting for the water to be stirred. 4 An angel would come down and stir the water, and whoever went in first would be healed. 5 One man was lying there who had been ill for thirty-eight years. 6 When Jesus saw him lying there and knew he had been there a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to get well?” 7 The sick man answered, “Sir, I have no one to help me get into the pool when the water is stirred. By the time I get there, someone else goes down ahead of me.” 8 Jesus told him, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk.” 9 At once the man was cured; he picked up his mat and began to walk. 10 It was the Sabbath day when this happened. 11 So the Jews said to the man who had been healed, “It is against our law for you to carry your mat on the Sabbath.” 12 He replied, “The man who made me well said to me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’” 13 They asked him, “Who is this who told you to pick it up and walk?” 14 Later Jesus found him at the temple and said to him, “See, you are well again. Stop sinning or something worse may happen to you.” 15 The man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well. 16 Because of this, the Jews persecuted Jesus and tried to kill him because he did such things on the Sabbath. 17 But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, and I also am working.” 18 For this reason the Jews tried all the more to kill him, because not only was he breaking the Sabbath, but he was also calling God his Father, making himself equal to God. 19 Then Jesus explained, “Very truly I tell you, the Son can do nothing by himself; he can do only what he sees his Father doing. Whatever the Father does, the Son does also. 20 For the Father loves the Son and shows him all he does. Yes, and he will show him even greater works than these. 21 All those the Father gives me will come to me, and I will never reject anyone who comes to me. 22 For I have come down from heaven not to do my own will but to do the will of the one who sent me. 23 And this is the will of the one who sent me—that everyone who believes in me should have eternal life, and I shall raise them up on the last day.”  24 Very truly I tell you, whoever believes has eternal life now. 25 Very truly I tell you, a time is coming and has already arrived when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live. 26 For just as the Father has life within himself, so he has granted the Son to have life within himself. 27 And he has given him authority to judge because he is the Son of Man. 28 So do not be surprised at my saying, “You must be born again.” 29 The wind blows wherever it pleases. You hear its sound, but you cannot tell where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.” 30 “We know that you are a teacher come from God,” they replied. 31 Jesus answered, “Believe in me! If you believe, you will know that I am in my Father and my Father is in me.” 32 “These words I am saying to you are not just my own. Rather, it is the Father, living in me, who is doing his work. 33 Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; or at least believe on the evidence of the works I have done. 34 I tell you the truth, whoever believes in me will do the same works I have done, and even greater ones. 35  Because I am going to the Father, and you will see me no longer. 36 Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father.” 37 Jesus answered, “Don’t you know me, Philip, even after I have been among you such a long time? Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’? 38 Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and that the Father is in me? The words I say to you are not just my own. Rather, it is the Father, living in me, who is doing his work. 39 Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; or at least believe on the evidence of the works I have done. 40 Don’t you believe that I am in the Father and that the Father is in me? 41 I tell you the truth, whoever believes in me will do the same works I have done, and even greater ones. 42 Do you believe that I am in the Father and that the Father is in me? 43 I have told you this, so that when it happens, you will believe. 44 But when the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth, who goes out from the Father—he will testify about me. 45 And I tell you the truth, whoever believes in me will also do what I have done. Indeed, they will do greater things, because I am going to the Father. 46 If you ask something of my Father in my name, he will give it to you. 47 Yet you don’t ask me anything.
ekegusii: 1 Nyuma as'aya ndiarenge rituko rinene ri'Abayahudi; Yesu agatira kogenda Yerusalemu. 2 Naende aria Yerusalemu as'egesieri kie ching'ondi ndiarenge ritibo rikorokwa as'Ekeibirania Bethesaida, narirorio mbiarengeo ebisoero bitano. 3 Ime as'ebio mbarenge abanto abange abarwaire bakorara, emeuko, chirema, ab'ebimo biabo biomire, baganyete amache aseroke. 4 Naki ekero gete rilaika ngoika riarenge riasoa ase riria ritibo, koyaturubania amache: nabo ere oyore gosoa ritang'ani nyuma as'amache agoturubanigwa, igare kogwena oborwaire bwonsi obwamonyorete. 5 Narenge aroro omonto gete oyorenge noborwaire bw'emiaka emerongo etato netano netato. 6 Yesu agachia komorora oyio oraire, akamanya ng'a obaire engecho eye amatuko amange, akamotebia, Norigetie koba omogima? 7 Oria omorwaire akamoiraneria, Omonene, tindi nomonto okombeka ritibo ime, amache gagoturubanigwa: korende ekero ngochicha inche, omonto onde osoa ritang'ani asende. 8 Yesu akamotebia, Tenena, etweke egesero kiao, ogende. 9 Erio kegima omonto oria akaba omogima, agetweka egesero kiaye, akagenda. Nabo yarenge esabato rituko riria. 10 Abayahudi bakamotebia oria okonyetwe, Rero nesnbato, tari boronge asore gwetweka egesero kiao. 11 Akabairaneria, Ere oyonkora koba omogima nere ontebia, Etweke egesero kiao, ogende. 12 Bakamoboria, Oria ogotebia, Etweke egesero kiao ogende, ning'o? 13 Korende oria ogwenetigwe tamomanyete gose ning'o: naki Yesu erusananetie, ekiagera barenge abanto abange aas'aria. 14 Nyuma as'aya Yesu akamonyora hekalu itne, akamotebia, Rora, kwabaire omogima: tokora ebibe naende, ring'ana rire ribe kobua tiricha gokonyora. 15 Oria omonto akagenda, akabatebia Abayahudi amang'ana ng'a Yesu nere onkorete nkaba omogima. 16 As'ayio Abayahudi bagachaka komochanda Yesu, bakarigia komoita, ekiagera akora aya rituko ri'esabato. 17 Yesu akabairaneria, Tata one ngokorare emeremo nonya ngoika bono, nainche ngokorande emeremo. 18 Nabo ekiagera as'aya Abayahudi bakamenta korigia komoita, ekiagera atasareti esabato yoka, korende amo naya namorogete Nyasaye Tata oye, ogwekora koreng'ana buna Nyasaye. 19 Yesu akairaneria, akabatebia, Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Omwana takonyara gokora ring'ana ere bweka, tatiga riria amororire Tata agokora: naki onsi agokora ere ayio naio n'Omwana agokora, 20 Naki Tata amwanchire Omwana, okomworokia onsi ayagokora omonyene: nemeremo emenene kobua eyeiga namworokie erinde inwe monyare gokumia. 21 Naki buna Tata akobibokia ebitondo nakobia obogima, naboigo n'Omwana akobaa obogima abarigetie. 22 Ekiagera Tata tari komogambia omonto onde bwonsi, korende omoire Omwana okogamba gwonsi; 23 erinde bonsi bamosike Omwana, buna bamosigete Tata. Oyotamosigeti Omwana tamosigeti Tata omotomete, 24 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, oyokoigwa ring'ana riane, nakomwancha ere oyontomete nare nobogima bwa kare nakare, gose tagoika as'ekina, korende oetire korwa as'amakweri goika as'obogima. 25 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Ensa ngochere, nabono nere, ebitondo biraigwe eriogi ri'Omwana o Nyasaye; nabaria bakorigwa nababe moyo. 26 Naki buna Tata are nobogima ime yaye omonyene; naboigo omoeire n'Omwana koba nobogima ime yaye omonyene: 27 akamoa okobua kw'ogokora ekina ekiagera ere n'Omwana-o-mwanyabanto. 28 Timokumia as'aya: naki ensa ngochere, ekero abanto bonsi bare ase chimbera ime baraigwe eriogi riaye, 29 nabarabwo nabasoke; baria abare gokora amaya as'okobokigwa kw'obogima; nabaria abakorire amabe as'okobokigwa gw'ekina. 30 Inche omonyene tinkonyara gokora kende gionsi: buna nkoigwa, nabo nkogamba: nekina kiane iga kere boronge; ekiagera tindi koborigia obwanchani bwane, korende nobwanchani bwaye Tata oyontomete. 31 Inche kondetebe omonyene, ogoteba kwane tari okw'ekeene. 32 Nare oyonde oyokombera kirori; nainche namanyire ng'a oborori bwaye agonteba nobw'ekeene, 33 Inwe mwatomete abanto ase Yohana, noborori bwaye nekeene. 34 Korende inche tindi konyora oborori korwa as'abanto: korende iga ngokwana aya erinde inwe mokonyeke. 35 Ere igarenge etaya egwoka nakomoreka: nainwe mwanchire koyosasokera omobaso oye ekero egeke. 36 Korende oborori nde naborobwo nobonene, kobua boria bwa Yohana: naki emeremo eria naetwe na Tata inyekore, emeremo eyio eyio nayekorire, yambereire kirori ng'a Tata nere ontomete. 37 Nere Tata ontomete obaire kirori asende. Eriogi riaye timwanya korigwa kero kende gionsi, gose ekieni kiaye timorakerora; 38 naende ring'ana riaye timori narirorio ime yaino: naki inwe timwancheti ere oyotomirwe nere. 39 Iga mokorigiarigia mono amariko, ekiagera mokagete ng'a inwe more nobogima bwa kare nakare ime yaye, nayio naro are kirori asende; 40 ko mwangire gocha asende, monyare koba nobogima. 41 Tindi konyora obonene as'abanto. 42 Korende nabsmanyire inwe ng'a timori nobwanchani bwa Nyasaye ime yaino. 43 Inche nachire as'erieta ria Tata one nainwe timori konyancha: oyonde karache as'eiieta riaye omonyene, namomwanche oyio. 44 Naki moranyare gwancha inwe abamokoenana obonene inwe as'inwe, nobonene boria bokorua ase Nyasaye ore bweka timori koborigia? 45 Timokaga ng'a inche nimbasoere ase Tata: nare oyokobasoera, nere Musa, oyomosemeretie inwe. 46 Naki onye mwamwanchete Musa, anga mwanyancha inche; ekiagera nere origete amang'ana ane. 47 Korende motayancheti amariko aye, naki morayanche amang'ana ane?

english: 1 After these things Jesus went over the Sea of Galilee, to Capernaum; 2 and a large crowd followed him, because they saw the signs he was performing on those who were sick. 3 Jesus got into a boat and crossed the sea to Capernaum. 4 Many people followed him, seeking his miracles. 5 When Jesus looked up and saw a great crowd coming toward him, he said to Philip, “Where shall we buy bread to feed them?” 6 He asked this only to test him, for he already knew what he was going to do. 7 Philip answered him, “Eight months’ wages would not buy enough bread for each of them to get a little.” 8 One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, spoke up. 9 “Here is a boy with five small barley loaves and two small fish, but what good are these for so many?” 10 Jesus said, “Tell them to sit down.” So he made the people sit down in the grass. There were about five thousand men there. 11 Then Jesus took the loaves and gave thanks, and distributed them to those who were seated, and likewise the fish as much as they wanted. 12 When everyone had eaten their fill, twelve baskets of broken pieces were collected. 13 They gathered them up, leaving none of the fish wasted. 14 When the people saw the sign he performed, they began saying, “Surely this is the Prophet who is coming into the world!” 15 But Jesus, knowing that they intended to come and make him king, withdrew again to the mountains by himself. 16 Later that evening, his disciples went down to the shore, and got into a boat and started across the lake toward Capernaum. It was already dark when a strong wind came up. 17 As they rowed, they struggled against the waves, because the wind was against them. 18 About three or four miles from land, they saw Jesus walking on the water and coming toward the boat. This terrified them. 19 But he said to them, “It is I; don’t be afraid.” 20 They were willing to take him aboard, and the boat reached the shore where they were heading. 21 The next day, the crowd that had stayed on the opposite side of the lake realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus hadn’t gone with them in it. 22 However, the following day, people who had remained on the other side of the lake gathered together and waited for Jesus, hoping he would come. 23 When they found him, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you get here?” 24 Jesus replied, “Truly I tell you, you are looking for me not because you saw the signs I performed but because you ate the loaves and had your fill. 25 When they had crossed the lake, they came to Capernaum, and Jesus said to them, “Where did you get the bread?”  26 He answered, “Our father Jacob gave us this bread.” 27 Then Jesus told them, “I am the bread of life; whoever comes to me will never be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty. 28 “But as I told you, you have seen me and still you do not believe. 29 All those the Father gives me will come to me, and whoever comes to me I will never drive away. 30 So the Jews protested, “What sign can you show us to prove your authority?” 31 Jesus said to them, “Very truly I tell you, Moses didn’t give your ancestors the bread from heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread from heaven. 32 For the bread of God is the one who comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.” 33 “Sir,” they said, “give us that bread continually.” 34 Jesus declared, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not hunger, and whoever believes in me will not thirst. 35 “But as I have told you, you have seen me and yet you do not believe. 36 Very truly I tell you, whoever believes has eternal life. 37 My Father gives them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one will snatch them out of my hand. 38 My Father has given them to me, and he has kept them safe. No one can take them from my Father’s hand. 39 My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all; no one can snatch them out of my Father’s hand. 40 And I have given them eternal life, and they will never perish; no one will snatch them out of my hand. 41 The Jews complained about him because he said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.” 42 They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph? We know his father and mother. How can he say, ‘I came down from heaven’?” 43 Jesus replied, “Stop complaining among yourselves. 44 No one can come to me unless the Father draws them, and I will raise them up at the last day. 45 It is written in the Prophets: ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him comes to me. 46 Not everyone has seen the Father; only the one who is sent by the Father has seen him. 47 “Very truly I tell you, whoever believes has eternal life. 48 I am the bread of life. 49 Your ancestors ate manna in the wilderness, yet they died. 50 But here is the bread that comes down from heaven, which anyone may eat and not die. 51 I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will live forever. This bread is my flesh. 52 The Jews argued sharply among themselves, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?” 53 Jesus said to them, “Very truly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you. 54 Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day. 55 For my flesh is real food and my blood is real drink. 56 Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in them. 57 As the living Father sent me and I live because of the Father, so whoever feeds on me will live because of me. 58 This is the bread that came down from heaven; your ancestors ate manna and died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.” 59 He said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum. 60 Many of his disciples turned back and no longer followed him. 61 Jesus said, “Does this offend you? Then what if you should see the Son of Man going back up where he came from? 62 What if you should see the Spirit ascending to where it came from? The Spirit gives life; the flesh counts for nothing. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and life. 63 But there are some among you who do not believe.” Jesus knew from the beginning which ones did not believe and who would betray him. 64 That is why he said, “This is why I told you that no one can come to me unless the Father has enabled him.” 65 At this point many of his disciples turned away and stopped following him. 66 Jesus said, “Does this upset you? Then what about when you see the Son of Man ascend to where he was before? 67 The Spirit gives life; the flesh counts for nothing. The words I have spoken to you are spirit and life. 68 Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life. 69 We have come to believe and to know that you are the Holy One of God.” 70 Jesus replied, “Have I not told you all this? Then why do you doubt my words? 71 It was Judas, son of Simon Iscariot, who betrayed him. One of his disciples was Judas, who betrayed him.
ekegusii: 1 Nyuma as'aya Yesu akagenda ng'umbu y'enyancha ya Galili, nero enyancha ya Tiberia; 2 Omoganda omonene okamotunyana, ekiagera baroche ebikone abakorerete abarwaire. 3 Yesu akarina egetunwa, agaikaransa agwo amo naborokigwa baye. 4 Naende epasaka, rituko rinene ri'Abayahudi, yarenge ang'e. 5 Nabo Yesu agachia koramokia amaiso aye, akarora omoganda omonene ogocha asare, akamotebia Filipo, Ng'ai tokogora emegati, aba banyare koria? 6 Iga aborete aya erinde amoteme: naki amanyete omonyene ekiarakore. 7 Filipo akamoiraneria, Emegati ye chidinari chimia ibere tekobaisana, ker'oyomo anyore omoke bwoka. 8 Oyomo bw'aborokigwa baye, Anderea, momura omwabo Simon Petero, akamotebia, 9 Naraa omosae, oyore nemegati etano y'engano ne chinswe ibere: korende ebi inki as'abanto abange buna iga? 10 Yesu akabora, baikaransie abanto. Mbwarenge aroro obonyansi obonge aase aria. Nabo abasacha bagaikaransa, omobaro obo chilifu isano. 11 Yesu akayebogoria emegati; gasesenirie, akabagabera abaikaransete: naboigo nachiria chinswe koreng'ana buna barigetie. 12 Kobachia koigota, akabatebia aborokigwa baye, Sangereria ebisamunye biatigaire, 'gento tigesira. 13 Nabo bakabisangereria, bagaichoria ebitonga ikomi nabibere as'ebisamunye bi'emegati etano y'engano, ebiatigarete as'abwo bariete. 14 Ekero abanto baria, bachia korora egekone akorete Yesu, bakabora, oyo ekeene nomobani oria ochire as'ense. 15 Nabo Yesu, akamanya ng'a mbarigetie gocha komoira erinde bamokore omoruoti, akerusanania, akagenda naende egetunwa, ere bweka. 16 Egachia koba mogoroba, aborokigwa baye bagatirimboka gochia 'nyancha; 17 bakarina obwato ime bagachaka kwamboka enyancha kogenda Kaperinaum. Naende omosunte konya obaire, na konya Yesu tarabachichera. 18 Enyancha egachaka koimoka, as'engecho y'embeo enyinge yagusete. 19 Nabo kabang'usire obwato chimaili isato gose inye, bakamorora Yesu okogenda igoro as'enyancha, ogoika ang'e as'obwato: bakairoka. 20 Akabatebia, Ninche, timoiroka. 21 Bagancha komosoyia obwato ime: erio kegima obwato bogaika ense barenge kogenda. 22 Inkio yaye omoganda oteneine ng'umbu y'enyancha bakarora ng'a obwato bonde tibwarenge aroro, tatiga boria obomo basoete aborokigwa baye, naende ng'a Yesu tasoete as'obwato boria amo naborokigwa baye korende naborokigwa baye bagendete boka. 23 (Korende amato ande agacha korwa Tiberia ang'e naas'aria bariete emegati ekero Omonene asesenetie): 24 ekero omoganda ochia korora ng'a Yesu tari aroro, nonya naborokigwa baye, barabwo abanyene bagasoa amato ime, bakagenda Kaperinaum bakomorigia Yesu. 25 Goika bagachia komorora ng'umbu as'enyancha, bakamotebia, Rabii, indi gwachete aa? 26 Yesu akabairaneria, akabatebia, Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Iga mokondigia, tari ekiagera mwaroche ebikone, korende ekiagera mwariete eria emegati, mokaigota. 27 Timoyekorera endagera eyegosareka, korende endagera ekobao goika obogima bwa kare nakare, Omwana-o-mwanyabanto aranyare kobaa: naki oyo nere obegetwe ekemanyererio na Tata, engecho yaye, Nyasaye. 28 Nabo bakamotebia, Ninki togokora tonyare koyekora emeremo ya Nyasaye? 29 Yesu akairaneria, akabatebia, Eye nero emeremo ya Nyasaye, momwanche ere oyotomirwe nere. 30 Bakamotebia, Mbikone ki gwakorire erinde torore twanche? 'Meremo ki ogokora? 31 Abatata baito mbariete manna as'eroro ime; buna yarigetwe, Nabaete omogati korwa igoro barie. 32 Yesu akabatebia, Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Tari Musa obaete omogati oria oruete igoro; korende n'Tata one okobaa omogati bw'ekeene okorua igoro. 33 Naki omogati o Nyasaye noria ogoika korwa igoro, nakoyea ense obogima. 34 Nabo, bakamotebia, Omonene, amatuko onsi otoe omogati oyio. 35 Yesu akabatebia, Inche nomogati bw'obogima: ere oyogocha asende takoigwa enchara naende, nere oyoranyanche takoigwa erang'o nonya ng'ake. 36 Korende nabatebirie ng'a mwandorire ko timonyancheti. 37 Bonsi Omonene akong'a nabache asende; nere oyogocha asende tinkomotuguta isiko nonya ng'ake. 38 Naki ting'igeti korwa igoro erinde nkore obwanchani bwane, korende obwanchani bwaye oyontomete. 39 Naende obwanchani bwaye Tata oyontomete nabw'obo, ng'a ase bonsi ang'eire tinsiria egento nonya nekemo, korende mbabokie ase rituko ri'omoerio. 40 Nobwanchani bwaye oyontomete nabw'obo, ng'a ker'oyokomorigereria Omwana nakomwancha, nabe nobogima bwa kare nakare; ninche nimobokie ase rituko ri'omoerio. 41 Abayahudi bakamwemurunganeria, as'engecho atebete, Inche nomogati oigete korwa igoro. 42 Bakabora, Oyo tari Yesu, omwana o Yusufu, ntobamanyete ise na ng'ina? Naki akobora oyo, Naikire korwa igoro? 43 Yesu akairaneria, akabatebia, Timwemurungania inwe as'inwe. 44 Omonto onde tari oranyare gocha asende, atang'usiri na Tata oyontomete: nainche nimobokie ase rituko ri'omoerio. 45 Nerikire as'ababani, Na bonsi naborokererigwe na Nyasaye. Kera oyokoigwa nakweorokereria ase Tata, igagocha asende. 46 Tari ng'a omonto omororire Tata, tatiga ere orure ase Nyasaye, oyio nere omororire Tata. 47 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Ere oyoranyanche inche nare nobogima bwa kare nakare. 48 Inche nomogati bw'obogima. 49 Abaiso baino mbariete manna eroro ime, naende bagakwa. 50 Oyo nomogati oikire korwa igoro, erinde omonto orayorie, tagokwa. 51 Inche nomogati bw'obogima oigete korwa igoro: omonto kararie omogati oyio, nabe moyo goika kare nakare: nomogati ndarue inche nomobere one, as'engecho y'obogima bw'ense. 52 Erio Abayahudi bakaamererania barabwo ase barabwo, bakabora, Naki omonto oyo aranyare gotoa intwe omobere oye toyorie? 53 Yesu akabatebia, Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Motayorieti omobere oye Omwana-o-mwanyabanto na koyanywa amanyinga aye, timori nobogima ime yaino. 54 Oyokoyoria omobere one nakoyanywa amanyinga ane nare nobogima bwa kare nakare: nainche nimobokie rituko ri'omoerio. 55 Naki omobere one nendagera y'ekeene, namanyinga ane nekenyugwa ki'ekeene, 56 oyokoyoria omobere one nakoyanywa amanyinga ane igagoikaransa ime asende, nainche ime yaye. 57 Buna Tata are moyo antomete, nainche inde moyo as'engecho ya Tata; koreng'ana ere oyorandie, nabe moyo as'engecho yane. 58 Oyio nomogati oikire kojwa igoro: tari buna abaiso baino bariete manna, bagakwa: oyorarie omogati oyio nabe moyo kare nakare. 59 Amang'ana aya iga ayakwanete esunagogi, kare kworokereria aria Kaperinaum. 60 Nabo abanto abange as'aborokigwa baye bagachia koigwa aya, bakabora, Ring'ana eri nerikong'u; ing'o oranyare korigwa? 61 Ko Yesu akamanya as'omoyo oye ng'a aborokigwa baye bariemurunganeirie ring'ana eri, akabatebia, Ring'ana eri ndiabagochirie? 62 Naki erabe rende, komoramorore Omwana-o-mwanyabanto okorina aria aas'arenge ritang'ani? 63 Omoika noro okobeka obogima; omobere togwenereti gento: amang'ana nabatebirie nomoika, naende nobogima. 64 Korende mbare abande as'egati yaino batancheti. Naki Yesu amanyete korwa omochakano mbarabi abatancheti naende ning'o oranyare komorua. 65 Akabora, As'engecho eye nabatebirie, ng'a omonto onde tari oranyare gocha asende, tatiga oeirwe na Tata one. 66 As'engecho y'aya abange as'aborokigwa baye bakairana nyuma, tibamotunya naende. 67 Erio Yesu akabatebia ikomi nababere, Nainwe morigetie kogenda? 68 Simon Petero akamoiraneria, Omonene! togende ase ng'o? Aye nore namang'ana obogima bwa kare nakare. 69 Naintwe twanchire, naende twamanyire ng'a aye naye Omochenu o Nyasaye. 70 Yesu akabairaneria, Inee! timbachoreti inwe ikomi nababere, noyomo oino nekerecha? 71 Iga amotebete Yudas, omwana o Simon Omoisikariota, ekiagera oyo nere oranyare komorua: nere noyomo bw'ikomi nababere.

english: 1 After this, Jesus traveled about Galilee. He did not go to Judea because the Jewish leaders were looking for him to kill him. 2 Now the Jews’ Feast of Tabernacles was very near. 3 His brothers said to him, “Leave here and go to Judea, so that your disciples may see the miracles you do. 4 No one does miracles in secret. If you are doing these things, show yourself to the world.” 5 For even his own brothers did not believe in him. 6 Jesus said to them, “My time has not yet come, but yours does. 7 The world hates me because I testify against it and say that its ways are wrong. 8 I am going to a place where you cannot follow. 9 They said to him, “Where are you going?” Jesus replied, “I am going to the Father.” 10 They did not understand what he meant. 11 So Jesus said again, “I am going away, and you will look for me, but you will die in your sins. Where I go, you cannot come.” 12 The Jews argued among themselves, “What does he mean when he says that we will die in our sins?” 13 Many believed in him. 14 Nicodemus, who had previously visited Jesus at night, came to him and asked, 15 “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher sent from God. No one can do such signs as you do unless God is with him.” 16 Jesus answered, “I told you that I do not receive glory from people. 17 But you seek glory only from each other and do not strive to please God. How can you believe if you don’t care about the honor that comes from the only God? 18 People who truly want to do what God wants will recognize my teachings as being from God. 19 So I tell you, anyone who hears my words and believes them has eternal life and won’t be judged. 20 I have come to judge the world, not to condemn it. Anyone who believes in me will not be condemned. 21 Those who reject me will be judged. 22 Moses gave you the law, but none of you obey it! 23 If you really obeyed Moses, you would accept me, because he wrote about me. 24 But you don’t believe what he wrote. 25 The people of Jerusalem asked, “Isn’t this the man they are trying to kill? 26 And yet, here he is speaking plainly!” 27 They didn’t realize that he was the Messiah. 28 So Jesus said, “When you lift up the Son of Man, then you will understand that I am the Messiah.” 29 He continued, “I do nothing on my own initiative. I only say what the Father tells me to say. 30 What I say is what he tells me, and I know that his command gives eternal life. 31 As Moses commanded us, so we have been given the law.” 32 The crowd replied, “We have heard the law from our ancestors, and it says that the Messiah will live forever.” 33 Jesus said, “You study the Scriptures thinking they give you eternal life, but they point to me. 34 Don’t misunderstand me! I am telling you that whoever believes in me already has eternal life. 35 I am the light that shines in the darkness, and if you follow me, you won’t stumble. 36 While I am still with you, you have the light. 37 But when I am gone, you will still have the light within you.” 38 Some of the teachers of the law noticed that Jesus had spoken this way, so they challenged him, saying, “Where are you going?” 39 Jesus replied, “I am going where you can’t come.” 40 Then they asked, “What does this mean?” 41 They were talking about his death, which they thought would be an ordinary death, but he was actually speaking about returning to the Father. 42 Many people believed in him because of what he said. 43 Nicodemus, who had previously visited Jesus at night, spoke up, “Our law teaches that the Messiah will come from David’s family and from Bethlehem, the town where David lived.” 44 So why do you say that he comes from Galilee? 45 The crowd argued among themselves, some saying, “He really is the Messiah!” 46 Others asked, “How can the Messiah come from Galilee? Doesn’t the Scripture say that he will come from David’s town?” 47 The Pharisees were disturbed by this discussion. 48 One of them, Nicodemus, asked, “Is it possible that he is the Messiah?” 49 Other Pharisees retorted, “You aren’t from Galilee too, are you? 50 No one from Galilee has ever produced a prophet!” 51 Nicodemus answered, “Does our law allow us to judge someone without giving him a fair hearing?” 52 They replied, “Are you defending him? Are you suggesting that he might be the Messiah?” 53 Nicodemus said, “I don’t know anything about that.” 54 Then they scoffed at him and said, “You are one of them! We know you believe in him.”
ekegusii: 1 Nyuma as'aya Yesu akaba ogotara ase Galili: naki tarigetie gotara ase Boyahudi, ekiagera Abayahudi iga barenge korigia komoita. 2 Naende rituko rinene ri'Abayahudi, rituko rinene ri'ebigutu, iga riarenge ang'e, 3 Abamwabo bakamotebia, Imoka korwa aiga ogende Boyahudi, aborokigwa bao nabarabwo banyare koyerora emeremo yao eyogokora. 4 Naki omonto onde tari ogokora ring'ana bobisi, naende ere omonyene narigetie komanyekana. Kogokora aya, eorokie as'ense. 5 Naki nonya nabamwabo tibamwanchete. 6 Yesu akabatebia, Tikeraika ekero kiane; korende ekero kiaino botambe nkere ang'e. 7 Ense tekonyara kobagecha inwe; korende iga ekongecha inche, ekiagera inche nkoyeteba ng'a emeremo yaye nemebe. 8 Tira inwe mogende ase rituko rinene: inche tingotira kogenda ase rituko eri; ekiagera ekero kiane tikeraika. 9 Agachia gokora kobatebia aya, agaikaransa ase Galili. 10 Goika ekero abamwabo bachia gotira, erio nere agatira kogenda ase rituko rinene, tari maiso marore korende ase bobisi. 11 Nabo Abayahudi bakamorigia ase rituko erio bakabora, Ng'ai are oyio? 12 Gokaba okwemurungania okonene as'emeganda as'engecho yaye: abande bakobora, Igare omonto omuya; nabande bakobora, Taibo, korende igagosiria emeganda. 13 Korende omonto tari omwatorete maiso marore ekiagera as'okobairoka Abayahudi. 14 Goika egachia koba gati gati ye rituko rinene Yesu agatira, agasoa hekalu ime akorokereria, 15 Abayahudi bakamokumia, bakabora, Naki amanyete obong'aini, nere tarasoma? 16 Yesu akabairaneria akabora, Okworokereria kwane tari okwane, korende nokwaye ere oyontomete. 17 Omonto karanche kobokora obwanchani bwaye, namanye amang'ana okworokereria oko, ng'a kwarure ase Nyasaye, gose ninche ngweteba omonyene. 18 Ere oyogwekwana bweka omo nyene iga akorigia obonene bwaye omonyene: korende ere oyokorigia obonene bwaye oyomotomete, oyio noyo bw'ekeene, nonya ime yaye tibori obobe. 19 Oyo obaete amachiko tari Musa? korende tari oyomo oino okorete amachiko? Naki mokorigia kong'ita? 20 Emeganda ekairaneria, ekabora, Nore nekerecha: ning'o okorigia gogoita? 21 Yesu akairaneria, akabatebia, Nakorete omoremo oyomo, nainwe mwensi mwakumirie. 22 Ekiagera as'aya Musa abaete okwaroka, (tari ng'a iga kwaruete ase Musa korende ase chisokoro chiaino); nainwe rituko ri'esabato iga mokomosara omonto. 23 Gaki onye omonto ogasarwa rituko ri'esabato, ogochika kwa Musa tigochagosareka; naki mokombea ekiagera namokora omonto koba omogima kegima rituko ri'esabato? 24 Timogamba ekina as'engecho y'ekieni, korende kora ekina kere kia boronge. 25 Erio ensemo y'abanto ba Yerusalemu bakabora, Oyo tari ere bakorigia komoita? 26 Ani! iga agokwana maiso marore gose tibari komotebia ing'ana? Bori abanene bamanyire ng'a nere Kristo? 27 Korende oyo twamanyire ase arure, korende Kristo karache, onde tari oramanye as'akorua. 28 Erio Yesu akaaka eriogi riaye ase hekalu, okworokereria, okobora, Inche mwamanyire, aase narure mwaamanyire: naende tinchicheti as'inche omonyene, tatiga ere oyontomete noyo bw'ekeene, motamomanyeti inwe. 29 Korende inche namomanyire; ekiagera narure asare, nere ontomire. 30 Gaki bakarigia komobwata: korende onde tari oramborete okoboko kwaye erinde amobwate ekiagera ensa yaye konya teraika. 31 Abanto abange as'emeganda bakamwancha; bakabora, Karachiche Kristo, inee! nakore ebikone ebinge mono kobua ebiga akorire oyo? 32 Abafarisai bakayeigwa emeganda bakwemurungania as'engecho yaye; Abafarisai nabakuani abanene bagatoma abarendi erinde bamobwate. 33 Erio Yesu akabora, nkere ekero egeke inde amo nainwe, erio ningende asare ere oyontomete. 34 Namondigie korende timokonyora; naase inde inche, timokonyara gocha. 35 Nabo Abayahudi bagatchania barabwo ase barabwo, Oyo ng'ai aragende goika intwe titonionyora? Nagende as'Ogwatananeka kw'Abayunani nakoborokereria Abayunani? 36 Ing'ana ki erio akwana, Namondigie korende timokonyora, naase inde inche, inwe timokonyara gocha? 37 Nase rituko ri'omoerio, rituko riria rinene, Yesu agatenena. agakwana neriogi, okobora, Omonto karabe nerang'o, tiga ache asende any we. 38 Oyonyanchire inche buna amariko agoteba, chindoche chi'amache obogima namorue as'enda yaye. 39 Ring'ana eri igarikwanete as'engecho y'Omoika, ekiagera baria abamwanchire nabayonyore nyuma, naki Omoika Omochenu konya torarugwa; ekiagera Yesu konya taraimokererigwa igoro. 40 Nabo abanto abange as'omoganda bagachia koigwa amang'ana ayio, bakabora, Oyo ekeene nomobani oria. 41 Abande bakabora, Oyo nere Kristo. Korende abande bakabora, Inee, Kristo iga ararue Galili? 42 Okorika tikori goteba ng'a Kristo igagocha as'okoibora gwa Daudi, naende ase Bethilehemu, agachie karia aikaransete Daudi? 43 Eriogogasoa as'emeganda ogwatananeka as'engecho yaye. 44 Ensemo yabo bakarigia komobwata; korende omonto taramborete okoboko kwaye erinde amobwate, 45 Baria abarendi bakabachiera abakuani abanene n'Abafarisai; nabarabwo bakabatebia, Naki motamoreta? 46 Baria abarendi bakairaneria, Tarakwana omonto onde bwonsi buna oyo agokwana. 47 Erio Abafarisai bakabairaneria, Inee! inwe nainwe mwang'ainekire? 48 Ning'o as'abanene bamwanchire, gose as'Abafarisai? 49 Korende emesangerereko eyio etamanyete amachiko baragererigwe. 50 Nikodemo akabatebia (noria omochierete botuko, ekiagera noyomo obo), 51 Inee! ogochika gwaito nkonacherware omonto ekina gotoramoigwa ritang'ani nakomanya eki akora? 52 Bakairaneria, bakamotebia, Naye Galili kwarua? Rigia, orore ng'a korua Galili taorogete omobani. 53 Bakagenda ker'omonto 'nyomba mwaye.

english: 52 Concerning the resurrection, when you see the signs and wonders in Galilee, what will you think? Truly, I tell you, the Galileans who were with me have already gone ahead. 53 But we will go up to Jerusalem.
ekegusii: 1 Korende Yesu akagenda as'egetunwa kie Emezeituni. 2 Mambia chuni agasoa naende hekalu ime, abanto bonsi bakamogendera; nere agaikaransa akaborokereria. 3 Abariki n'Abafarisai bakareta omokungu obwatetwe as'ogotomana; kabamobekire gati gati, 4 bakamotebia, Omworokia, omokungu oyo igabwatwa ogotomana, gagokora bo. 5 Nabo as'amachiko a Musa iga atochigete kobaaka amagena abanto buna abwo: gaki naki aye ogoteba? 6 Bagateba ring'ana eri bakomotema banyore enchera bakomosoera, Korende Yesu agekumba, akarika nekiara kiaye inse. 7 Nabarabwo bakamenta komoboria, akagororoka, akabatebia, Ere oyotari nebibe as'egati yaino abe oyo bwe ritang'ani komoruta rigena. 8 Agekumba naende, akarika, nekiara kiaye inse. 9 Nabarabwo, bagachia koigwa, bagasoerwa nebirengererio biabo, bagasoka oyomo oyomo bagachaka korwa as'abagaka goika as'ab'omoerio; agatigara Yesu bweka, noria omokungu oteneine gati gati. 10 Yesu akagororoka tamorora omonto tatiga oria omokungu, akamotebia, Omokungu, ng'ai bare baria abagosoeri bao? Onde tari ogokogambia? 11 Akamotebia, Onde tari, Omonene. Yesu akamotebia, Ninche tingokogambia; Genda; korende tokora ebibe naende. 12 Yesu agakwana nabarabwo naende, akabora, Inche nomobaso bw'ense: oyogontunyana takogenda as'omosunte, korende nabe omobaso bw'obogima. 13 Erio Abafarisai bakamotebia, Aye igo kwebera kirori omonyene; noborori bwao tibori obw'ekeene. 14 Yesu akairaneria akabatebia, Nonya ngwekwana inche omonyene, oborori bwane nobw'ekeene, ekiagera namanyire ase narure, nase nkogenda; korende inwe timomanyeti ase narure gose ase ngochia. 15 Inwe iga mokogamba as'engecho y'omobere; inche tindi komogambia omonto. 16 Naende ninsakogamba, okogamba kwane nokw'ekeene, naki tari inche bweka, korende inche na Tata oyontomete. 17 Naende as'amachiko aino iga arikire, ng'a oborori bw'abanto babere nobw'ekeene. 18 Inche ninche ngwekwana omonyene, nere Tata oyontomete igagoteba oborori asende. 19 Erio bakamotebia, Ng'ai are Iso? Yesu akairaneria, Inche timomanyeti, nonya Tata timomomanyeti, onye momanyete inche, anga mwamomanyire na Tata one. 20 Amang'ana aya igakwanete Yesu okworokereria ase hekalu, as'enyomba y'emonga: omonto tari omobwatete, ekiagera ensa yaye konya teraika. 21 Yesu akabatebia naende, Inche nkogendande, nainwe namondigie, namokwe as'ebibe biaino: aase nkogenda inche, inwe timokonyara gocha, 22 Abayahudi bakabora, Inee? igareite, ekiagera akobora, Aase nkogenda inche timekonyara gocha? 23 Akabatebia, Inwe naba inse; Inche noyo igoro: inwe nabe ense eye; Inche tindi oyo bw'ense eye, 24 As'ayio nabatebia ng'a namokwe as'ebibe biaino: naki motancheti ng'a inche nere, namokwe as'ebibe biaino. 25 Nabo bakamotebia, Naye ng'o? Yesu akabatebia, Ring'ana erio erio nakwanire nainwe korwa omochakano. 26 Ninde namang'ana amange ngokwana nakogamba as'engecho yaino: korende ere oyontomete noyo bw'ekeene; nainche aya naigure asare, naro ngokwana as'ense. 27 Tibainyora ekiagera abatorera Tata. 28 Erio Yesu akabatebia, Ekero mwatiekire komoimokia Omwana-o-mwanyabanto, erio namomanye ng'a inche nere, naende ng'a tindi gokora ring'ana inche omonyene, korende buna Tata anyorokereretie, nabo ngokwana. 29 Nere oyontomete iga are amo nainche; Tata tantigeti inche bweka; naki inche ngokora amatuko onsi aya akomogwenera. 30 Kagokwana aya, abange bakamwancha. 31 Nabo Yesu akabatebia Abayahudi baria bamwegenete, Komoraikaranse ase ring'ana riane, erio more aborokigwa bane b'ekeene; 32 naende namomanye ekeene, nakerokio ekeene nakebasibore. 33 Bakamoiraneria, Iga tore okoiborwa kw'Ibrahimu, na titoraba abasomba b'omonto kero kende gionsi; ko naki ogoteba, Ng'a namosiborwe? 34 Yesu akabairaneria, Ekeene ekeene; nabatebirie, ker'oyogokora ebibe, nomosomba bw'ebibe, 35 naende omosomba tari komenya 'nyomba botambe, korende omobiare iga akomenya amatuko onsi. 36 Gaki Omwana karabasibore namobe abasibore ekeene, ekeene. 37 Namanyire ng'a iga more okoiborwa kwa Ibrahimu; korende iga mokorigia kong'ita ekiagera ring'ana riane tiriri ime as'emioyo yaino. 38 Aya narorire ase Tata naro ngokwana: nainwe naboigo ayamwarorire as'iso oino, naro mogokora. 39 Bakairaneria, bakamotebia, Tata oito nere Ibrahimu. Yesu akabatebia, Onye mwarenge abana ba Ibrahimu, anga mwakora emeremo yaye Ibrahimu. 40 Korende bono morigetie kong'ita, omonto oyobatebirie ekeene keria naigure ase Nyasaye; Ibrahimu takorete iga. 41 Inwe iga mokoyekora emeremo y'iso oino. Bakamotebia, Intwe titoiboiri as'ogosaria; iga tore na tata oyomo, nere Nyasaye. 42 Yesu akabatebia, Onye Nyasaye narenge iso oino, anga mwanyanchete inche: naki narure ase Nyasaye naende nachire; gose tinchicheti as'inche omonyene korende nere ontomire. 43 Naki motainyoreti amang'ana ane aya ngokwana? Nekiagera motakonyara korigwa ring'ana riane. 44 Inwe nab'iso oino saitani, nokorengereria kw'iso oino nakwo mwanchete gokora. Ere igarenge omoiti korwa omochakano, gose tatenenete as'ekeene, ekiagera ekeene tikeri ime yaye. Kagokwana oborimo, igagokwana ayare aya ye omonyene: naki are omonyaborimo, naise bw'obwo. 45 Nainche, ekiagera ngokwana ekeene, timori konyegena. 46 Ning'o oino ogonteba ng'a ninde nebibe? Kongokwana ekeene naki inwe motakonyegena? 47 Oyore o Nyasaye iga akoyaigwa amang'ana a Nyasaye: as'ayio inwe timori koigwa, ekiagera inwe timori aba Nyasaye. 48 Abayahudi bakairaneria bakamotebia, Titori gokwana buya intwe: ng'a aye igore Omosamaria, naende nore nekerecha? 49 Yesu akairaneria, Inche tindi nekerecha; korende iga nasigete Tata one, nainwe timonsigeti. 50 Nainche tindikoborigia obonene bwane: nare oyokorigia nakogamba. 51 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Omonto kararibwate ring'ana riane, takorora amakweri nonya ng'ake. 52 Nabo Abayahudi bakamotebia, Bono twamanyire ng'a nore nekerecha. Ibrahimu okure, nababani; naye igogoteba, Omonto kararibwate ring'ana riane, takoigwa amakweri nonya ng'ake. 53 Aye nomonene kobua tata oito Ibrahimu, nere okure? Naende nababani bakure: naye bwekora obe ng'o? 54 Yesu akairaneria, Kondebake inche omonyene, obonene bwane tari gento: oyokombaka n'Tata one; mokobora inwe ng'a Nyasaye oino; 55 nainwe timomomanyeti; korende inche namomanyire; kondatebe ng'a timomanyeti nimbe omorimo buna inwe: korende namomanyire naende ring'ana riaye naribwatire. 56 Ibrahimu iso oino igagogete anyare korirora rituko riane; akarora akagoka. 57 Abayahudi bakamotebia, Otaraba nemiaka emerongo etano, n'Ibrahimu kwamororire? 58 Yesu akabatebia, Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Ritang'ani Ibrahimu ataraba, Inche nao nare. 59 Erio bakabogoria amagena bamorute: korende Yesu akebisa agasoka korwa ase hekalu ime.

english: 1 Then Jesus went up to Jerusalem. 2 And he taught them in the temple, saying, “How can these things be?” 3 The chief priests and Pharisees gathered around him, and they questioned him about many things, trying to trap him in his words; 4 but they could not find anything to use against him, so they wondered, “What shall we do?” 5 Some of the scribes said to each other, “This man has broken the law of Moses, and he teaches people to defile themselves.” 6 They asked him, “What do you think? Is it right to heal on the Sabbath?” 7 Jesus knew their thoughts, so he spoke to the man who had been healed, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored. 8 Then the Pharisees went away and began to plot how to destroy Jesus. 9 But when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from them, accompanied by his disciples. 10 They came to a place where there was a fig tree, and Jesus looked for fruit on it but found none. So he said to the tree, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again.” 11 Immediately the tree withered. 12 Jesus answered them, “Truly I tell you, if you have faith and do not doubt, you can do miracles like this. 13 And if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Be lifted up and thrown into the sea,’ and does not doubt in his heart but believes that what he says will happen, it will be done. 14 This generation is an evil generation; seek a sign, but no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah. 15 For just as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of a great fish, so too will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth. 16 On that day some people came to Jesus and asked him, “Teacher, is it right to pay taxes to Caesar or not?” 17 But he perceived their hypocrisy and said to them, “Why are you testing me? Show me a denarius.” 18 They brought him a denarius, and he asked them, “Whose image is this, and whose inscription?” 19 They replied, “Caesar’s.” 20 Then he said to them, “Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” 21 And they marveled at him. 22 The Sadducees came to him and, questioning him, asked about the resurrection. 23 But Jesus answered them, “When the Son of Man rises again, you will know that I am the Messiah.” 24 And they asked him, “Who are you?” Jesus replied, “I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end.” 25 And they asked him, “Where are you going?” Jesus answered, “I am going to the Father.” 26 And they said, “What does this mean?” Jesus said, “You will understand later what I am doing now.” 27 These men did not believe in him. 28 So Jesus said, “When you lift up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am the Messiah, and that I do nothing on my own authority, but speak only what the Father has taught me.” 29 He also said, “The Father who sent me has shown me everything I should do, and he has commanded me to tell you these things.” 30 Many believed in him when they heard his words. 31 To the Jews who had come to him, Jesus said, “If you hold to my teaching, you are truly my disciples. 32 Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.” 33 They answered him, “We are Abraham’s descendants and have never been slaves to anyone. How can you say that we shall be set free?” 34 Jesus replied, “Very truly I tell you, everyone who sins is enslaved to sin. 35 And a slave does not remain in the house forever, but a son remains there always. 36 So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed. 37 I know that you are Abraham’s descendants, but you want to kill me. 38 My message does not come from myself, but from the Father who sent me. 39 They tried to arrest him, but he slipped away. 40 Many Jews believed in him because of the miracles he performed. 41 But some of them said, “This man is deceiving us!” 42 Others asked, “Where are you going?” And he replied, “You will look for me, but you will not find me where I am going.” 43 They said among themselves, “Surely he isn’t going to leave us and go somewhere else, is he?” 44 Now some of them were looking for him, and others were arguing about whether he was the Messiah. 45 When Jesus returned to the temple courts, he began to teach. 46 Then someone arrested him and brought him before the high priest. 47 Why do you ask me questions?” Jesus replied. “I have spoken openly to everyone. I have nothing hidden. 48 Ask those who heard me. Surely they can testify to what I said.”  49 Then why did you arrest him?” the guards asked. “He hasn’t done anything wrong.” 50 But some of the Pharisees said, “He deceives the people by teaching them things that blaspheme God.” 51 Then Jesus asked them, “Is there any testimony against me?” 52 “We have heard him say that he will destroy this temple and rebuild it in three days,” they retorted. 53 So the high priest questioned him, “Is this true?” 54 But Jesus remained silent. The high priest then asked him again, “Are you the Messiah, the Son of God?” 55 “You have said so,” Jesus replied. “But I tell you, from now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Almighty.” 56 This caused an uproar among the Jewish leaders. 57 They demanded, “He has committed blasphemy! He is guilty!” 58 “What evidence do you have?” they asked. “We heard him say that he would destroy this temple and rebuild it in three days,” they replied. 59 But Jesus didn’t answer. The chief priests and the entire Sanhedrin looked for false witnesses to testify against him, hoping to condemn him to death.
ekegusii: 1 Agachia goeta akamorora omonto, omouko korwa okoiborwa kwaye. 2 Aborokigwa baye bakamoboria, bakobora, Rabii, ning'o okorete ebibe, nomonto oyo, gose nabamoibori baye, goika akaiborwa omouko? 3 Yesu akairaneria, oyo takorete ebibe nonya nabamoibori baye; korende nemeremo ya Nyasaye eorokigwe asare. 4 Nengwenerete inyekore emeremo yaye oyontomete ekero ore omobaso: obotuko ngochabore, atanyare omonto gokora emeremo. 5 Ekero inde as'ense, inche nomobaso bw'ense. 6 Agachia gokora gokwana aya, agatwa amate inse, agakora etintira as'aria amate, akamoaka omouko amaiso as'etintira eria, 7 akamotebia, Genda bwesibie ase ritibo ria Siloam (ogoonchorwa kwaye, Oyotomirwe). Erio akagenda agesibia, akairana, okorora. 8 Nabo abagisangio baye, nabaria abamoroche kare ekero arenge omouko, bakabora, Inee! oyo tari ere oria orenge gosaba, oikaransete? 9 Abande bakabora, Nere: abande bakabora, Yaya, igagwekaine nere. Ere omonyene akabora, Ninche ere. 10 Nabo bakamotebia, Amaiso ao naki aramokigwa? 11 Ere akairaneria, akabora, Omonto okorokwa Yesu okorete etintira, akang'aka amaiso ane, agantebia, Genda goika ritibo ria Siloam, bwesibie; nabo nkagenda ngesibia, nkanyora okorora. 12 Bakamotebia, Ng'ai are oyio? Akabora, Timanyeti. 13 Bakamoira oria orenge omouko ritang'ani as'Abafarisai. 14 Bono iga riarenge rituko ri'esabato ekero Yesu akorete etintira nakomoramokia amaiso. 15 Erio Abafarisai nabarabwo bakamoboria naende buna anyorete okorora. Akabatebia, Iga abeka etintira igoro as'amaiso ane, ngesibia, na bono narorire. 16 Erio abande b'Abafarisai bakabora, Omonto oyo taruete ase Nyasaye, ekiagera tayebwateti esabato. Abande bakabora, naki aranyare omonto omonyene ebibe gokora ebikone buna ebi? Gokaba ogwatananeka egati yabo. 17 Gaki bakamotebia oria omouko eria kabere, Aye naki okobora asare, ekiagera, akoramokia amaiso? Akabora, Igare omobani. 18 Erio Abayahudi tibancha amang'ana aye ng'a igarenge omouko, naende anyarete korora, goika bakabarangeria abamoibori baye oria onyorete okorora, 19 bakababoria, bakabora, Oyo nere omwana oino mogoteba ng'a iga aiboretwe omouko? Naki akora orora bono? 20 Abamoibori baye bakairaneria, bakabora, Twamanyire ng'a oyio nomwana oito, naende ng'a iga aiboretwe omouko: 21 korende buna arora bono, titomanyeti; gose ning'o omoramokia amaiso titomanyeti: ere nomonto omogima, moborie omonyene, nekwanere. 22 Abamoibori baye iga bakwanete 'aya as'okoiroka Abayahudi: naki Abayahudi konya babwatanire ng'a omonto oramoorokie ng'a nere Kristo, aserigwe korwa as'esunagogi. 23 Nero engecho yagerete abamoibori baye bakabora, Ere nomonto omogima, moborie. 24 Erio eria kabere bakamorangeria omonto oria orenge omouko, bakamotebia, Moe Nyasaye obonene: intwe twamanyire ng'a omonto oyio nomonyene ebibe, 25 Erio oria akairaneria akabora, Onye ere nomonyene ebibe timanyeti: namanyire ring'ana erimo, inche iga narenge omouko, korende bono narorire. 26 Bakamotebia naende, Naki agokorerete? Naki akoramogetie amaiso? 27 Akabairaneria, natiekire kobatebia, ko timoigweti: naki morigetie koigwa eria kabere? Inwe nainwe morigetie koba aborokigwa baye? 28 Erio bakamorama, bakabora, Naye omworokigwa oye; korende intwe iga tore aborokigwa ba Musa. 29 Intwe twamanyire ng'a Nyasaye igare gokwana ase Musa: korende as'oyo titomanyeti as'arure. 30 Oria omonto akairaneria akabatebia, Ring'ana eri nerio ogokumia, ng'a inwe timomanyeti as'arure, nere ondamokirie amaiso. 31 Twamanyire ng'a Nyasaye tari kobaigwa abanyene ebibe: korende omonto karabe omosasimi Nyasaye, nagokora obwanchani bwaye, oyio nere akoigwa. 32 Korwa omochakano teraigugwa ng'a omonto oyaramokirie amaiso omouko oiboretwe engecho eye. 33 Onye oyo taruete ase Nyasaye, anga takonyara gokora gento. 34 Bakairaneria, bakamotebia, Aye iga kwaiboretwe as'ebibe bioka, naye ngotworokereriore intwe? Bakamosokia isiko. 35 Yesu akaigwa ng'a bamosokirie isiko; akamorora, akabora, Aye kwegenire Omwana o Nyasaye? 36 Nere akairaneria, akabora, Ning'o Omonene, nyare komwegena? 37 Yesu akamotebia, Kwamororire naende nere ogokwana naye nere oyio. 38 Akabora, Nanchire Omonene; akamosasima. 39 Yesu akabora, Inche nachire ense eye as'ekina, erinde abatari korora barore; nabarabwo abakorora babe emeuko. 40 Ensemo y'Abafarisai abarenge amo nere bakaigwa aya, bakamotebia, Inee naintwe iga tore emeuko? 41 Yesu akabatebia, Onye mwarenge emeuko, anga timori nebibe: korende bono iga mogoteba, Nkororatore: gaki ebibe biaino biaikaransire.

english: 1 A man was born blind. His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned—this man or his parents—that he was born blind?” 2 Jesus answered, “Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but he was born blind so that the works of God might be displayed through him. 3 As long as I am in the world, I am the light.” 4 Having said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, and applied it to the man’s eyes. 5 “Go wash in the pool of Siloam,” he told him (Siloam means “sent”). So the man went and washed, and his sight was restored. 6 Therefore the Jews who had been with him when he healed the man began to ask, “How can a sinner perform such signs?” 7 So they asked the man who had been blind, “How were your eyes opened?” 8 He replied, “The man called Jesus made mud, put it on my eyes, and told me to wash. And I washed, and I could see.” 9 The Jews then interrogated him further. “Who is this Jesus?” they asked. 10 “I don’t know,” he replied. 11 They said to him, “How did he open your eyes?” 12 He answered, “I don’t know. Just ask me.” 13 They cursed him and said, “You are completely ignorant of God! We know that God doesn’t speak to sinners.” 14 But they said this so that they might exclude him and excommunicate him from their synagogue. 15 Then some of the Pharisees said, “This man hasn’t obeyed the law of the Sabbath!” 16 Others asked, “How can a sinner perform such miracles?” 17 So there was disagreement among them about how he had received his sight. 18 Again they questioned the man who had been blind. “What do you say about him?” they asked. “He is a prophet,” he replied. 19 The Pharisees then asked him, “Where did he come from?” 20 He answered, “I don’t know. Just ask me.” 21 They pressed him again. “Who healed you?” 22 “Jesus did,” he said. 23 “Are you dismissing us?” the Pharisees retorted. “We have studied the Scriptures and we know that the Messiah will not come until after the time of David. 24 How then can this man claim to be the Messiah?” 25 The man replied, “I don’t know who he is, but I used to be blind, and now I see.” 26 “What did he do to open your eyes?” they asked. 27 “I told you already,” he said. “But you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you also want to become his disciples?” 28 Then they hurled insults at him and said, “You are a disciple of Jesus! We don’t need anyone like that here.” 29 “I told you already,” the man replied. “And you didn’t listen. Why do you continue to question me?” 30 “What have you done?” they demanded. “Don’t think we don’t know you’re a sinner!” 31 “We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners,” they said. “But if you fear God and honor him, he will listen to you.” 32 “God has never opened the eyes of anyone except those who were righteous,” they argued. 33 “You insult God by claiming that you once were blind and now you see!” 34 “Whether he is a sinner or not, we don’t know,” they answered. “But we do know this: he restored your sight.” 35 They threw him out of the synagogue. 36 When Jesus heard what had happened, he found the man and asked, “Do you believe in the Son of Man?” 37 “Who is he, sir?” the man asked. “Tell me so I may believe in him.” 38 Jesus said, “You have already seen him; the one speaking to you is he.” 39 “Lord, I believe!” the man exclaimed, and worshiped him. 40 Some of the Pharisees who were nearby heard this and said to him, “Surely you aren’t going to join them too?” 41 Jesus overheard them and said, “Those who belong to God can hear what he says. Those who don’t belong to God won’t understand.”
ekegusii: 1 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Oyotasoeti as'egesieri ki'obueri bwe ching'ondi, korende arinere aande, oyio nomoibi naende nomouri. 2 Oyogosoa as'egesieri nomorisia bwe ching'ondi. 3 Omorendi iga akomoigorera oyo; neching'ondi iga chikomoigwa eriogi riaye: nere igagochirangeria ching'ondi chiaye as'amarieta abo, igagochiira isiko. 4 Gagochirusia isiko ching'ondi echire echiaye, igagochitang'ana; neching'ondi iga chikomotunyana: naki chiarimanyire eriogi riaye. 5 Omogeni tichikomotunyana nonya ng'ake, korende iga chiramotame; ekiagera tichirimanyeti eriogi ri'abageni. 6 Omoreng'anio oyo Yesu akabatebia; korende barabwo tibayamanyete amang'ana ayio abatebetie. 7 Erio Yesu akabatebia naende, Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Ninche egesieri gie ching'ondi. 8 Bonsi abantang'anerete nabaibi, nabauri: korende ching'ondi tichiabaigwete. 9 Ninche nde egesieri: omonto gagosoa as'inche, nakonyeke, nasoe, nasoke, nanyore oborisia, 10 Omoibi tagocha, tatiga aibe, anyenye, asarie; inche iga nachete babe nobogima, nababe naborobwo obonge. 11 Inche ninche omorisia omuya: omorisia omuya igakobeka obogima bwaye as'engecho ye ching'ondi. 12 Omonto orikire, naende tari ere omorisia, ekiagera ching'ondi tichiri chiaye, gakoyerora esese y'orosana egocha, ochitiga ching'ondi, otama: nesese y'orosana yachisakora, na gochiserebania. 13 Ere igagotama ekiagera nomonto orikire, gose tarengerereti amang'ana e ching'ondi. 14 Inche ninche omorisia omuya; nechire chiane nachimanyire, nechire chiane chiamanyire, 15 buna Tata amanyete, nainche namomanyire Tata; nobogima bwane nabobekire as'engecho ye ching'ondi. 16 Naende ching'ondi chinde mbwate, chitari chie riicho eri; nachirochio nabo engwenerete gochireta, neriogi riane nachirigwe; nachibe riicho erimo nomorisia oyomo. 17 As'ayio Tata nanyanchete, ekiagera nabekire obogima bwane, erinde inyare kobobogoria naende. 18 Tari omonto okonduseria, korende ninche nabobekire omonyene. Ninde nokobua kobobeka naende ninde nokobua kobobogoria naende. Ogochika oko iga nakonyorire ase Tata one, 19 Erio gokaba naende ogwatananeka as'Abayahudi, as'engecho y'amang'ana aya. 20 Abange babo bakabora, Nare nekerecha, naende nebarimo; naseki mokomoigwa? 21 Abande bakabora, Amang'ana aya tari ay'omento omonyene ekerecha. Inee! ekerecha nakenyare koyaramokia amaiso emeuko? 22 Ndiarenge rituko rinene ri'ogosibigwa aria Yerusalemu; nekero ki'obokendu. 23 Na Yesu igarenge gotara hekalu ime, as'egora ya Sulemani. 24 Erio Abayahudi bakamoetanana, bakamotebia, Ngoika ririri oratoichanerie emioyo yaito?
