Onye naye Kristo, totebie maiso marore. 25 Yesu akabairaneria, Nabatebirie, nainwe timori gwancha: emeremo eye ngokora as'erieta ria Tata one, nero ekombera kirori. 26 Korende inwe timori gwancha ekiagera timori ase ching'ondi chiane. 27 ching'ondi chiane iga chikorigwa eriogi riane, nainche nachimanyire, nachirochio iga chigontunya: 28 nainche nachieire obogima bwa kare nakare; na chirochio tichigosira nonya ng'ake, nonya nomonto tagochitaboria korwa as'okoboko kwane. 29 Tata one oching'eire nomonene kobua bonsi; nonde takonyara gochitaboria korwa as'okoboko kwa Tata. 30 Inche na Tata nobomo. 31 Erio Abayahudi bagachora amagena naende, erinde bamoake. 32 Yesu akabairaneria, Emeremo emiya emenge naborokirie eruete ase Tata; as'emeremo eyio nereri mokong'akera amagena? 33 Abayahudi bakamoiraneria bakabora, As'emeremo emiya titogokoakera amagena, korende nas'okorama; ekiagera aye, ore omonto, ogwekora omonyene ng'a naye Nyasaye. 34 Yesu akabairaneria, Tarikiri as'amachiko aino, ng'a inche natebete, Inwe iga more chinyasaye? 35 Onye obarogete baria chinyasaye abacheretwe nering'ana ria Nyasaye (namariko takonyara gosareka), 36 Inee! iga mogoteba asare, ere Tata asibetie akamotoma as'ense, Nkoramare: ekiagera nateba, Inche n'Omwana o Nyasaye? 37 Onye tindi koyekora emeremo ya Tata one timonyancha. 38 Korende kondayekore, nonya timonyancheti inche, yianche eria emeremo; monyare komanya nagwancha ng'a Tata igare ime yane, nainche ime ase Tata, 39 Bakarigia eria kabere komobwata: akarua as'amaboko abo. 40 Akagenda naende ng'umbu ya Yorodan goika aas'aria Yohana are kobatisera ritang'ani; agaikaransa agwo. 41 Abanto abange bakamochiera, bakabora, Yohana takorete egekone kende gionsi: korende onsi ayatebete Yohana as'omonto oyo igare ay'ekeene, 42 Abange bakamwancha agwo.

english: 1 Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in me also believes in the one who sent me. 2 Whoever looks at me sees the one who sent me. 3 I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes may remain in darkness. 4 If anyone hears my words but does not obey them, I do not judge him, for I did not come to judge the world, but to save it. 5 Anyone who rejects me and doesn’t accept my message has already been judged, because the word I speak will be his condemnation. 6 These things I told you so that when the time comes you will remember that I warned you. 7 “Truly, truly, I tell you,” Jesus replied, “I am the gate for the sheep. 8 All those who came before me were thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them. 9 I am the gate; whoever enters through me will be saved, and they will come in and go out and find pasture. 10 The thief comes only to steal, kill, and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full. 11 “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep. 12 A hired hand is not a shepherd and doesn’t care when the sheep are scattered. He runs away because he’s a hired hand and has no concern for the sheep. 13 But I know my sheep, and they know me—just as the Father knows me and I know the Father—and I lay down my life for the sheep. 14 I have other sheep that aren’t in this fold. I must bring them too, and they will listen to my voice, so there will be one flock and one shepherd. 15 I lay down my life for my sheep. 16 And I have other sheep that are not of this pen. I must lead those also, and they will hear my voice. Then there will be one flock, one shepherd. 17 The Father loves me because I lay down my life—and then take it back again. 18 No one takes it from me, but I freely lay it down. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This command I received from my Father.” 19 At this, the Jews became divided over these words. 20 Many of them said, “He has a demon!” Others said, “What can he say like that?” 21 Still others asked, “Is this the Messiah?” 22 They went around him, asking, “How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly.” 23 Jesus answered, “I have already told you, yet you don’t believe me. 24 The works I do in my Father’s name testify about me, 25  but you don’t believe because you are not my sheep. 26 My sheep listen to my voice, and I know them, and they follow me. 27 I give them eternal life, and they will never perish. No one will snatch them out of my hand. 28 My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one can snatch them out of my Father’s hand. 29 I and my Father are one.” 30 Again his Jewish opponents picked up stones to stone him. 31 Jesus said to them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. Which one of these do you intend to use against me?” 32 The Jews replied, “We are stoning you not for any good work, but for blasphemy! You, a man, claim to be God.” 33 Jesus answered, “Isn’t it written in your Law, ‘I said, you are gods’? 34 If he called them ‘gods,’ and Scripture cannot be broken, 35 how can you accuse me of blasphemy for saying, ‘I am the Son of God’? 36 If I don’t perform miracles, don’t believe me! 37 But if I do, don’t believe me anyway. For what my Father has done is revealed through me. 38 I and my Father are one.” 39 They tried again to arrest him, but he escaped their grasp. 40 He went back across the Jordan River to the place where John had been baptizing, and people gathered around him, and he taught them there. 41 Many were saying, “John did no miraculous signs, but everything John said about this man was true.” 42 And many believed in him there.
ekegusii: 1 Nabo omonto gete narenge omorwaire, erieta riaye Lazaro o Bethania, omonto bw'omochie o Mariamu na Maritha mosubati omwabo. 2 Nere Mariamu oria omoagete Omonene amaguta, nakamotinyia amagoro aye as'etukia yaye, naki momura omwabo Lazaro igarenge omorwaire. 3 Nabo baria basubati bamwabo bagatoma omotomwa asare, bakobora, Omonene, ere oyobwanchete orwarire. 4 Yesu agachia koigwa, akabora, Oborwaire obwo tari obw'amakweri, korende nas'obonene bwaye Nyasaye, erinde Omwana o Nyasaye abakwe as'obwo. 5 Nere Yesu igamwanchete Maritha, na mosubati omwabo, na Lazaro. 6 Erio agachia koigwa ng'a nomorwaire, agaikaransa amatuko abere aas'aria arenge. 7 Erio nyuma as'aya akabatebia aborokigwa baye, Togende Boyahudi naende. 8 Baria aborokigwa bakamotebia, Rabii, moisonde Abayahudi iga barenge korigia gokoaka amagena: naye nkogendore aroro naende? 9 Yesu akairaneria, chinsa chi'omobaso tichiri ikomi naibere? Omonto karagende 'mobaso tari kogochwa, ekiagera ayoroche omobaso bw'ense eye. 10 Korende omonto karagende botuko, igakogochwa, ekiagera omobaso tori ime yaye. 11 Akayakwana aya: erio nyuma as'aya akabatebia, Lazaro omosani oito orarire; korende nkogendande inyare komotura. 12 Baria aborokigwa baye bakamotebia, Omonene, onye orarire nagwene. 13 Korende Yesu igakwanete amang'ana amakweri aye: nabarabwo bagakaga ng'a iga agokwana amang'ana okorara chitoro. 14 Erio agwo Yesu akabatebia maiso marore, Lazaro okure. 15 Nainche nagokire as'engecho yaino ekiagera ntarenge aroro, erinde monyare gwancha; korende togende asare, 16 Nabo Thomas, okorokwa Didumo akabatebia aborokigwa bamwabo, Togende naintwe, tokwe amo nere. 17 Erio agachia goika Yesu, akamonyora otiekire koba embera amatuko ane. 18 Bethania iga yarenge ang'e na Yerusalemu, orogendo rwe chimaili ibere; 19 nabanto abange as'Abayahudi bagacha ase Maritha na Mariamu, erinde babaremie as'engecho y'oyomwabo. 20 Nabo Maritha agachia koigwa ng'a Yesu ochire, akagenda komorotota: korende Mariamu igaikaransete nyomba ime. 21 Erio Maritha akamotebia Yesu, Omonene onye naa kwarenge, momura ominto anga takwete. 22 Korende nonya mbono namanyire, ng'a kende gionsi oramosabe Nyasaye, Nyasaye nakoe. 23 Yesu akamotebia, Oyomino naboke naende. 24 Maritha akamotebia, Namanyire ng'a naboke as'okobokigwa kwe rituko ri'omoerio. 25 Yesu akamotebia, Inche nokobokigwa nobogima: oyonyanchire inche, nonya ogokwa, nanyare koba moyo. 26 Naendeker'oyore moyo nakonyancha inche tagokwa nonya ng'ake. Inee! gwanchire aya? 27 Akamotebia, Ee, Omonene: Inche nanchire ng'a aye naye Kristo, Omwana o Nyasaye, oria ogocha ense. 28 Naende gakwanire aya, akagenda, akamorangeria mosubati omwabo, Mariamu, bobisi, akabora, Omworokia ochire, ngokorangeriare. 29 Nere agachia koigwa, akaimoka bwango, akamochiera. 30 (Na Yesu konya taraika omochie ime, korende igarenge aria aria aase riaumeranete na Maritha.) 31 Erio baria Abayahudi barenge amo nere nyomba ime, abakomoremia, bagachia komorora Mariamu buna aimoka bwango nagosoka, bakamotunyana, bagakaga ng'a igakogenda oboina erinde arere aroro. 32 Erio Mariamu, agachia goika aria aas'arenge Yesu, akamorora, akagwa as'amagoro aye, akamotebia, Omonene, onye naa kwarenge, anga oyominto takwete. 33 Erio Yesu agachia komorora okorera, nabaria Abayahudi bachete amo nere bakorera, agasogwa nobororo as'omoyo oye, agaichana. 34 Akabora, ng'ai mwamobekire? Bakamotebia, Omonene, nchuo orore. 35 Yesu akaiyeria amariga. 36 Erio Abayahudi bakabora, Rora buna amwanchete! 37 Korende abande bakabora, Inee! oyoyaramogetie amaiso oria omouko, tanyarete komogwenia oyo takwa? 38 Nabo Yesu oichanete naende as'omoyo oye, agaika oboina. Naborobwo iga bwarenge rikuruma, naende rigena ndiabegetwe igoro yaye. 39 Yesu akabora, Ritigerie rigena. Maritha, mosubati omwabo, oria okwete, akamotebia, Omonene, otiokire bono: naki obaire egetondo amatuko ane. 40 Yesu akamotebia, Tingotebeti ng'a koranche noborore obonene bwa Nyasaye? 41 Nabo bakarirusia riria rigena. Yesu akaramokia amaiso aye igoro, akabora, Tata, nakoiraneirie ng'a mbuya mono ekiagera okong'igwa. 42 Nainche namanyete ng'a iga okong'igwa amatuko onsi: korende as'engecho y'omoganda oyo oetanaine, ngakwana aya, banyare gwancha ng'a naye gwantomete. 43 Erio gakwanire iga, akaaka eriogi rinene, Lazaro, soka isiko. 44 Agasoka oria okwete, oboirie egetambaa amagoro namaboko; obosio bwaye boboirie egetambaa. Yesu akabatebia, Mosansore, momotige agende. 45 Nabo abange as'Abayahudi abachete ase Mariamu nakoyarora ayakorete Yesu, bakamwancha. 46 Korende abande babo bakagenda as'Abafarisai, bakabatebia ayakora Yesu. 47 Abakuani abanene n'Abafarisai bagasangerereka ritongo, bakabora, Ninki togokora, naki omonto oyo agokora ebikone ebinge. 48 Gatoramotige iga, abanto bonsi nabamwanche; n'Abarumi nabache, nabarusie aase aito negesaku giaito. 49 Omonto oyomo asebare, Kaifa, oyorenge omokuani omonene omwaka oria, akabatebia, Inwe timomanyeti kende gionsi. 50 Gose timorengerereti ng'a negwenerete omonto oyomo akwe as'engecho y'abanto aba, ng'a egesaku tigesira ekegima. 51 Naende eri takwanete as'omoyo oye omonyene, korende ekiagera arenge omokuani omonene omwaka oria, akabana ng'a Yesu nakwe as'engecho y'egesaku keria; 52 gose tari as'engecho y'egesaku keria gioka, korende amo naya abasangererie abana ba Nyasaye abatananekire babe abamo. 53 Nabo korwa rituko riria bagakora ekina banyare komoita. 54 Yesu tatarete naende ase maiso marore as'egati y'Abayahudi, korende akarua aria akagenda aase ang'e neroro, goika omochie okorokwa Efuraim; agaikaransa aroro amo naborokigwa baye. 55 Naende epasaka y'Abayahudi iga yarenge ang'e: abange bagatira korwa chinse chionsi kogenda Yerusalemu ritang'ani as'epasaka, erinde besibie. 56 Nabo bakamorigia Yesu, bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, bagotenena ase hekalu, Naki moroche? Tagocha nonya ng'ake ase rituko eri? 57 Bono abakuani n'Abafarisai bakarua ogochika ng'a omonto karamomanye aas'are, arete amang'ana, banyare komobwata.

english: 1 Now Lazarus was sick, and his sisters Mary and Martha sent a message to Jesus telling him. 2 Mary, who sat at his feet and listened to his word, was the one who sent the message. 3 Martha met him on the way and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.” 4 But when Jesus heard this, he said, “Your brother will rise again.” 5 Martha answered, “I know he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.” 6 Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die; 7 and whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?” 8 She said to him, “Yes, Lord, I believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of God, who is coming into the world.” 9 Then she went back and told her sister Mary privately that Jesus was calling for her. 10 As soon as Mary heard this, she got up and went to him. 11 Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still outside at the place where Martha had met him. 12 When Mary reached him, she fell at his feet and said to him, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.” 13 When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come along with her were also weeping, he was deeply moved in spirit and troubled. 14 He said, “Where have you laid him?” They said, “Lord, come and see.” 15 Jesus wept. 16 Then the Jews said, “See how much he loved him!” 17 Some of them said, “Could not he who opened the eyes of the blind man have kept this man from dying?” 18 Those who had stood with Mary comforted her. 19 When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet him, while Mary stayed at home. 20 Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.” 21 Then Jesus said, “Your brother will rise again.” 22 Martha replied, “I know he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.” 23 Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die; 24 and whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?” 25 She said to him, “Yes, Lord, I believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of God, who has come into the world.” 26 And when she had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside, whispering to her, “Jesus is calling for you.” 27 When Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to him. 28  Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, and Martha met him on the road. 29 When Mary reached the place where Jesus was and saw him, she fell at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.” 30 When Jesus saw her crying, and the Jews who had come along with her were also crying, he was once again deeply moved in spirit. 31 So he said, “Where have you laid him?” They said, “Lord, come and see.” 32 Then Mary went to where Jesus was and knelt at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.” 33 When Jesus saw her crying, and the Jews who had come along with her were also crying, he was greatly disturbed in spirit and testified, “See how much he loves him!” 34 Then someone said, “Rabbi, look!” And they began to weep loudly. 35 Jesus wept again. 36 The Jews said, “See how much he loved him!” 37 But some of them said, “Could not he who opened the eyes of the blind man have kept this man from dying?” 38 Jesus, once more deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave, and a stone lay against it. 39 Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of the dead man, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a bad odor, for he has been dead four days.” 40 Jesus answered, “Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?” 41 So they took away the stone. Then Jesus looked up and said, “Father, I thank you that you have heard me. 42 I knew that you always hear me, but I say this so that the people will believe that you sent me.” 43 After he had said this, Jesus called out, “Lazarus, come out!” 44 The dead man came out, wrapped in grave clothes, and his hands and feet were tied with strips of linen. 45 Jesus said to them, “Untie him and let him go.” 46 So those who had stood there with Mary and seen what happened were amazed. 47 Some of the Pharisees said, “See how nothing gets us anywhere! Here we are, trying to destroy him.” 48 But even then many of the Jews came to Jesus and put their faith in him. 50 Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent member of the Sanhedrin, also came forward and asked Pilate for Jesus’ body. 51 He received permission, and he took the body down and wrapped it in fine linen with spices—in keeping with Jewish burial customs. 52 Now there was a garden near the place of crucifixion, and in the garden a new tomb in which no one had ever been laid. 53 So they laid Jesus in this tomb, because it was nearby and the Sabbath was approaching. 54 As evening approached, a rich man named Joseph of Arimathea arrived. 55 He went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate ordered that it be given to him. 56 Joseph took the body, wrapped it in clean linen cloth, 57 and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut into the rock. He rolled a large stone over the entrance of the tomb and went away.
ekegusii: 1 Nabo Yesu amatuko atano narimo ritang'ani ri'epasaka agaika Bethania, agwo aas'arenge Lazaro, oria okwete obogetigwe nere. 2 Bakamokorera endagera aria: Maritha akamokorera; korende Lazaro igarenge oyomo ase baria baikaransete as'endagera amo nere. 3 Erio Mariamu akabogoria ekerengo ki'eratili eyemo y'amanukato, aye rigori rinene, akamoaka Yesu amagoro, akayatinyia amagoro aye netukia yaye: enyomba egaichora rimisu ri 'amaguta aria. 4 Korende Yudas Omoisikariota omwana o Simon, oyomo bw'aborokigwa baye, oyoramorue, akabora, 5 Naki amaguta aya atagorua chidinari chimia isato, nakoegwa abataka? 6 Iga akwanete aya, tari ng'a igarengereria abataka; korende nekiagera arenge omoibi, naende obwate esanduku ye chishilingi, nagochirusia echiabekire aroro. 7 Erio Yesu agateba, Motige agache aya ase rituko ri'ogotindekwa kwane, 8 Naki abataka more nabarabwo amatuko onsi amo nainwe; korende timori nainche amatuko onsi, 9 Nabo omoganda omonene bw'Abayahudi bakamanya ng'a ere nao are aria: bagacha, tari as'engecho yaye Yesu yoka, korende bamorore Lazaro, ekiagera amobogetie korwa as'ogokwa: 10 Abakuani abanene bagakora ekina bamoite Lazaro nere; 11 naki as'engecho yaye abange b'Abayahudi bakagenda, bakamwancha Yesu. 12 Rituko ria kabere abanto abange abaricherete rituko rinene, kobachia koigwa ng'a Yesu ngochare Yerusalemu, 13 bakabogoria chinsagia chi'amakendo bagasoka isiko kogenda komorotota, bakaaka eriogi, Hosana: Osesenigwe oyochire as'erieta ri'Omonene, omoruoti o Isiraeli. 14 Yesu akanyora emori y'etigeri akayerina; buna yarigetwe, 15 Toiroka, enyaroka ya Zayoni: rigereria, Omoruoti oo ochichire igaikaransete igoro as'emori y'etigere. 16 Amang'ana aya aborokigwa baye tibainyora agwo ritang'ani; korende Yesu agachia kobakwa, erio bakainyora ng'a narikeire aya naende ng'a mbamokorerete aya. 17 Nabo bakamoorokia omoganda abarenge amo nere ekero amorangeretie Lazaro korwa as'oboina ime nakomobokia. 18 As'engecho eyio omoganda okagenda komorotota, naki baigure ng'a okorire egekone eke. 19 Erio Abafarisai bagatebania barabwo ase barabwo, Mwarorire ng'a timokonyara gokora gento; ense yagendire komotunyana ere. 20 Naende mbarenge Abayunani batai bake ase barabwo abanto abatirete kogenda gosasima as'ekero kie rituko rinene; 21 barabwo abwo bakamogendera Filipo o Bethisaida o Galili, bakamoboria, bakobora, Omonene, ntorigetie komorora Yesu. 22 Filipo akagenda, akamotebia Anderea: erio Anderea na Filipo bakamotebia Yesu. 23 Yesu akairaneria, akabora, Ensa yaikire, abakwe Omwana-o-mwanyabanto. 24 Ekeene, ekeene, nabatebirie, Euyeke y'engano etagweti as'ense ekwe iga egoikaransa ero yoka; korende kerakwej iga ekwama okwama okonge. 25 Oyoranche obogima bwaye nabosirie; oyorabogeche obogima bwaye as'ense eye nabogache goika obogima bwa kare nakare. 26 Omonto karankorere, antunyane; inche asende, nao nomosomba one aranyare koba; naende omonto karankorere, Tata namosike. 27 Bono omoyo one oichanire; ninki ngokwana? Tata, onkonye nensa eye. Korende as'engecho y'ayio nayeikeire ensa eye. 28 Tata, oribake erieta riao, erio rigacha eriogi korwa igoro, rigoteba, Naribakire, nainche nandibake naende. 29 Nabo abanto batenenete ang'e bakaigwa, bakabora, ng'a kwabaire okogukura: abande bakabora, Rilaika rigokwana nere. 30 Yesu akairaneria, akabora, Eriogi eri tiribeti as'engecho yane, korende as'engecho yaino. 31 Bono ekina gi'ense eye nkere: bono omonene bw'ense eye natugutwe isiko. 32 Nainche kondaimokererigwe igoro as'ense, nimbang'use bonsi asende. 33 Agakwana aya, erinde aorokie amakweri ki aranyare gokwa. 34 Erio omoganda okameiraneria, Twaigure as'amachiko ng'a Kristo iga akobao goika kare nakare: naye naki okobora ng'a nemogwenerete Omwana-o-mwanyabanto aimokererigwe igoro? Oyo Omwana-o-mwanyabanto nere ng'o? 35 Yesu akabatebia, Omobaso igore amo nainwe ekero egeke. Genda ekero more noria omobaso, omusunte tocha kobabua: nere oyokogenda omosunte ime tamanyeti aas'akogenda. 36 Ekero more nomobaso, yuanche omobaso, monyare koba abana b'omobaso. Ayio akwanete Yesu, akagenda akebisa nabarabwo. 37 Nonya okorete ebikone ebinge as'amasio abo, tibamwanchete: 38 erinde riikeranigwe ring'ana riria ri'omobani Isaya aritebete, Omonene, ning'o oyanchire amang'ana aito? Naende okoboko kw'Omonene kwamanoirwe nang'o? 39 Naki as'engecho eye tibanyara gwancha, naki Isaya atebete naende, 40 Obaukoirie amaiso, okorire chinkoro chiabo chinkong'u; Tibacha korora as'amaiso abo nakomanya ase chinkoro chiabo, Beenchore, Mbagwenie. 41 Amang'ana ayio akwanete Isaya ekiagera akarora obonene bwaye; agatora amang'ana aye. 42 Korende nonya nabo as'abanene abange bakamwancha; korende ekiagera as'engecho y'Abafarisai tibaorogetie, tibacha korusigwa as'esunagogi: 43 naki mbabwanchete obonene bw'abanto kobua obonene bwa Nyasaye. 44 Yesu akaaka eriogi akabora, Oyonyanchire inche, tanyancheti inche, korende noyontomete. 45 Nere oyondigereirie inche, omorigereirie ere oyontomete. 46 Inche nachire imbe omobaso as'ense, erinde ker'oyonyanchire, taikaransa omosunte ime. 47 Naende omonto karaigwe amang'ana ane, ko tayabwata, inche tinkomogambia: ekiagera tincheti kogambia ense, korende nyekonye ense. 48 Oyoranyange inche otancheti amang'ana ane, nare noyoramogambie: ring'ana riria nakwanete, nario riranyare komogambia rituko ri'omoerio. 49 Naki inche tinkwaneti ase inche bweka omonyene; korende nere ontomete, engecho yaye Tata, onchikire aya ngoteba naende ayst ngokwana. 50 Nainche namanyire ng'a ogochika kwaye nobogima bwa kare nakare: nabo aya ngokwana inche buna Tata antebetie, nabo ngokwana.

english: Articles of Faith in Kisii
ekegusii: Articles of Faith in Kisii

english: I declare that the Five Books of Moses were given by God through people who were inspired; and also that they are true and accurate in every detail, and that they reveal the eternal character of God and His dealings with mankind; the teachings of Christ and the doctrines of God.
ekegusii: Igo twegenete ng’a Ebibilia Enchenu nigo yarigetwe na Mwanyabanto abwo baetwe okobua gwakemoika; nakwo ogteba buna nigo are n’ekeene getaochaginirie na okomocha ase igo nigo ere, nabo erabe kegima goika omoerio bwe ebiro, okomaanoka gwoka ogoikeranu gwokagania kwa Nyazae aze Mwanyabanto; ekerenga giekeene gio kobwatana kwomoKristo na ekerengo kiomoerio aze ogoteeme chingencho, amoorokerenoi na okoganie kwa Mwanyabanto.

english: Psalm 19:7-11
ekegusii: Zaburi 19:7-11

english: 7. The law of the Lord is perfect, converting souls. The testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.
ekegusii: 7. Amachiko ‘OMONENE namaikeranu, nigo agokora omoyo oba omoyia. Oborori bw’Omonene nobw’ekene, nigo akong’ainiya oyotamanyeti amange.

english: 8. The statutes of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart. The commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.
ekegusii: 8. Amachiko ‘OMONENE namaronge nigo akogokia enkoro; ring’ana Omonene achikirie nerironge, nigo rikorenta oborabu ase amaiso.

english: 9. The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring forever. The judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.
ekegusii: 9. Okomoiriko OMONENE nering’ana rinchegenete, okwo koragendere kare na kare; okogamba kw’Omonene nog’ekeene, na okw’oboronge.

english: 10. They are more desirable than gold, yes, than much fine gold. They are sweeter than honey, yes, than the honeycomb.
ekegusii: 10. Ayio onsi nigo are amaya kobua etahabu, ee, kobua etahabu echenire. Na amansu kobua obooke, ee, kobua richoe ri’obooke.

english: 11. Moreover Your servant is warned by them, and in keeping them there is great reward.
ekegusii: 11. Amo nayio nigo ogokurera omosomba oo; oyio okoyarenda nigo akoegwa eng’eria enene obuya.

english: Psalm 119:89
ekegusii: Zaburi 119:89

english: Forever, O Lord, Your word is settled in heaven.
ekegusii: Aye OMONENE, ring’ana riao nigo riteneine bokong’u aaria igoro goika kare na kare.

english: Psalm 119:105
ekegusii: Zaburi 119:105

english: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
ekegusii: Ring’ana riao netaya ase amagoro aane na omobaso ase enchera ngoeta.

english: Psalm 119:30
ekegusii: Zaburi 119:30

english: I have chosen a good way; I will keep Your statutes.
ekegusii: Inche nachorire enchera y’ekeene, nabekire ase obosio bwane aya gwanchikire.

english: Psalm 119:60
ekegusii: Zaburi 119:60

english: I will hasten and not delay to keep Your commandments.
ekegusii: Amang’ana ao onsi nay’ekeene, na okogamba kwao gwonsi kw’oboronge nogwa kare na kare.

english: Proverbs 30:5-6
ekegusii: Emerenga’anio 30:5-6

english: 5. Every word of God is pure; He is a shield to those who trust in Him.
ekegusii: 5. Kera ring’ana ria Nyasae nigo rienekirie ng’a neri’ekeene. Ere nenguba ase abwo bakomotamera, barendwe.

english: 6. Do not add to His words, lest He rebuke you, and you be found a liar.
ekegusii: 6. Tobaisa komenta kende ase aman’ana aye, nigo arabaise kogotogonyera, naye obe omonyaborimo.

english: Proverbs 8:20
ekegusii: Emerenga’anio 8:20

english: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the paths of justice.
ekegusii: Nigo nkobwaita enchera y’oboronge, naba ngotaara ase oboeto bw’ekeene.

english: Luke 16:31
ekegusii: Luka 16:31

english: But if they do not hear Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded though one rise from the dead.
ekegusii: Akamotebia, bataigweti Musa nababani, naisa koimoka omonto korwa as'abakure, tibakoebererigwa banche.

english: 25. Then He said to them, “Oh foolish ones, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!
ekegusii: 25. Nere akabatebia, Inwe abariri, nabanyene emioyo emerito as'okoyancha onsi batebete ababani!

english: 26. Did not the Christ have to suffer these things and enter into His glory?”
ekegusii: 26. Tiyamogwenerete Kristo konyora emechando eye, erio asoe obonene bwaye?

english: 27. And beginning at Moses and all the Prophets, He explained to them what was written about Himself in all the Scriptures.
ekegusii: 27. Akachaka korwa Musa nababani bonsi akabaonchorera as'amariko onsi amang'ana are igoro asare.

english: 44. Then He said to them, “These are the words which I spoke to you while I was still with you, that all things must be fulfilled which were written in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and the Psalms concerning Me.”
ekegusii: 44. Akabatebia, Aya naro amang'ana ane nabatebetie, rigoro narenge asemore, buna onsi agwenerete goikeranigwa ayanarikeretwe as'amachiko a Musa nas'ababani, nase Zaburi.

english: 45. Then He opened their understanding, that they might comprehend the Scriptures.
ekegusii: 45. Erio akaigora obong'aini bwabo, banyare koyamanya amariko amachenu.

english: John 5:39
